entries.en: Every single one of these games has their own dedicated fanbase, be that niche or gargantuan, and so each will sell a respectable number of copies. But this tidal wave of competitors – a slew of games that all look really good – will no doubt erode away at the potential winnings. Even the most dedicated player can’t be expected to buy into this entire buffet, and so some of the dishes are inevitably going to go cold.

entries.en: It feels like storm clouds are brewing over Control Resonant developer Remedy, the incredibly talented Finnish studio whose visionary games never quite connect with the size of audience they deserve. FBC: Firebreak understandably cost the company – few people were looking for a merely okay live service shooter in the 2020s – but Remedy has struggled with sales even on its critically adored projects. It took over a year for Alan Wake 2 to make a profit. The company’s new CEO, former EA studio head Jean-Charles Gaudechon, has already said that Remedy’s unique approach must be “protected”, and I can only hope he can find a way to successfully weather this storm.
entries.cn: 感觉《控制：共振》的开发商Remedy上空乌云密布。这家极具天赋的芬兰工作室，其富有远见的游戏从未获得应有的受众规模。《FBC：Firebreak》让公司付出了代价——在2020年代，很少有人想要一款仅仅还行的服务型射击游戏——但即使是备受好评的项目，Remedy在销量上也举步维艰。《心灵杀手2》花了一年多才盈利。公司新任CEO、前EA工作室负责人Jean-Charles Gaudechon已经表示，Remedy的独特方法必须得到「保护」，只能希望他能找到成功渡过这场风暴的方法。

entries.en: I recently sat down with Daniel McMahon, a writer who worked on LA Noire for a YouTube video celebrating the game's recent 15th anniversary. In the second half of the video, we dove deep on Whore of the Orient, a controversial game that would've served as a spiritual successor to LA Noire. The game was in the works at Kennedy Miller-Mitchell, the production company of the Mad Max films, and was being worked on by ex-Team Bondi staff, including LA Noire writer and director Brendan McNamara.

entries.en: Nowhere is this shift more evident than at the helm of the Fahrenheit, Final Fantasy 10’s airship. In prior games, unlocking the airship was a moment of unparalleled excitement. Each entry’s cloud-surfer grants you complete freedom, permitting you to thunder across the overworld at a pace you could only dream of in the game’s opening act. But in Final Fantasy 10, the Fahrenheit is nothing more than a fancy fast travel menu. A list of destinations dressed for the Met Gala. A diamond-encrusted spreadsheet of co-ordinates.
entries.cn: 这种转变在《最终幻想10》的飞空艇「Fahrenheit」上体现得尤为明显。在前作中，解锁飞空艇是一个无比激动人心的时刻。每一部作品中的云端冲浪者都能赋予你完全的自由，让你能以在游戏开场部分想都不敢想的高速驰骋在大地图上。但在《最终幻想10》里，Fahrenheit只不过是一个花哨的快速旅行菜单。

entries.en: But above all of this, ownership matters because it’s an investment. It’s an investment players themselves make in their life, because they believe in the video game experience. Whether you’re 15 years old picking up extra shifts at your first job or 50 years old blocking out a weekend to enjoy a long-awaited release; the future of what happens with that video game should lie with the person who’s bought it and them alone. So why are our video games slipping out of our hands now more than ever? To understand that, we need to understand DRM.
entries.cn: 但最重要的是，所有权之所以重要，是因为它是一项投资。玩家相信电子游戏体验，因此把自己的生活投入其中。无论你是15岁、拿到你的第一份兼职收入，还是50岁、专门空出一个周末享受期待已久的新作，这款游戏未来会怎样都应该只由购买者决定。那么，为什么我们的游戏如今比以往任何时候都更容易从手中溜走？要理解这一点，就必须先理解DRM。

entries.en: I have fond memories of saving up for Ocarina of Time for months when I was a kid, buying it the day it was released, and sitting on a curb in a Toys R Us parking lot, poring over the manual while waiting for my dad to pick me up and bring me home, where I’d go on to spend countless hours exploring Hyrule. entries.en: Shanti Easton-Steel, production co-ordinator at Rockstar North, added: “This is a landmark moment for the Rockstar Game Workers Union, and hopefully for the industry as a whole. It’s thanks to the hard work of so many of our members — both those currently with us and those who were fired last October — that we are now in a strong enough position to pursue formal recognition. Whilst it’s painful that our dismissed colleagues are not here to share this milestone moment, the best way we can honour their contribution now is by succeeding in the fight they helped us to start, and making them proud to have been a part of it.
entries.cn: Shanti Easton-Steel，Rockstar North的制作协调员，补充道：「这是Rockstar游戏工人工会的一个里程碑时刻，但愿对整个行业也是如此。这要感谢我们许多成员的努力——包括目前在岗的成员和去年十月被解雇的同事们——正是他们的付出让我们今天有足够的底气去争取正式认可。虽然很痛心那些离开了的同事无法与我们共享这一里程碑时刻，但我们能为他们的贡献所做的最好回报，就是赢得这场由他们帮助发起的斗争，并让他们为曾参与其中而感到骄傲。」

entries.en: Kratos finds a new ally in Gaia, the mother of Titans and Earth. She provides Kratos with a way to rewrite the past and save his own life. After a trip to the Underworld, Kratos follows Gaia’s instructions, leading him to the Sisters of Fate. After more bloodshed, Kratos takes control of the Loom of Fate and returns to the scene of his death. Kratos’s plan to kill Zeus is thwarted when another Olympian steps in front of his blade. It’s here that we (and Kratos) learn about his true parentage. Kratos uses the power of the Loom to recruit the Titans of the past to his future war. Back in the present, Kratos leads the Titans in an assault on Mount Olympus, setting up God of War 3.
entries.cn: 奎托斯找到了新的盟友——大地之母、泰坦之母盖亚。她为奎托斯提供了一条改写过去、拯救自己生命的方法。在前往冥界之后，奎托斯遵循盖亚的指引，找到了命运三女神。经过更多杀戮，奎托斯控制了命运之梭，回到了自己死亡的那一刻。奎托斯杀死宙斯的计划被另一位奥林匹斯神挡在刀前而受阻。正是在这里，我们（和奎托斯）得知了他的真实身世。奎托斯利用命运之梭的力量，将过去的泰坦招募到未来的战争中。回到现在，奎托斯率领泰坦进攻奥林匹斯山，为《战神3》埋下伏笔。

entries.en: But that doesn’t mean it was doomed to fail. Who knows what might have been? The stratospheric rise of TLOU as a hot property following two blockbuster games and an acclaimed HBO show would, surely, have given it a curiosity advantage had it ever come out. And, if it had the juice, people would have stuck around: we might well be having a much different conversation about Naughty Dog right now had it persevered with it. I would be sitting here complaining about how TLOU Online’s success ruined Naughty Dog, because, while I can appreciate the appeal of a good online game from an academic perspective, I personally feel that the least desirable feature in any video game is the presence of other people.
entries.cn: 但这并不意味着它注定失败。谁知道结果会怎样？《最后生还者》凭借两款大作和一部备受赞誉的HBO剧集，成为炙手可热的IP，如果它真的推出，肯定会拥有好奇心优势。而且，如果它质量过硬，玩家会留下来：如果顽皮狗坚持做下去，我们现在对它的评价可能大不相同。我可能会坐在这里抱怨《最后生还者 Online》的成功毁掉了顽皮狗，因为，虽然我从学术角度能理解一款好在线游戏的吸引力，但我个人觉得，任何电子游戏中最不理想的功能就是其他人的存在。

entries.en: But even the flying Regalia Type-F was better than Final Fantasy 16 ’s bait-and-switch. Built for the PS5, the world of Valisthea may have technically been a series of interconnected zones rather than FF15's more genuine attempt at an open world, but its scope was finally approaching the scale depicted by those old-fashioned overworlds – a series of kingdoms with fields, forests, deserts, towns, and hideaways. And when engineer Mid Telamon tasks you with aiding her rebuild an airship in the story’s final act, it really does seem that Final Fantasy is about to revisit its glory days of airborne freedom. Alas, the quest goes absolutely nowhere near that direction. If anything, your options in FF16 are more limited than those of its predecessor – all you have here are your own legs or those of a Chocobo.
entries.cn: 不过，即便是能飞的雷加利亚Type-F，也比《最终幻想16》的挂羊头卖狗肉要强。为PS5量身打造的瓦利斯泽亚大陆，虽然严格来说只是一系列相连的区域，并非《最终幻想15》那种更接近真正开放世界的尝试，但其规模终于开始接近那些老式大地图所描绘的图景——一片由原野、森林、沙漠、城镇和庇护所组成的王国。当工程师Mid Telamon在故事最后一幕委托你帮她重建一艘飞空艇时，似乎《最终幻想》真的即将重拾它空中自由的光辉岁月。可惜的是，这个任务完全没往那个方向发展。甚至可以说，你在《最终幻想16》中的选择比前作还要有限——你能依赖的只有自己的双腿或者陆行鸟。

entries.en: "Take-Two did it before," Toto continued, referencing the $10 increase to $70 video games seen at the start of the PS5 and Xbox Series X/S era for the NBA 2K series that has now become an industry standard. "Why should it not become the trailblazer for the industry again? Jumping from $70 to $80 is a 14.3% price increase, which is quite a lot. It will very much depend on the game, but I can easily see some marquee titles going for this price, perhaps even this year, too."

entries.en: Imagine being a 10 year old who walks out of the Zelda movie, heads home, grabs their Nintendo Switch 2, and plays Ocarina of Time for the first time in their lives. It’s hard not to be envious of experiencing a moment like that. Also, consider this: it’s been almost three decades since the original game launched, and it seems pretty likely that a sizable number of people who played it back then now have children of their own. Hmm, if only there was a Zelda game about experiencing how the world changes from the perspective of a child and the perspective of an adult…
entries.cn: 想象一下，一个10岁的孩子走出《塞尔达》电影院，回到家，拿起Switch 2，人生中第一次玩《时之笛》。很难不羡慕能体验那样时刻的人。另外，再想想：原版游戏发售已经快三十年了，当年玩过它的人中，相当一部分现在很可能已经有了自己的孩子。嗯，要是有一款《塞尔达》游戏是关于从孩子和成年人的视角体验世界如何变化就好了……

entries.en: Meanwhile, the design approach that had birthed Uncharted 3’s cruise ship freed Infinite Warfare from the very concepts of up and down, left and right. Leaping from the spinning cockpit of your fighter jet, you might grapple with a Martian soldier in open space. Then find footing on the angular exterior hull of a battleship, tilting your view to 45 degrees. Before finally heading in through an airlock, where gravity as we know it is restored. entries.en: In the past, this would have been incredibly difficult to actually implement. You'd have to independently model and animate a cosmetic across every game you'd want to actually use it in. But with Unreal 6, because the systems are going to be the same across any game using the engine, it sounds like you'll just be able to drop items from one game into another and it'll just work. Of course, only time will tell whether or not that'll actually work out.
entries.cn: 若放在过去，真要落实这个想法会极其困难。你得针对每一个想使用的游戏，分别为同一件外观物品独立建模和制作动画。但有了虚幻引擎6，由于任何使用该引擎的游戏都共享相同的底层系统，听起来玩家可以直接把物品从一个游戏挪到另一个游戏，它就能直接生效。当然，实际效果是否真的如此，还得等时间来验证。

entries.en: "Almost nobody else has that. For everyone else, the maths is brutal in that raising your base to $80 just sheds the price-sensitive buyers you can't afford to lose in this economy. That's why I reckon most publishers will, correctly, stick to a $70 base with an $80-$100 premium edition layered on top, early access, a few cosmetic perks, and stuff. That model lets the FOMO-prone superfans pay more for early access while everyone else pays $70, or waits for the inevitable discount. You capture the whales without raising the floor on the people most likely to walk.
entries.cn: 「除此以外，几乎没人能做到。对其他所有人来说，这笔账很残酷：把基础版提到80美元，只会劝退那些在当前经济环境下你根本流失不起的价格敏感型买家。因此，我认为多数发行商会明智地选择继续把基础版定在70美元，再往上叠加80-100美元的豪华版，配点抢先体验、外观奖励之类的东西。这样一来，担心错过的铁粉可以多花钱提前玩到，其他人要么付70美元，要么等打折。既抓住了大R玩家，又没提高那些容易流失用户的门槛。」

entries.en: But Sony’s controversial decision to ditch physical discs for PlayStation games threatens to destroy this market. Time, and how the past and future intertwine, works in very weird ways in Norse mythology, in case you didn’t know. Loki is the father of the ancient World Serpent, Jörmungandr, for example. It's a topic Time Extension explored in a guest column in 2024. entries.en: Valve has repeatedly found itself in legal crosshairs in 2026. As the aforementioned antitrust lawsuit continues, in January a UK tribunal gave the green light to a £656 million ($901 million) collective action lawsuit targeting Valve over monopoly concerns. On top of this, New York Attorney General Letitia James in February and, in April, the Australian government issued Valve a legally enforceable transparency notice to have the company detail how its systems intend to prevent child grooming and radicalization on the Steam platform.
entries.cn: 2026年，Valve屡屡成为法律靶心。在上述反垄断诉讼进行的同时，今年1月，英国一家法庭批准了一项针对Valve的6.56亿英镑（约合人民币60亿元）集体诉讼，涉及垄断问题。除此之外，纽约州总检察长Letitia James在2月采取了行动，4月澳大利亚政府向Valve发出了具有法律效力的透明度通知，要求该公司详细说明其系统如何防止Steam平台上的儿童诱骗和极端化行为。

entries.en: The question is, will Sony reverse its decision? Will petitions like this one and all the online backlash have any impact at all? It seems unlikely. Sony’s share price enjoyed a bump following the announcement, which suggests the market is in favor of it (unsurprising, given it will in theory make the company more money). One analyst said fans of physical media had their chance and blew it, so there’s no going back. “If gamers and preservationists had bought more physical games, Sony wouldn’t have seen the digital sales ratios that justify this decision,” Robin Zhu, a games analyst at Bernstein, told the Financial Times .
entries.cn: 问题在于，索尼会撤回决定吗？这样的请愿和网上反弹会产生任何影响吗？看起来不太可能。公告发布后，索尼股价有所上涨，这表明市场支持这项决定（考虑到它理论上会让公司赚更多钱，这并不意外）。一位分析师表示，实体媒介粉丝曾有机会，但他们错过了，因此已经没有回头路，Bernstein游戏分析师Robin Zhu对《金融时报》表示：「如果玩家和保存主义者购买了更多实体游戏，索尼就不会看到足以支撑这项决定的数字销售比例。数字游戏销售基本上带来100%的增量利润率……而实体包装、运输和零售商利润可能超过标价的20%。」

entries.en: I expected to hear a lot about combat and action and we did, but we also heard a lot about the heart of this story and what The Last Ronin means to Turtles fans who grew up with TMNT and now can look back on their lives and see that things have changed, and they're more complicated, and they live in a different world, and they want the next generation to be able to enjoy the things that we all enjoyed when we were younger. So when they came in and they're like, "It's about the seasons of life and how we all love this thing and how it changes as we grow older but we still love it, but it's not the same," that hit different for me because okay, these guys not only understand the action component very well and obviously have those chops, but they understand this story and the work that Kevin Eastman [co-creator of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles] and Tom Waltz, the Escorza Brothers and Peter Laird and everyone else who contributed to The Last Ronin, they will honor the source material with an adaptation that really gets into the heart of the characters and the themes.
entries.cn: 我本以为会听到很多关于战斗和动作的内容，确实听到了，但我们也听到了很多关于这个故事的核心，以及《最后的浪人》对那些从小看《忍者神龟》长大的粉丝意味着什么——他们现在回顾自己的生活，发现一切都变了，变得更复杂了，他们生活在一个不同的世界，他们希望下一代也能享受我们年轻时喜欢的东西。所以当他们过来说：「这是关于人生的季节，关于我们如何热爱这个东西，以及它如何随着我们长大而改变，但我们仍然爱它，只是它不一样了，」这让我感触很深，因为好吧，这些人不仅非常了解动作部分，显然也有那个功底，而且他们理解这个故事，理解凯文·伊斯特曼（《忍者神龟》联合创作者）、汤姆·沃尔兹、埃斯科尔萨兄弟、彼得·莱尔德以及其他所有为《最后的浪人》做出贡献的人的作品，他们会通过一部真正深入角色和主题核心的改编作品来尊重原作。

entries.en: "The next barrier we faced when we were bringing them back for these characters for these roles was their voice, right? We probably couldn't replicate their voices with AI if we went for it, but we're a studio that has really valued acting, not just movie acting but also drama acting. And we're really careful about the voice actors we chose in the past as well. So, we wanted to focus on getting a real person to put their own spin on that character. We didn't want to have them just do an imitation of that character, we wanted them to try to bring out that character's personality, but with a different voice. So, we did our best to pick an actor that would fit the role and fit that character, and some of these people might be related to them or have some sort of relationship to them."
entries.cn: 「我们在让这些角色回归时面临的下一个障碍就是他们的声音，对吧？我们或许可以用AI复制他们的声音，但我们是一家非常重视表演的工作室，不仅是电影表演，还有戏剧表演。过去我们在选择声优方面也非常谨慎。因此，我们专注于找一位真人演员来对这个角色进行自己的演绎。我们不希望他们只是模仿那个角色，我们希望他们尝试带出角色的个性，但使用不同的声音。所以，我们尽力挑选适合这个角色和人物的演员，有些人可能与角色有关联或某种关系。」

entries.en: Season 3 of AMC’s series formerly known as Anne Rice's Interview With the Vampire has raced along like Lestat’s tour bus on nitrous. “Montreal,” the penultimate episode of this season, is an emotional roller coaster ride. For “Loustat” shippers, this episode gifts viewers with Lestat de Lioncourt (Sam Reid) and Louis de Pointe du Lac (Jacob Anderson) being on the same page, sharing emotional intimacy like we’ve never seen before. On the flip-side, the witch Merrick Mayfair (Sarah Afful) summons Claudia (Delainey Hayles) back to this earthly plain to metaphorically rip everyone’s hearts out in a devastating sequence that ranks as one of the show’s best.
entries.cn: AMC这部曾名为《安妮·莱斯的吸血鬼访谈》的剧集第三季，节奏快得像莱斯特那辆充入一氧化二氮的巡演巴士。本季倒数第二集《蒙特利尔》是一场情绪过山车。对「Loustat」粉丝而言，本集让莱斯特·德·里昂科特（山姆·里德饰）与路易·德·庞特·杜拉克（雅各布·安德森饰）终于心意相通，分享了前所未有的情感亲密。另一方面，女巫梅里克·梅费尔（莎拉·阿富尔饰）召唤克劳迪娅（德莱尼·海尔斯饰）回到人世，在一段令人心碎的戏中从隐喻意义上撕裂所有人的心，这也成为本剧最出色的桥段之一。

entries.en: The reasoning behind both the acquisition and departure of these studios is fairly clear. For a long time, under previous CEO Phil Spencer, the prevailing Xbox strategy was to fuel Game Pass with the widest possible variety of irresistible games. During this push to make Xbox a subscription company, even something as marvellously esoteric as Obsidian’s Pentiment had its place - signalling that Game Pass was home to both bombastic shooters and monkish murder investigations.

entries.en: It’s impossible to point out the slowdown in sales of first-party Sony games without also talking about the many games it has canceled in recent years. Sony’s well-documented live-service game push resulted in mega hit Helldivers 2, but The Last of Us Online was canceled, Concord and its developer, Firewalk, was shut down, and a God of War live-service game from Bluepoint didn’t even make it to announcement before it fell by the wayside. Then there’s the canceled Twisted Metal live-service game, and canceled games at Sony Bend. Haven Studios' Fairgames is still officially in the works, but may have been renamed . All those canceled games have certainly left a hole in Sony’s release schedule.
entries.cn: 在指出索尼第一方游戏销量放缓的同时，不能不提近年来它取消的众多游戏。索尼大张旗鼓的服务型游戏推进计划催生了爆款《绝地潜兵2》，但《最后生还者 Online》被取消，《星鸣特攻》及其开发商Firewalk被关闭，Bluepoint的一款《战神》服务型游戏甚至还没公布就夭折了。此外还有被取消的《烈火战车》服务型游戏，以及索尼Bend工作室被取消的项目。Haven Studios的《Fairgame$》官方仍在开发中，但可能已经改名。所有这些被取消的游戏无疑在索尼的发售日程上留下了一个大窟窿。

entries.en: As detailed by Stop Killing Games, the bill AB-1921 would require game companies to provide 60 days' notice before shutting down support for server-dependent games and then either offer a method for owners to play affected games afterwards or provide refunds. entries.cn: 根据「停止扼杀游戏」运动的详细说明，AB-1921法案将要求游戏公司在关闭依赖服务器的游戏支持之前提前60天通知，随后要么为拥有者提供继续游玩受影响游戏的方法，要么提供退款。前者可通过社区服务器或某种形式的离线访问实现。

entries.en: The deal Gattis is referring to is the one that allowed IO Interactive the power to self-publish 007 First Light, similar to Hitman 3. entries.en: The anonymous employee tells me they would have liked to have made single-player combat more dynamic. In parts of Ryse, when you venture into Britain to crush the rebellion of Queen Boudica, you advance in testudo formation, raising your shield alongside your fellow soldiers to form an impregnable barrier. In the final game, gameplay is limited to shielding yourself from enemy fire and returning fire of your own – all with the press of a button. “Our original plan was that you’d be able to leave and reenter this formation at will,” they say, “fighting enemies on your own and then returning to position when you feel like doing so.”
entries.cn: 那名匿名员工告诉我，他们原本希望让单人战斗更具变化。《崛起》的部分流程中，玩家前往不列颠镇压布狄卡女王的叛乱，会以龟甲阵推进，与战友一同举盾组成坚不可摧的屏障。最终版本的玩法仅限于按键举盾抵挡敌方火力，再进行还击。他说：「我们原本计划让玩家随时离开或重新加入阵形，独自与敌人作战，并在想要归队时回到位置。」

entries.en: So that's another element that changes the dynamic of combat depending on how much rage you have. At one end of the spectrum, you don't have enough rage to jumpstart your heart and so you're vulnerable. You need to be strategic, you need to be defensive, you need to focus on survival and rage build-up. And then at the opposite end of the spectrum, you need to be super aggressive. You need to focus on doing damage as quick as you can and focusing on the targets that you can kill quickly.
entries.cn: 这是另一个根据愤怒值多少改变战斗动态的元素。在一种极端情况下，你没有足够的愤怒值来重启心脏，因此很脆弱。你需要讲究策略，注重防御，专注于生存和积攒愤怒值。而在另一个极端，你需要超级激进，专注于尽快造成伤害，并瞄准能快速击杀的目标。

entries.en: In an interview with YouTuber KiwiTalkz , former Rockstar Games producer John Ricchio explained that starting with consoles and going to PC is actually easier. entries.en: So, what does the future of Xbox exclusive games look like? For the most die-hard fans – and maybe even Microsoft itself – it's hard to say, for now. In June, Booty said the company will choose which titles get the exclusive treatment on a "case-by-case basis." Today, he's being a tad more direct, promising that, while "large live-service titles" will be multiplatform going forward, players shouldn't expect all single-player titles to be Xbox exclusive.

entries.en: Over what is sure to be a painful and fearful year for Xbox employees, 3,200 people are set to leave the company. 1,600 have already lost their jobs, and four studios have been shown the door. Double Fine and Compulsion will return to independent status; Ninja Theory and Undead Labs have found new homes. A fifth studio, Arkane Lyon, is likely to be handed off to a new owner too. The alternative, too grim to contemplate, is that Lyon will go the same way as its Austin counterpart, cut down like the Sycamore Gap tree .
entries.cn: 对XBOX员工而言，这注定是痛苦恐惧的一年：3200人将离开公司，其中1600人已经失业，四家工作室被扫地出门。Double Fine和Compulsion将恢复独立，Ninja Theory与Undead Labs找到了新东家；第五家Arkane Lyon也可能被移交给新所有者。另一个令人不敢设想的结果，是Lyon重蹈Austin的覆辙，被微软直接关停。

entries.en: Following the game's success, Activision recruited Schofield to co-found Sledgehammer Games with his Visceral Games colleague, Michael Condrey. The two worked on a third-person Call of Duty game set in Vietnam for six months before eventually being asked to help co-develop Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3 after Infinity Ward imploded in 2010. Despite being very new to the franchise as a creative, Sledgehammer Games helped Infinity Ward deliver a highly successful trilogy capper that also solidified Sledgehammer as one of the core Call of Duty teams.

entries.en: IGN's Matt Purslow was able to check it out recently - in particular, its prologue - and wrote in his hands-off preview that "It feels like Rebel Wolves has created a prologue that effectively establishes a dark medieval world and lays the initial tracks for Coen’s interesting dual-lane journey in which you must master both the man and the vampire. It’s knowing what comes after all this, though – the depth of its day/night “narrative sandbox” and the multitude of opportunities for both sides of Coen that I was shown previously – that places The Blood of Dawnwalker among the small handful of games that I’m impatiently waiting for this year."
entries.cn: IGN的Matt Purslow最近有机会体验了本作——尤其是其序章——并在他的非上手预览中写道：「我觉得Rebel Wolves打造了一个非常出色的序章，它成功建立起了一个黑暗的中世纪世界观，同时也为科恩（Coen）那条颇具吸引力的双重旅程奠定了基础——玩家必须同时掌握作为人类的他，以及作为吸血鬼的他。不过，真正让我对《黎明行者之血》充满期待的，是在这之后的内容：我此前看到的昼夜交替‘叙事沙盒’系统，以及围绕科恩人类与吸血鬼两种身份所展开的大量可能性。正因如此，《黎明行者之血》已经成为今年我最迫不及待想玩的少数几款游戏之一。」

entries.en: At the end of the showcase, Tim Sweeney described the gaming industry as in a state of "both crisis and opportunity," because while more people are playing games than ever before, big-budget AAA games are having a harder time making a profit. It's a tale we hear over and over again, but the Epic CEO spelled it out yet again: "we're often seeing hundreds of millions in dev costs, followed by tens of millions in revenue, and dev costs are continuing to grow."
entries.cn: 在发布会结尾，Tim Sweeney称游戏行业处于「危机与机遇并存」的状态，因为虽然玩游戏的人比以往任何时候都多，但预算庞大的3A大作却越来越难盈利。这是我们反复听到的故事，但这位Epic的CEO又一次说明了这一点：「我们经常看到数亿美元的开发成本，却只换来数千万美元的收入，而且开发成本还在持续增长。」

entries.en: "We've seen your feedback since launch, and we're reading all of it," a Ubisoft community spokesperson said in a to the DLC backlash last week. "Thank you for caring this much about Black Flag Resynced. We want to be clear on one point: the standard edition is the full, complete experience. Every mission, every island, the full story and the complete world are all there, with nothing held back. The additional packs are entirely optional extras for players who want them, never a requirement to enjoy or complete the game. We'll keep listening as you play!"

entries.en: The underwater adventure has sold a mammoth 4 million copies since its early access launch on May 14, achieving more than 467,000 peak concurrent players on Steam. But its development was turbulent, with Krafton firing Gill and co-founders Charlie Cleveland and Max McGuire in the summer of last year. entries.en: Speaking of dreaming, I personally would love nothing more than to finally see what Persona 6 looks like. 2026 will mark 10 years since the last mainline entry in the beloved RPG series, and I need it back in my life. entries.en: Santa Monica Studio’s new project isn’t a prequel, as rumored, and actually starts the moment that Faye’s body is burnt on the funeral pyre at the beginning of 2018’s God of War. This transports her to a land called the Everywhen, the afterlife of the gods. It’s definitely not the Elysium fields of Valhalla, but a nightmarish otherworld with killer flowers and masked skeletons, where creatures are being rounded up in cages. There are bonfires of corpses and an ominous gateway hanging in the sky. It's far from a friendly place, as Santa Monica Studio’s Head of Creative, Cory Barlog, is more than happy to divulge.
entries.cn: 圣莫尼卡工作室的新作并非传闻中的前传，而是从2018年《战神》开头劳菲的遗体在火葬柴堆上焚烧的那一刻开始。这将她传送到了一个名为「万古（Everywhen）」的地方——众神的来世。这绝不是英灵殿的极乐世界，而是一个噩梦般的异界，有致命的鲜花和戴着面具的骷髅，生物被关在笼子里。到处是尸体的篝火，天空中悬挂着一扇不祥的大门。这里远非友善之地，圣莫尼卡工作室创意总监Cory Barlog非常乐意透露这一点。

entries.en: While a remake is the perfect solution to that long wait between sequels, there’s also something else to consider. The Legend of Zelda is about to have a gigantic big screen moment on April 30, 2027 – just a few months after the Ocarina of Time remake is set to be released. A live-action Zelda movie hitting theaters will introduce a whole new audience to this series for the first time. Having a stunning new remake of the most iconic Zelda game on store shelves and at the top of the Nintendo Switch 2’s eShop in time for the movie’s premiere makes perfect sense. After all, it’s happened before: Super Mario Galaxy 1 and 2 got Nintendo Switch remasters six months before The Super Mario Galaxy Movie premiered. Kids saw the Mario movie, wanted a Mario game to play, and Nintendo made sure they had something ready, even if it was something many of us played ages ago.

entries.en: "For Kratos, magic is a tool he wears on his belt. With Faye, magic is a part of her," says Barlog. He explains that her powers are more like Freya's, and tied to the natural world. "There's that moment in the reveal where she gets the sword and then she pops the soul out of that character, and you get that great slow-mo to see that there is a power even beyond what was shown before that she has. And it is only going to grow and evolve inside of this world. It's that idea that in the realms that we've explored, in Greece and in the Norse realms, magic is part of the air. It exists all around us. Its density is a certain amount in these realms. And when we get to the Everywhen, the density of magic is amplified by like a thousand."
entries.cn: 「对奎托斯来说，魔法是他系在腰带上的工具。对劳菲来说，魔法是她的一部分，」Barlog说。他解释说，她的力量更像芙蕾雅，与自然世界相连。「在演示中，有一个时刻她拿到剑，然后她把那个角色的灵魂抽出来，你看到那个精彩的慢动作，发现她拥有甚至超越之前展示的力量。而且这种力量只会在这个世界中成长和进化。这就是我们在希腊和北欧领域探索过的理念：魔法是空气的一部分，存在于我们周围。在这些领域中，魔法密度是固定的。而当我们到达万古时，魔法密度被放大了大约一千倍。」

entries.en: What impact does an all-digital future have on certain genres of games? An uncertain one, at best. No one is denying the seismic shift in consumer preference, or how digital game sales do indeed eclipse physical sales, broadly. However, as noted in a 2025 analysis from The Game Business , there are certain genres of games that still sell well on disc. At least across the UK, single-player, story-driven games and family games have regularly seen much stronger physical sales than typical. That is, almost half of Hogwart’s Legacy, Assassin’s Creed Mirage, and Resident Evil 4 Remake sales were physical. In the case of Spider-Man 2 and Astro Bot, the figure was reportedly over half. How long will publishers continue to invest in the sorts of single-player games many people still crave if it becomes apparent the audience isn’t fully migrating?
entries.cn: 全数字未来会对某些游戏类型造成什么影响？最多也只能说是不确定。没人否认消费者偏好的巨大转变，也没人否认整体上数字游戏销量确实超过了实体销量。不过，正如The Game Business在2025年的一篇分析所指出的，某些类型的游戏仍然在实体盘上卖得不错。至少在英国，单人叙事游戏和家庭游戏的实体销量经常明显强于一般水平。也就是说，《霍格沃茨之遗》《刺客信条：幻景》和《生化危机4 重制版》几乎有一半销量来自实体版。据报道，《漫威蜘蛛侠2》和《宇宙机器人》的这一比例还超过了一半。如果事实证明受众并没有完全迁移，发行商还会继续投资许多人仍然渴望的那类单人游戏多久？

entries.en: “We are operating at margins that are 3-10x lower than comparable platform and publishing businesses,” Sharma said in a blog post announcing the layoffs. “We entered Gen 9 with a smaller install base and a higher cost structure. To grow, we bet on Game Pass, multi-platform, and a broader portfolio of content. While those businesses have created meaningful value, they did not grow at the pace we expected. As that happened, our core business weakened, and we added more teams, more investment, and more time, hoping for a better outcome. And now the industry is facing the most severe hardware crisis in its history. We must reset Xbox.”
entries.cn: Sharma在宣布裁员的Blog中说：「我们的利润率比可比的平台和发行企业低3到10倍。进入第9世代时，我们的装机基础更小，成本结构更高。为了增长，我们押注Game Pass、多平台和更广泛的内容组合。虽然这些业务创造了有意义的价值，但它们没有按我们预期的速度增长。随着这种情况发生，我们的核心业务变弱，而我们增加了更多团队、更多投资和更多时间，希望取得更好的结果。现在，行业正面临史上最严重的硬件危机。我们必须重置XBOX。」

entries.en: Last year saw the launch of sci-fi RPG The Outer Worlds 2 . Developed by Obsidian Entertainment , it followed in the footsteps of its predecessor, which in turn followed in the footsteps of Obsidian’s own Fallout: New Vegas – a satirical role-playing game with lots of interesting choices, fantastic writing, memorable companions, and wild weaponry. Unfortunately, The Outer Worlds 2 failed to meet Xbox’s sales goals , and so it will be the final game in the series. The Outer Worlds is over as a running series, although Obsidian Entertainment as a studio thankfully remains in operation.

entries.en: Sharma was asked gamers still care enough to pay for an expensive console. "I think it's expensive if we do not innovate," she replied. "I came to help that problem. Look, it is natural that prices go up. Every generation around us is raising prices. But I don't think you can raise prices through the hardware crisis that we're seeing. And so it will require fundamental change in terms of how we innovate and how we think about the business models and how we go bring this to market, and we're working on that."
entries.cn: 当被问及玩家是否还愿意为昂贵的主机买单时，Sharma回答：「我认为如果我们不创新，那才是真的贵。我来就是为了解决这个问题。你看，价格上涨是自然的。我们周围的每一代产品都在涨价。但我认为你不能在当前的硬件危机中涨价。因此，这需要在创新方式、商业模式思考以及如何推向市场方面进行根本性变革，我们正在为此努力。」

entries.en: We’re now staring down the barrel of a future where the PS6 doesn’t come with a disc drive . Separate reports are indicating that Xbox may also be moving away from physical media, and that the next-generation Project Helix device will also not feature a disc drive. It’s a philosophy that will likely sideline anyone with a curated collection of physical games, or even a hybrid library that’s part disc, part digital. So it’s a rake in the face for backwards compatibility, and an entirely unappealing future for vintage gamers – the support of whom laid the bedrock for the business today.
entries.cn: 我们现在正直面一个PS6不配备光驱的未来。另有报道显示，XBOX也可能正在远离实体媒介，下一代Project Helix设备同样不会配备光驱。这种理念很可能会把那些精心收藏实体游戏的人，甚至是实体盘和数字版混合收藏的人，全部推到边缘。所以，这等于给向后兼容迎面来了一耙，也给复古玩家描绘了一个毫无吸引力的未来，而正是这些玩家的支持为今天的业务奠定了基础。

entries.en: So the lack of easy access to the 3DS is one reason why now is the perfect time for an Ocarina remake. But there’s another, equally frustrating one: the massive gap between Zelda games. There was a six-year gap between the release of Breath of the Wild and Tears of the Kingdom, despite the fact that Tears used so many of BotW’s assets, systems, and locations. This gigantic sandbox take on the Zelda formula is clearly the blueprint going forward, which means – like most big video game sequels these days – a five or six year wait between sequels seems likely for the foreseeable future. That’s a pretty untenable stretch of time for a franchise to go without any notable game releases, which is why since Breath of the Wild launched in 2017 we’ve seen smaller Zelda games like Cadence of Hyrule , the Link’s Awakening remake , and Echoes of Wisdom launch, keeping Zelda fans occupied during those long waits. If waiting six or more years between big open world Zelda games is the new normal now, that means we’re at least three years away from the next mainline Zelda. An Ocarina of Time remake is the perfect thing to help hold us over, and much easier to make, too. After all, the entire blueprint for it has existed for almost 30 years.
entries.cn: 因此，3DS不易获取是现在重制《时之笛》的完美时机的原因之一。但还有另一个同样令人沮丧的原因：《塞尔达》系列作品之间的巨大空窗期。《旷野之息》和《王国之泪》之间相隔了六年，尽管《王国之泪》使用了大量《旷野之息》的素材、系统和地点。这种巨大的沙盒式《塞尔达》玩法显然是未来的蓝图，这意味着——就像如今大多数大型游戏续作一样——在可预见的未来，续作之间很可能要等上五六年。对于一个系列来说，这么长时间没有值得注意的游戏发售是相当难以为继的，这就是为什么自2017年《旷野之息》推出以来，我们看到了像《节奏海拉鲁》、《织梦岛》和《智慧的再现》这样的小型《塞尔达》游戏，让粉丝们在漫长的等待中有所寄托。如果大型开放世界《塞尔达》游戏之间等待六年或更长时间成为新常态，那就意味着我们距离下一部主线《塞尔达》至少还有三年。《时之笛》重制版是帮助我们度过这段时期的完美选择，而且制作起来也容易得多。毕竟，它的整个蓝图已经存在了近30年。

entries.en: "We refuse to be left in the dark as the company decides to restructure in a way that seriously affects us all," said ZeniMax Online Studios senior encounter designer Morgan Goin. "We're being treated as expendable, valued one week, and cut the next. Why would a game developer bother to put forward their best work under these conditions? Hard work and great games do not save you from layoffs under Microsoft. That's why we're coming together across Xbox to make our voices heard and to demand real accountability."
entries.cn: 「我们拒绝在公司决定进行严重影响所有人的重组时被蒙在鼓里，」ZeniMax Online Studios高级遭遇设计师Morgan Goin说，「我们被视作可消耗品，一周被重视，下一周被砍。在这种条件下，游戏开发者为什么要费心交出最好的作品？在微软手下，努力工作和优秀游戏也不能让你免于裁员。这就是为什么我们联合起来，在整个XBOX发出我们的声音，要求真正的问责。」

entries.en: There is a kind of magic to physical ownership - the feeling of unwrapping a game for the first time on Christmas, flicking through the manual inside, discovering bonus goodies like a map or art cards. Many of those aspects have been eroded away by time and the push for cheaper production, but there’s one thing we’ve not lost quite yet: choice. You might keep that game for 10 years, or give it to a friend to play within 10 days; what happens to that game is up to you .
entries.cn: 实体所有权有一种魔力：圣诞节第一次拆开游戏包装，翻阅盒内说明书，发现地图或艺术卡等赠品。随着时间流逝和生产成本不断压低，许多体验已经被侵蚀，但我们尚未失去一件事：选择。你可以把游戏保留10年，也可以在10天内交给朋友游玩；它之后会怎样，由你决定。

entries.en: “It's interesting, Star Trek has had so many permutations over the years,” Kittelsen said. “It can kind of genre bend. It's the rare sci-fi show that can do a Sherlock Holmes Victorian era mystery as well as interplanetary warfare on an epic scale. And everything in between. Bloober has an incredible track record in the horror space… Silent Hill 2 remake, Cronos: The New Dawn I thought was really well done and showed them pushing into sci-fi horror. I think we consider Star Trek: Shadow Frontier more of a psychological thriller than a horror game, sort of akin to Hellblade in a lot of ways.”
entries.cn: 「有趣的是，《星际迷航》多年来经历了如此多的演变，」Kittelsen说，「它几乎可以混合各种类型。这是一部罕见的科幻剧集，既能演绎福尔摩斯式的维多利亚时代谜案，也能展现宏大的星际战争，以及介于两者之间的一切。Bloober在恐怖领域有着令人难以置信的履历……《寂静岭2 重制版》、《时间旅者：重生曙光》，我认为都做得相当出色，展现了他们向科幻恐怖领域大胆进军。我认为我们将《星际迷航：暗影边境》更多地视为一部心理惊悚游戏，而非恐怖游戏，在很多方面类似于《地狱之刃》。」

entries.en: One area where the sequels would not diverge from the original Ryse was aesthetics. Son of Rome was not historically accurate, but it did aim for a certain emotional or psychological accuracy. As Gornstein puts it, they did not try to present Rome as it was, but as how it might have appeared to someone “who lived in a village somewhere, five hours away. To someone who visited the city for the first and only time in their life, everything must have seemed completely overwhelming.”
entries.cn: 续作不会偏离初代《崛起》的一个方面是美学。《罗马之子》在历史上并不准确，但力求实现某种情感或心理层面的真实。Gornstein表示，他们并非试图呈现罗马实际的样子，而是呈现它在某类人眼中的模样：那人「住在五小时路程外的某个村庄，一生第一次也是唯一一次来到这座城市时，一切必定都显得无比震撼」。

entries.en: Shawn Kittelsen: If you are a fan of Star Trek or Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles or SpongeBob or any of the franchises that live at Paramount, then this is a sea change in how Paramount approaches games, where previously games were strictly something that was licensed out and Paramount didn't have an investment in. Now Paramount is treating games as a content pillar alongside film and TV, and we're investing in games and we're publishing games. We're taking a stronger hand in the quality and creative control of those games. So we are elevating games in a big way. And that means if you've been a fan of these franchises and you're like, where are the triple-A TMNT games? Where's the love for Avatar: The Last Airbender? We're going to bring those games that you've been waiting for to the platforms that you play on.
entries.cn: Shawn Kittelsen：如果你是《星际迷航》《忍者神龟》《海绵宝宝》或派拉蒙旗下任何IP的粉丝，那么派拉蒙对待游戏的方式将发生巨变。以前游戏严格来说是授权出去的，派拉蒙没有投资。现在派拉蒙将游戏视为与电影和电视并列的内容支柱，我们正在投资游戏并发行游戏。我们在游戏质量和创意控制上掌握了更强的主导权。所以我们正在大力提升游戏的地位。这意味着，如果你一直是这些IP的粉丝，并且心想：AAA级《忍者神龟》游戏在哪？《降世神通》的爱在哪里？我们将把你们期待已久的游戏带到你们玩的平台上。

entries.en: As any long-term fan of the series will know, the structure of Final Fantasy has significantly changed over the past quarter-century. The first nine games, spanning from the pixel art of the NES through to the 3D landscapes of the PlayStation era, all featured an overworld; a big map you explore to discover new locations. These maps were not true-scale in size and were significantly less detailed than the towns and dungeons you accessed from them, but they nonetheless provided the stage for a sprawling, epic adventure. In many ways, these overworlds were one of the seeds from which today’s open world games grew.
entries.cn: 所有系列老粉丝都知道，在过去四分之一个世纪里，《最终幻想》的结构发生了重大变化。从红白机上的像素艺术到PlayStation时代的3D场景，前九部作品都拥有一张大地图；那是一张供你探索、发现新地点的大型地图。这些地图并非真实比例，细节也远不如你从中进入的城镇和迷宫，但它们依旧为一场广阔的史诗冒险提供了舞台。从许多方面来说，这些大地图正是如今开放世界游戏的种子之一。

entries.en: Developer Double Fine Productions is known for many creative and quirky games, including last year’s brilliant lighthouse adventure Keeper , 360-era metal cult classic Brutal Legend , and remasters of beloved point-and-click games Full Throttle and Grim Fandango . These are the games that have made the studio one of my personal favourites. However, perhaps its most iconic output is Psychonauts – a duology (with a couple of spin-offs) that started waaay back in 2005 on the original Xbox and finally continued in 2021 with the long-awaited sequel . Unfortunately, the future of Psychonauts and all of Double Fine’s games – including the recently released multiplayer game Kiln – is reportedly on the line, as it is one of three Xbox studios believed to be facing closure .
entries.cn: 开发商Double Fine Productions以诸多充满创意与古怪的游戏闻名，包括去年精彩的灯塔冒险《Keeper》、360时代的金属经典《Brutal Legend》，以及备受喜爱的点击解谜游戏《Full Throttle》和《Grim Fandango》的重制版。这些作品让该工作室成为我个人最喜欢的开发者之一。不过，也许它最具标志性的作品是《意航员》——一个二部曲系列（附带一些衍生作品），最早可追溯到2005年的初代Xbox，并在2021年终于推出了期待已久的续作。不幸的是，据报道，《意航员》以及Double Fine的所有游戏——包括最近推出的多人游戏《Kiln》——都前途未卜，因为它是三家据称面临关闭的Xbox工作室之一。

entries.en: Yesterday, Microsoft confirmed that Halo: Campaign Evolved, a campaign-only remake of the original Halo game, will finally release in late July . entries.en: Sweeney : The biggest opportunity is for games to connect their economies. Not every game wants to connect every part of it; in some cases it's logical and in some cases it’s not. But if you look broadly across games, there's an awful lot of stuff that could be shared in common. Every game with human [characters] could share emotes, and a lot of games with similar art styles could share characters such that from a player's point of view, it would be a whole lot more valuable if everything we bought that is cosmetic in nature worked across all of the different games that we owned.
entries.cn: Sweeney说道：「最大的机遇在于让游戏之间互通经济。并不是每款游戏都想把所有部分都互通；在某些情况下合乎逻辑，在某些情况下则不然。但如果放眼所有游戏，有大量内容可以共享。凡是包含人类角色的游戏都可以共享表情动作，而许多美术风格相似的游戏可以共享角色。这样一来，从玩家角度看，如果我们购买的所有装饰性物品都能在拥有的不同游戏中使用，其价值会大得多。」

entries.en: The Grand Tour will return with a six-episode series, which will visit a variety of locations, from the Angolan desert, to Malaysia, and also California. Hosting duties will be handled by Thomas Holland and James Engelsman – an existing duo from successful motoring YouTube channel Throttle House – and social media personality Francis Bourgeois. Holland is a motoring journalist who launched Throttle House in 2015, and was joined on the channel by Engelsman a few years later. Francis Bourgeois (whose real name is Luke Nicolson) is a qualified mechanical engineer who briefly worked at Rolls-Royce before leaving to pursue his popular social media profile based on his trainspotting hobby. Former host Jeremy Clarkson made an appearance on The Grand Tour’s social channels in February in a brief skit to reveal the new hosts.

entries.en: But while Remedy’s struggles paint Control Resonant as the most vulnerable of all September’s releases, almost none of these games are guaranteed slam dunks. Marvel’s Wolverine will likely enjoy the smoothest ride – the next chapter in Insomniac’s Marvel series, it’s already looking incredibly good, and is the exact sort of thing a great deal of PlayStation owners are locked in for. While Logan isn’t quite as popular as Peter Parker, and so probably not destined to beat Spider-Man 2’s record of the fastest-selling PlayStation Studios game in a 24-hour period , it’s nonetheless almost guaranteed to shift copies faster than a fastball special. But it’s worth remembering those reports of concern over Spider-Man 2’s spiralling budget – if Insomniac didn’t get that under control for Wolverine, it may need to sell many millions to break even. Not an ideal situation when there will be folks holding onto their cash as they wait for GTA 6.
entries.cn: 尽管Remedy的困境让《控制：共振》成为9月所有发售游戏中最脆弱的一款，但几乎没有任何一款游戏是稳赢的。《漫威金刚狼》可能会是最顺利的——作为Insomniac漫威系列的下一章，它看起来已经非常出色，正是大量PlayStation玩家锁定的类型。虽然罗根不像彼得·帕克那么受欢迎，因此可能无法打破《漫威蜘蛛侠2》创下的PlayStation Studios游戏24小时内最快销售纪录，但它几乎肯定能比快球特快卖得更快。但值得记住的是，那些关于《漫威蜘蛛侠2》预算失控的担忧报道——如果Insomniac在《漫威金刚狼》上没有控制住预算，它可能需要卖出数百万份才能收支平衡。在人们为了等《GTA6》而捂紧钱包的情况下，这可不是理想局面。

entries.en: There is no chance that a series like Fallout could be kickstarted at Xbox today. Yes, CEO Asha Sharma is evidently interested in continuing the blockbuster franchise that Fallout has become; a recent Bloomberg report suggested that Obsidian’s upcoming sequel to Avowed had been cancelled in favour of another Fallout . But whatever Xbox’s next Fallout might have been - the oddity in the corner that thrives without oversight and unexpectedly becomes beloved - will have died on July 6, when Sharma announced “the most significant restructure in Xbox history”.
entries.cn: 如今的XBOX不可能再启动一个像《辐射》这样的新系列。首席执行官Asha Sharma显然希望延续如今已成巨作的《辐射》；彭博社近期报道称，黑曜石即将推出的《宣誓》续作已被取消，以便转做另一款《辐射》。但XBOX原本可能诞生的下一个《辐射》——那个在监管之外蓬勃生长、意外赢得喜爱的角落怪作——可能已在7月6日死去。那天Sharma宣布了「XBOX史上最重大的重组」。

entries.en: "The over-reliance on microtransactions is overemphasizing certain genres and stopping others from flourishing," Darrah noted. "Everything can't be a live-service, which is something I hope we've proven pretty definitively over the past year and a half, and if monetization is coming predominantly from live-services, we run the risk of living in a world where there are no AAA games that aren't live-services. entries.en: Kratos, nearing the end of his servitude to the gods, is given one final task by Athena: defeat Ares and save the city of Athens from his siege. With the promise of forgiveness for his past atrocites as his reward, Kratos sets out to obtain Pandora’s Box and kill Ares. The task takes him to hell and back, with Kratos ultimately facing off against the God of War. Victorious yet no less troubled by his past, Kratos jump off the bluff as we saw in the game’s opening. Athena pulls him from the water and offers him a throne on Olympus, completing his 10-year ascension to becoming the God of War.
entries.cn: 奎托斯即将结束对众神的效忠，雅典娜交给他最后一个任务：击败阿瑞斯，拯救被围困的雅典城。以赦免他过去的暴行作为奖励，奎托斯出发寻找潘多拉魔盒并杀死阿瑞斯。这项任务让他历经地狱般的磨难，最终与战神正面对决。尽管获胜，但奎托斯仍被过去所困扰，他跳下悬崖，正如游戏开场所示。雅典娜将他从水中救起，并赐予他奥林匹斯神座，完成了长达十年的晋升，成为新的战神。

entries.en: There’s a misconception amongst players that once you’ve bought a digital game, you own it. You don’t. DRM, or Digital Rights Management, is the process of being granted a ‘license’ whenever we purchase content through digital storefronts like the PlayStation Store or Steam. What you have bought is effectively a long-term loan from the publisher & store to the player. As a result, it can be taken away from you at any time.
entries.cn: 玩家普遍存在一个误解：购买数字游戏后，你就拥有了它。事实并非如此。DRM——即数字版权管理，意味着我们通过PlayStation Store或Steam等数字商店购买内容时，获得的是一份「许可」。你实际买到的，是发行商和商店向玩家提供的长期借用权，因此它随时可能被收回。

entries.en: What does it mean for games with limited lifespans due to licensed characters, cars, or music? It means no discovery after the fact. Right now a kid entering the gaming community today can use second-hand marketplaces to wind back the clock and experience games that are no longer available digitally. Weren’t born when the first Forza Horizon game came out, but adore Forza Horizon 6? Well, you can’t download most of them anymore, but there are still discs out there in the wild for you to collect and keep. The same goes for all kinds of delisted gems, from Driver: San Francisco to Driveclub, or old Bond and Spider-Man games. How does this work a decade into an all-digital future? It doesn’t.

entries.en: What exactly we’ll be doing with these titanium torsos and steel skulls remains much of a mystery. It seems to me as if it’s an evolution of The Last Guardian’s companion concept, just with one huge difference: this time, the oversized companion itself will be controllable, as well as the human protagonist. Perhaps Ueda has taken on feedback from players that this is a desirable option that has never been the case in any of his games to date.
entries.cn: 至于玩家究竟会如何与这些钛合金身躯和钢铁头颅互动，目前仍是个谜。不过，在观看了《gen Atlas》夏日游戏节预告片的加长版内容后——其中展示了更多实机画面——我已经有了一些推测。在我看来，这款游戏似乎是在《最后的守护者》伙伴系统基础上的一次进化，但有一个巨大的不同之处：这一次，那位体型庞大的伙伴本身似乎也可以被玩家直接操控，而不仅仅是人类主角。或许，上田文人吸收了玩家多年来的反馈。毕竟在他过去的作品中，玩家从未真正能够控制这些巨大的伙伴生物，而这恰恰是许多人一直希望实现的玩法。

As a result, it seems like almost the entire end-of-year slate of releases has been forced into a single month. GTA 6 has turned September into a video game battle royale, and it’s potentially going to be a bigger blood bath than anything we saw in the Wolverine trailer .
entries.cn: 多年来我们一直知道整个游戏行业都会对《侠盗猎车手6（GTA6）》敬而远之，但本周的State of Play证实了Rockstar的巨兽就像某种劫车版的摩西，劈开了游戏发行的红海，将竞争浪潮推向两边。结果，几乎整个年底的发售档期都被迫挤进了一个月里。《GTA6》把9月变成了一场游戏大逃杀，而且可能比我们在《漫威金刚狼》预告片里看到的任何场面都更血腥。

entries.en: “We are working very hard to rethink everything that we can about Helix, which is a console we are committed to shipping," he said. “We are very cognizant of the ways in which we need the change as a company to make sure it is affordable, to make sure that it’s flexible. entries.en: It started with new Xbox CEO Asha Sharma’s “reset” memo, which most took as a signal that Microsoft planned big layoffs and studio closures. Microsoft published the memo just days after Xbox Games Showcase — which had gone down well with core Xbox fans — was held. In it Sharma revealed that Microsoft's gaming business has a 3% accountability margin (assumed to mean profit margin), which is down year-on-year. "Excluding Activision Blizzard King, over the past five years, we have spent over $20 billion on ongoing investments in our content, platform, and hardware subsidy, but our annual revenue has declined nearly half a billion during that time. Going forward, this cannot continue," Sharma said.
entries.cn: 事情始于新任Xbox CEO Asha Sharma那份「重置」备忘录，大多数人将其解读为微软计划进行大规模裁员和关闭工作室的信号。微软在Xbox游戏展示会（这次展示会在核心Xbox粉丝中反响不错）举行仅仅几天后，就发布了这份备忘录。Sharma在备忘录中透露，微软游戏业务的问责利润率（推测指净利润率）为3%，同比下降。「除去动视暴雪King，过去五年我们在内容、平台和硬件补贴上的持续投资已超过200亿美元（约合人民币1352亿元），但同期我们的年收入却下降了近5亿美元（约合人民币34亿元）。这种情况不能继续下去了。」Sharma说道。

entries.en: What does it mean for game preservation? Nothing good. Archivists, historians, and museums have been fighting a frustrating battle with the games industry for years, and removing physical games from PlayStation’s future is not going to help in the slightest. Certainly not when trade groups like the US Entertainment Software Association are so demonstrably against the concept of game preservation that it actively maintains the process of restoring old games is illegal “hacking”, and lobbies against academic institutions being permitted to take measures to preserve old games and keep them playable for future generations.
entries.cn: 这对游戏保存意味着什么？没有任何好事。档案工作者、历史学者和博物馆多年来一直在和游戏行业打一场令人沮丧的仗，而把实体游戏从PlayStation的未来中移除，丝毫不会帮上忙。尤其是当美国娱乐软件协会这样的行业组织如此明显地反对游戏保存概念，甚至积极坚持认为修复旧游戏是非法的「黑客行为」，并游说阻止学术机构采取措施保存旧游戏、让未来世代仍能游玩时，更是如此。

entries.en: This has, I think, contributed massively to the perception that the PS5 has no games. Which patently isn’t true: aside from the fact that gaming generally is enjoying one of its most bountiful release calendars since the gluttonous days of the Xbox 360 era, Sony’s other first party studios have massively stepped up to fill the big Uncharted-shaped hole in PS5’s lineup. Insomniac alone will have delivered Miles Morales, Spider-Man 2, Ratchet and Clank: A Rift Apart and Wolverine before we even know what PS6 looks like. We’ll have had two mainline God of Wars from Santa Monica Studio, Team Asobi has deftly established Astro Bot in the pantheon of great console mascots: there’s so much great work being done. I could go on listing things, but after a long time where it felt as though the PS5 was spinning its wheels, even the most hardened cynic can’t deny that the 10th gen has now, finally, picked up some momentum. Well, they can, but not with any credibility.
entries.cn: 我认为，这在很大程度上加剧了「PS5没游戏」的印象。但这显然不是事实：且不说整个游戏行业正享受着自Xbox 360时代「饕餮之年」以来最丰富的发售日历之一，索尼的其他第一方工作室也纷纷挺身而出，填补了PS5阵容中《神秘海域》留下的巨大空缺。光是Insomniac，就将在我们见到PS6长什么样之前，推出《漫威蜘蛛侠：迈尔斯·莫拉莱斯》《漫威蜘蛛侠2》《瑞奇与叮当 时空跳转》和《漫威金刚狼》。圣莫妮卡工作室将带来两部正统《战神》作品，Team Asobi巧妙地将《宇宙机器人》塑造成了伟大主机吉祥物之一：优秀作品层出不穷。我还可以继续列举，但在PS5长期原地踏步之后，即使是最顽固的愤世嫉俗者也无法否认，第十世代终于开始加速了。好吧，他们可以否认，但毫无可信度。

entries.en: I cannot begin to explain how deflated 12 year-old me was when I finally took command of the Fahrenheit. I had fixated over the PS1 era’s airships, particularly the militarised space Ferrari that was Final Fantasy 8’s Ragnarok. For me, getting the airship had become the definitive Final Fantasy moment, a gaming experience unlike any other. And in Final Fantasy 10 – the first game I had obsessively followed the development of across multiple issues of Official PlayStation Magazine, dreaming of all the things a next-gen FF could be – this moment had been reduced to a UI element that could teleport me between save points. It may be a looker, with its gilded halo and pearlescant hue, but the Fahrenheit has been a constant reminder of how great progress demands great sacrifice.
entries.cn: 我简直不知该如何形容12岁的我，在指挥飞空艇「Fahrenheit」时有多泄气。整个PS1时代，我都对飞空艇着迷不已，特别是《最终幻想8》里那架军用太空法拉利——诸神黄昏号（Ragnarok）。对我来说，获得飞空艇已成为《最终幻想》的标志性时刻，一种无与伦比的游戏体验。而在《最终幻想10》中这一刻竟被简化成了一个可在存档点之间传送我的UI元素。Fahrenheit或许很漂亮，有镀金光环和珠光色泽，但它一直在提醒我，伟大的进步需要巨大的牺牲。

entries.en: Sweeney : The whole space is moving so fast. We recognized early on that Epic should just broadly enable everybody to use the tools they prefer and be able to plug them into Unreal Engine in any way they want. We didn't go out to build like the Unreal Engine coding model, rather, we built an MCP server so that people could bring Claude code, Gemini, or whatever tool they prefer and connect it. Every week or two, there are going to be new capabilities coming out with lots of different companies competing, and we want to be able to support them all and put each game developer in charge of how they want to integrate AI tools into their pipelines to get maximum usefulness out of it and figure out what really gets acceleration maximized.
entries.cn: Sweeney：「整个领域发展太快了。我们早就认识到，Epic应该广泛地让每个人使用自己喜欢的工具，并以他们想要的任何方式接入Unreal Engine。我们没有去构建Unreal Engine的编程模型，而是构建了一个MCP服务器，让人们可以接入Claude代码、Gemini或任何他们偏好的工具，并连接起来。每一两周，各大公司竞争会带来新的能力，我们希望能支持所有这些，让每个游戏开发者自己决定如何将AI工具整合到流水线中，以获取最大效用，并找出真正能实现最大加速的东西。」

entries.en: Afterwards, Minkoff and Kurosaki pulled off the 2019 reboot of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare – a coup that many have credited with the rejuvenation of the series during the pandemic. Warzone made most of the headlines, but the campaign continued the exceptional character work Infinite Warfare’s directors had established, rejecting bombast in favour of intimacy and tension. Of particular note was the story of Farah and her brother Hadir – beginning in traumatic childhood as you snuck around during a home invasion, evading a Russian soldier and stabbing at him with a screwdriver. “You survive,” says her dying father, squeezing his last breaths from faltering lungs. “Whatever it takes, never back down.”
entries.cn: 此后，Minkoff和Kurosaki完成了2019年的《使命召唤：现代战争》重启。许多人认为这次成功让系列在疫情期间重新焕发生机。《战区》占据了大多数头条，但战役延续了《无限战争》导演们确立的出色角色塑造，拒绝浮夸，转向亲密感和紧张感。尤其值得注意的是Farah和她哥哥Hadir的故事：它从创伤性的童年开始，你在一次入室袭击中潜行，躲避一名俄罗斯士兵，并用螺丝刀刺向他。「活下去，」她垂死的父亲用逐渐衰弱的肺挤出最后的气息说，「不惜一切，永不退缩。」

entries.en: The video game industry’s knotty entanglement with DRM has been ongoing for years, but it really ramped up in the 2010s, with publishers claiming the key purpose was to prevent piracy. Infamous incidents involving SimCity and Diablo 3 in the early 2010s, where ‘always-online’ DRM became a mandatory requirement for the first time, saw server malfunctions locking players out of their games entirely , whilst other times saw players log into games only to find their cloud-based saves had seemingly vanished into thin air. DRM games are like a penny on an invisible string - you pick something up that you think you’ll always have, only to have it suddenly snatched out of your hands with little choice but to accept what’s happened.
entries.cn: 游戏行业与DRM的复杂纠葛已持续多年，并在2010年代明显加剧，发行商声称其主要目的是防止盗版。2010年代初，《模拟城市》和《暗黑破坏神3》等「臭名昭著」的游戏首次把「全程联网」DRM设为强制要求；服务器故障会让玩家完全无法进入游戏，另一些时候，玩家登录后却发现云存档仿佛凭空消失。DRM游戏就像系在隐形细线上的硬币：你捡起一个以为永远属于自己的东西，它却会突然被从手中拽走，而你几乎只能接受现实。

Fallout 3, for example, is set in the Capital Wasteland, a post-apocalyptic version of the city of Washington and the surrounding areas. Fallout: New Vegas is set in the Mojave Wasteland, which includes post-apocalyptic Las Vegas. Fallout 4 is set in the Commonwealth, which takes in the surrounding area of Boston, Massachusetts. And Fallout 76 is set in Appalachia, although updates have expanded its borders.
entries.cn: 今年二月，Robertson-Dworet 曾表示，第三季前往一个全新地点的决定是受到了《辐射》游戏的启发，因为每代游戏的故事通常都发生在一个不同的地点。比如《辐射3》的舞台是首都废土，即后末日版的华盛顿特区及其周边；《辐射：新维加斯》的背景是莫哈维废土，包含后末日版拉斯维加斯；《辐射4》的故事发生在联邦，涵盖马萨诸塞州波士顿附近的区域；而《辐射76》则设置在阿帕拉契亚，尽管后续更新扩大了其边界。

entries.en: And, again, like we've heard in the past, the answer is apparently in microtransactions. According to Sweeney, "the economy is shifting from buying games to buying things in games" and "whether you're a fan of this or not, the arithmetic of it is undeniable." In his eye, this is a boon for huge games with established communities, but it's just another bar to clear for new games hoping to stay alive for more than a few months.
entries.cn: 而答案——和过去听到的一样——显然在于微交易。Sweeney表示，「经济正从购买游戏转向购买游戏里的物品」，并且「无论你是否喜欢这一点，这种算术都无可否认」。在他看来，这对那些拥有稳定社区的大型游戏来说是好事，但对于渴望存活超过几个月的新游戏来说，这不过是另一道门槛。

entries.en: And, it would be remiss to talk about Naughty Dog shedding talent without mentioning Amy Hennig, creative director of the original Uncharted trilogy, who left under reportedly tense circumstances back in 2014, later citing burnout among other factors. entries.en: Mike Daly: The way that works is, you've got your health bar, once it gets drained out, if you've got enough rage left, then Logan's down but he's not out. entries.en: There is just something about mascot characters and kart racers that makes them fit together like two peas in a pod. Ever since the first Mario Kart game was released on the Super Nintendo, it’s been a genre that continues to delight fans, even in the wild times we find ourselves in. Now, the lizard and bat combo of Yooka-Laylee is hopping into the driver's seat of Super Yooka-Laylee Kart, revealed during this year's Summer Game Fest, and IGN had a chance to get some time on the track with this upcoming racer from some of the same devs that worked on the much-loved Diddy Kong Racing!
entries.cn: 吉祥物角色和卡丁车竞速似乎天生绝配。自从第一款《马力欧卡丁车》登陆超级任天堂以来，这个类型一直为粉丝带来欢乐，即便在今天这个疯狂的时代也不例外。现在，Yooka-Laylee这对蜥蜴和蝙蝠组合跃入《Super Yooka-Laylee Kart》的驾驶座，在今年的夏日游戏节上首次亮相，IGN有幸在这款新作中试跑了几圈，开发团队中不乏曾参与备受热爱《迪迪刚赛车》的老将。

entries.en: Rumors abound that Microsoft is set to continue its support for older games with the announcement of a disc-to-digital-license transferal program. A report earlier this month suggested that Project Helix, the next-generation Xbox, will not feature a disc drive . No further details were provided, but the news follows the bombshell dropped by PlayStation that it will no longer be producing or supporting physical game discs starting in January 2028 . This suggests that the PlayStation 6 won't come with a disc drive, and that Sony is planning to embrace an all-digital future .
entries.cn: 还有大量传言称，微软将公布一项把实体光盘转换为数字许可的计划，继续支持旧游戏。本月早些时候的一份报道指出，下一代XBOX Project Helix不会配备光驱。报道未提供更多细节，但就在此前，PlayStation刚刚投下一颗重磅炸弹：从2028年1月起停止生产和支持实体游戏光盘。这意味着PS6可能不会配备光驱，而索尼正计划全面拥抱数字未来。

entries.en: Sharma's ground-shaking memo revealed that Microsoft's gaming business currently has a 3% accountability margin (assumed to mean profit margin), which is down year-on-year. "Excluding Activision Blizzard King, over the past five years, we have spent over $20 billion on ongoing investments in our content, platform, and hardware subsidy, but our annual revenue has declined nearly half a billion during that time. Going forward, this cannot continue," Sharma said.

entries.en: Blade isn't the only Xbox game under threat of cancelation. after reports overnight suggested both are under threat of closure as part of impending layoffs at Xbox. Psychonauts developer Double Fine, South of Midnight developer Compulsion, and Hellblade developer Ninja Theory are also said to be in talks with Microsoft over potentially buying themselves out. entries.en: CNBC reported on estimates from Dataintelo , which valued the global second-hand video game market at $7.2 billion last year, and predicted it would grow to $13.8 billion by 2034. entries.en: "In the current economic environment, a $80 price tag is earned, not given," van Dreunen said. It also widens the gap between S-tier game makers like Take-Two, Nintendo, and EA, and everyone else. I expect that especially those publishers like Ubisoft that are already feeling the burn will have a harder time in the coming period."
entries.cn: van Dreunen表示：「在当前经济环境下，80美元的定价是靠实力赢得的，不是凭空得来的。只有那些能在文化上引领风潮的成熟系列，才配得上标准版卖这个价。这也进一步拉大了Take-Two、任天堂、EA等顶级游戏厂商与其他所有公司的差距。我认为，尤其是像育碧这样已经压力重重的发行商，未来一段日子会更难过。」

entries.en: Every technology generation, whether it's seven or ten years – changes accumulate so much that the way people build games and play games changes. The answer can't be that every generation we just spend exponentially more on game development because the market doesn't always support that. And I think we've seen some very specific problems with specific games. Sometimes a really big budget game ships that wasn't very good and didn't sell. But much more often as we've seen with a bunch of the big multiplayer games – it could be a good game – the market dynamics prevented players from coming in simultaneously with enough scale to make it viable.
entries.cn: 每一代技术，不管是七年还是十年，累积的变化都大到足以改变人们开发游戏和玩游戏的方式。但答案不能是每进入一代，我们就在游戏开发上投入指数级增长的资金，因为市场并不总是支撑得住。我觉得我们已经看到一些特定游戏出现了很具体的问题。有时一部超大预算的作品推出后质量不佳，销量也不好。但更常见的情况，正如我们在许多大型多人游戏中所见——游戏本身或许不错——但市场动态导致玩家无法在同一时间以足够大的规模涌入，使其无法立足。

entries.en: Wassmer : I think it's two things – one, the efficiency of development. Games are getting bigger, games are getting more difficult [to make]. So, all the architectural work we're doing on the engine should just smooth things out. Not to mention AI creation flows. We showed some demos, and it really should take a lot of the tedium out of game creation and let people just actually focus on the creative part, which should be really nice. Then, the really cool thing, I think we're kind of inventing a new type of economy here, hopefully with the interconnected and interoperable assets between games, which I don’t think has ever been done. I haven't seen it done at scale, at least anyway.
entries.cn: Wassmer：我认为主要两点——其一，开发效率。游戏越来越庞大，制作也越来越难。所以我们在引擎架构上所做的所有工作，就是要理顺这些流程。更别提AI创作流程了。我们展示了一些演示，它确实能大幅消除游戏创作中的繁琐工作，让人们真正专注于创意部分，这应该会很棒。然后，真正酷的是，我们或许正在这里发明一种全新的经济形态，希望实现游戏间资产的互联互通与互操作，我觉得这前所未有。至少我从未见过如此大规模的应用。

entries.en: “We think of Steam Machine as an extension of PC gaming, not as a console,” Valve explained. “The traditional console model is to sell hardware at a loss and make up the revenue with subscription services or by selling games that are locked-in to the hardware. We think this can make sense for a single business in the short term but that open ecosystems are better for customers over the long term. PC gaming's history proves this: The openness of the PC gaming space has enabled it to be the primary driver of hardware and software innovation for decades.
entries.cn: 「我们将Steam Machine视为PC游戏的延伸，而不是一台主机。」Valve解释说，「传统主机模式是亏本卖硬件，再通过订阅服务或销售硬件独占的游戏来弥补收入。我们认为，这对单个企业在短期内可能行得通，但对消费者而言，长期来看开放生态更有利。PC游戏的发展史证明了这一点：数十年来，PC游戏领域的开放性使其成为硬件和软件创新的主要驱动力。」

entries.en: The other factor here is that, over the years, Naughty Dog’s top brass have been whittled down, constituting a huge brain drain. In 2023, former Head of Technology Christian Gyrling left for Meta: he oversaw the firm’s technology pipelines, the ones that made it such a powerhouse for showing off the capabilities of Sony’s hardware. Evan Wells retired at around the same time: he’d been co-president of the firm through its most successful eras and before that, one of its top game designers. Bruce Straley, co-director of Uncharted 2, 4, and The Last of Us, who would almost certainly be Neil Druckmann’s right-hand man on Intergalactic had he not left to start his own studio in 2017.
entries.cn: 另一个因素是，多年来顽皮狗的高层不断流失，造成了巨大的人才流失。2023年，前技术主管Christian Gyrling离职去了Meta：他曾负责公司的技术管线，正是这些管线让顽皮狗成为展示索尼硬件能力的强大引擎。Evan Wells大约在同一时间退休：他在公司最成功的时期担任联合总裁，在此之前是顶级游戏设计师之一。Bruce Straley是《神秘海域2》《神秘海域4》和《最后生还者》的联合总监，如果他2017年没有离开去创办自己的工作室，几乎肯定会成为Neil Druckmann在《星际：异端先知》项目上的得力助手。

entries.en: But as gaming technology advanced, the worlds of Final Fantasy did finally begin to resemble the overworlds of its past. The power of the PlayStation 4 unlocked Final Fantasy 15 ’s Eos, an open world of rolling verdant hills that seemingly stretched on without end. But protagonist Noctis navigated through it in a brand new way: via car, along pre-determined roads. If you wanted to trek off the beaten path, you’d need to hoof it on-foot or hop on a Chocobo (at least until a free update added an off-road version of the Regalia car, six months later.) Noctics’ wheels could be upgraded to fly, but this was a post-game bonus, rather than a transformative moment in the main story.
entries.cn: 但随着游戏技术的进步，《最终幻想》的世界终于开始重现昔日的大地图风貌。PS4的强大性能打开了《最终幻想15》的伊欧斯——一个青翠山丘绵延起伏、仿佛无边无际的开放世界。但主角诺克提斯以一种全新的方式穿行其中：驾驶汽车，沿预设的道路行驶。如果你想驶离大路，就得徒步跋涉或者骑上陆行鸟。诺克提斯的座驾可以升级为飞行模式，但这仅是通关后的奖励，而非主线故事中一个改变格局的时刻。

entries.en: Sony discontinued the ability to make movie and TV purchases and rentals on the PlayStation Store back in August 2021. entries.en: It may be that those who don't have Rebel Wolves’ head start on the action may re-consider their position, certainly after the likes of Summer Game Fest and the Xbox Showcase add even more dates to the pile. entries.en: Being an early pre-alpha build, the core systems are in place - the driving, the zanny items, and courses - but actually playing Yooka-Laylee felt a bit rough. Driving around, even without the use of boosts, felt slippery, where I would often find myself sliding oddly into walls, frequently feeling that turning was cranked up to 11 and being far too extreme in movement. The current build lacked a mini-map or any signage to help tip you off as to what was coming up. I would find it difficult to notice what was quickly approaching, forcing me to react more violently than I normally would. Thankfully, the representative from Playtonic who was there mentioned that both the mini-map and signage were in the works, and that fine-tuning controls is a normal part of polish, so I’m not too worried when it arrives in retail, but I am keeping an eye on it.
entries.cn: 作为早期pre-alpha版本，核心系统已就位——驾驶、古怪道具和赛道——但实际游玩Yooka-Laylee时手感稍显生涩。即便不用加速，开起来也感觉滑溜，我经常莫名其妙地滑向墙壁，打方向盘好像被拧到了最灵敏，动作幅度过大。目前的版本缺少小地图或指示牌，无法提前预警前方的弯道或障碍。我很难察觉快速逼近的路况，导致反应比平时更激烈。好在Playtonic的代表告诉我，小地图和指示牌都在制作中，而操控微调本身就是打磨环节的一部分，所以成品发售时我并不太担心，但仍会保持关注。

entries.en: So why is PlayStation doing this? It has claimed it’s merely following consumer trends. Unfortunately, this isn’t entirely incorrect. The physical video game market has been in a marked decline – in May 2016, consumer spend was just below $6 billion; as of May this year, it’s barely passed $1.5 billion (although it’s worth noting that was a 3% growth, the first year-on-year growth since 2009). In PlayStation’s case specifically, the shift becomes more pronounced – in 2016, 27 of every 100 PlayStation games were purchased digitally; as of this year, it is now 78 out of 100. Hardware leakers have also reported the PS6’s manufacturing costs are pushing close to $1000, and with PlayStation boss Hideaki Nishino stating that it’s “not realistic” for Sony to front these pricey component increases, streamlining the PS6 as a singular digital-only console would assist in lowering prices.
entries.cn: 那么PlayStation为什么这样做？它声称只是在顺应消费趋势。遗憾的是，它说的很可能是对的。实体游戏市场明显衰退：2016年5月消费者支出略低于60亿美元(约合人民币407亿元)，截至今年5月仅勉强超过15亿美元(约合人民币102亿元)，尽管值得注意的是，这仍同比增长3%，也是自2009年以来首次同比增长。对PlayStation而言，变化更明显：2016年每100款PlayStation游戏中有27款以数字形式购买，今年则已增至78款。硬件爆料者还称PS6制造成本逼近1000美元；PlayStation负责人西野秀明表示，让索尼承担昂贵零部件涨价「并不现实」，因此把PS6精简为单一的纯数字主机有助于降低售价。

entries.en: There are other shifts, too – The Witcher 3’s Songs of the Past expansion was originally planned to launch this year, but was pushed into 2027 “to achieve the best possible result.” While that may refer to development polish, there’s no denying that Geralt’s one last hurrah will enjoy more attention if it stays outside of GTA 6’s gravity well. And as this week continues, with Summer Games Fest, the Xbox Games Showcase, and others announcing new dates, we’ll likely see this space around GTA become increasingly defined. Few will brave arriving within weeks of the biggest game of all time. Some will try to get ahead of it, others will find safety in 2027. And as September fills up, I wouldn’t be surprised if we get a scattering of last minute dashes as developers and publishers realise that the ninth month of 2026 wasn’t quite the safe haven they thought it would be.
entries.cn: 还有其他调整——《巫师3》的《旧时曲》资料片据爆料称原计划今年发售，但被推迟到2027年「以达到最佳效果」。虽然这可能指的是开发打磨，但不可否认，如果杰洛特的最后一舞远离《GTA6》的引力井，它将获得更多关注。随着本周夏日游戏节、Xbox游戏展示会等活动陆续公布新日期，我们很可能会看到《GTA》周围的这片空间变得越来越清晰。很少有人敢在史上最大游戏发售前几周内冒险。有些人会试图抢在前面，另一些人则会在2027年找到安全区。而随着9月越来越满，如果开发商和发行商意识到2026年的第九个月并不像他们想象的那样是安全港，从而出现一些最后一刻的仓促撤退，我也不会感到惊讶。

entries.en: There's a unique sense of intrigue that surrounds every new Fumito Ueda project. Familiar, yet exciting. A promise of a connection between character and player that few others can forge. But the Ico , Shadow of the Colossus , and The Last Guardian creator is moving away from his fantasy worlds with Gen Atlas , shifting to a land of sci-fi where giant robots lie strewn across its shores, waiting to be awoken. That quiet image of towering metal creatures served as the spark for this new project.
entries.cn: 每当Fumito Ueda公布新作时，总会带来一种独特的期待感：既熟悉，又令人兴奋。那种角色与玩家之间的情感连接，是少有开发者能够做到的。但这位《ICO》《汪达与巨像》和《最后的守护者》的缔造者，正在通过《gen Atlas》离开他的奇幻世界，转向一片科幻之地——在这个全新世界里，巨大的机器人残骸散落在海岸线上，静静等待被唤醒。而正是这幅由高耸钢铁巨兽构成的静谧景象，成为了这部新作诞生的最初灵感。

entries.en: In Infinite Warfare, that was the UNSA Retribution – a warship that your protagonist, Nick Reyes, first storms onto in a state of heightened (if manfully contained) anguish. The ship’s captain has steered the Retribution into the path of an enemy supercarrier in a desperate attempt to buy Earth’s defenders time – killing and injuring many of his own crew in the process. As the survivors rush to put out the flames, Reyes seeks to confront the captain, and remind him that a commander’s job is to bring those under his command safely home. But as it transpires, the captain is dead; Reyes is promoted to take his place, and finds himself standing among the personal effects of a man he’ll never get to hold to account, nor demand an explanation from.
entries.cn: 在《无限战争》中，这个枢纽是UNSA Retribution号，一艘战舰。你的主角Nick Reyes第一次冲上这艘舰时，正处在高涨但强行压抑的痛苦之中。舰长为了给地球防御力量争取时间，孤注一掷地驾驶Retribution号撞向敌方超级航母，而这一决定也导致大量船员死伤。当幸存者们忙着扑灭火焰时，雷耶斯试图去质问舰长，提醒他指挥官的职责是把部下平安带回家。然而，当他赶到时，却发现舰长已经身亡。雷耶斯随即被提拔接替其职位，只能独自站在那位舰长留下的私人遗物之间——一个他再也无法追究责任、也永远得不到解释的人。

entries.en: Moscovitch says they fast-forwarded so deep into book canon because they built the architecture of this season around Louis’ 2025 surge of grief for Claudia. “We were talking about it as early as Prague,” she says of their story-breaking while they were shooting there in Season 2. “[Showrunner] Rolin [Jones] brought the idea of the Merrick seance into the room from the get-go. We moved it around in [this] season but it felt climactic, these last moments with the actual ghost Claudia after having imposed or imprinted her on Regina. We knew we’d arrive at it late and it would close this chapter of grief for Louis (and Lestat).”
entries.cn: Moscovitch表示，他们之所以如此深入原著设定，是因为本季的整体架构围绕路易在2025年因克劳迪娅而再次涌起的悲痛展开。「早在布拉格时我们就讨论过这件事，」她说。当时剧组正在那里拍摄第二季，并进行故事拆解。「（剧集运作人）罗林·琼斯从一开始就把梅里克招魂仪式的想法带进了编剧室。我们在本季调整了它的位置，但它感觉像高潮——克劳迪娅真正的鬼魂出现的最后时刻，此前我们已经把她强行施加或烙印在Regina身上。我们知道这段戏会在后期出现，并为路易（以及莱斯特）的悲痛篇章画上句号。」

entries.en: This is Howard's first comment on Reddit in six months. The last was to simply say "Dear Reddit, please never change," in a thread about someone who modded Todd Howard into Fallout 4 . Before that, Howard posted on Reddit three years ago to thank fans for their "passion and excitement" for Starfield. And, before that, Howard posted five years ago as part of a Reddit Ask Me Anything celebrating Skyrim’s 10th anniversary . In that AMA, Howard said he hadn't posted on the internet in 15 years.
entries.cn: 这是陶德六个月来首次在Reddit发表评论。上一次，他只是在一个有人把陶德·霍华德做成《辐射4》Mod的帖子下写道：「亲爱的Reddit，请永远不要改变。」再往前，陶德曾在三年前发帖，感谢粉丝对《星空》的「热情与期待」；五年前，他还参加过一场庆祝《上古卷轴5：天际》10周年的Reddit问答活动。在那次问答中，陶德称自己已有15年没有在网上发帖。

entries.en: Yesterday, Deltarune Chapter 5 was finally released to much anticipation. Within hours of its launch, the release helped the game shatter its previous concurrent player record on Steam. Previously, the record was 133,920 concurrent players, now the record sits at 290,973 concurrent players, more than double the original all-time peak. Despite Deltarune being nearly a decade old, it seems like it has only grown in popularity over time.
entries.cn: 昨天，备受期待的《三角符文》第5章终于上线。发售数小时内，它便帮助游戏打破了Steam同时在线玩家纪录——此前纪录为133,920人，如今已来到290,973人，比原先的最高峰翻了一倍多。尽管《三角符文》推出已近十年，人气似乎只增不减。

entries.en: The development team was made up of nine people, all of whom are now seeking work. The team spent seven years working on the game, which entered development in 2019. IGN first previewed the game back in 2023 and expressed plenty of optimism for the overall vision that Kwalee Labs had for Luna Abyss. That optimism trickled into another preview of the game earlier this year , ahead of the game's release, where we praised the game for its difficulty and slick gameplay.

entries.en: It’s an imperfect example, since not even owning The Crew on disc helps in this particular instance. Despite having full support for single-player progress, it’s an online-only game, and the discs are now worthless. It was, nonetheless, an effective glimpse at a future where games can be yanked away, leaving consumers conned out of their cash.

entries.en: My demo scene found Bigby with a detective named Faye investigating the apartment of their prime suspect. Faye finds a note on a strange stone table in the middle of the apartment -- a note with Bigby's name on it. She immediately questions Bigby, wondering if he's involved. This prompts a dialogue choice -- they're a staple of Telltale games and they will absolutely play a prominent role in the sequel. I chose to deny any nefarious intentions, which she was naturally skeptical of.
entries.cn: 我的演示场景中，Bigby与一名叫Faye的侦探一起调查他们主要嫌疑人的公寓。Faye在公寓中央一张奇怪的石桌上发现了一张纸条——上面写着Bigby的名字。她立刻质问Bigby，怀疑他是否与此有关。这触发了对话选择——这是Telltale游戏的标志性元素，在续作中绝对会扮演重要角色。我选择了否认任何邪恶意图，她自然表示怀疑。

entries.en: Besides looking sweet, with blood splattering across the screen, performing these attacks with your own forces around to see looks to have a far more important effect - boosting morale. Morale among your troops (ranging from Inspired / Confident / Concerned / Wavering / Broken) will allow your men to fight better while inspired. On the flip side, should their wills ever be broken, it may cause them to flee in terror, causing a rout and losing you the battle. Your enemies have their own morale too, and breaking them will cause a similar outcome, allowing you the choice to spare or run down the escaping forces.
entries.cn: 除了视觉效果酷炫、鲜血飞溅屏幕之外，在己方部队面前执行这些攻击还有一个更重要的效果——提升士气。部队的士气状态（分为振奋/自信/担忧/动摇/崩溃）会影响战斗力：士气高昂时士兵作战更勇猛；反之，一旦意志崩溃，他们可能会惊恐逃散，导致溃败并输掉战斗。敌人也有自己的士气，击垮他们同样会引发溃逃，届时你可以选择放过或追击溃军。

entries.en: The recently announced Senua marks the continuation of the Hellblade series in all but name. This gritty tale of a psychosis-suffering celtic warrior has been running since 2017, and is developer Ninja Theory ’s most enduring series, despite poor performance in terms of copies sold and failing to crack Game Pass’ top 10 during its second game's launch window . Yet despite having only just revealed Senua, Ninja Theory is now one of the three Xbox studios facing closure . Reports suggest that Senua was announced because Xbox believed “the promise of a newly announced game would help draw investor interest in the studio.” It’s currently unclear if an investor will buy Ninja Theory, and thus allow development on Senua to continue. As it stands, we may never see the game completed and released.
entries.cn: 最近公布的《塞娜》标志着《地狱之刃》系列的延续，只不过换了名字。这个关于一名饱受精神病折磨的凯尔特战士的沉重故事自2017年一直延续至今，是开发商Ninja Theory最持久的系列，尽管销售数量不佳，且在第二款游戏发售窗口期间未能进入Game Pass前十。然而，尽管刚刚揭晓《塞娜》，Ninja Theory如今已是面临关闭的三家Xbox工作室之一。有报道称，之所以公布《塞娜》，是因为Xbox认为「新游戏的承诺有助于吸引投资者对该工作室的兴趣」。目前尚不清楚是否有投资者会收购Ninja Theory，从而让《塞娜》的开发得以继续。就目前情况而言，我们也许永远看不到这款游戏完成并面世了。

entries.en: Amid the reports, fans expressed confusion at how Microsoft could announce Senua from Ninja Theory and then just days later tell the studio’s staff it planned to shut the company down. According to Game File , Microsoft allegedly planned to close or spin off Ninja Theory when it revealed Senua, and it did so thinking that “the promise of a newly announced game would help draw investor interest in the studio.” Game File’s Stephen Totilo suggests Ninja Theory management may not have even been aware of Microsoft’s plan.
entries.cn: 在这些报道中，粉丝们表示困惑：微软怎么能在公布Ninja Theory的《塞娜》后，仅仅几天就告诉工作室员工公司计划关闭这间工作室？据Game File报道，微软据称在公布《塞娜》时，就已计划关闭或剥离Ninja Theory，并认为「一款新公布游戏的承诺将有助于吸引投资者对该工作室的兴趣」。Game File的Stephen Totilo表示，Ninja Theory管理层甚至可能并不知晓微软的计划。

entries.en: Cole Phelps and Don Draper do share similar stories, but are portrayed completely differently. Both men are World War II veterans trying desperately to run away from their failures overseas to avoid being consumed by guilt. They also both cheat on their wives, leading to the implosion of their families. Draper and Phelps are also consumed by their jobs and each career win inflates their ego, creating an unstainable arc. Their stories ultimately take different paths in the end, but it would've been interesting to see Hamm play Phelps or the game's second protagonist, Jack Kelso, as McMahon suggested.
entries.cn: 科尔·菲尔普斯与Don Draper的故事确实有相似之处，但呈现方式完全不同。两人都是二战老兵，都在拼命逃离海外经历的失败，以免被愧疚吞噬。他们也都背叛过妻子，导致家庭分崩离析。Draper和菲尔普斯还都被工作吞没，每一次事业上的胜利都会膨胀自我，形成难以持续的人生轨迹。最终，他们的故事走向不同结局，但如果Hamm像McMahon建议的那样出演菲尔普斯，或游戏的第二主角杰克·凯尔索，一定会很有意思。

entries.en: When the PlayStation 2 arrived at the dawn of the millennium, it brought with it a whole new generation of graphical fidelity. No longer was Final Fantasy restricted to pre-rendered backgrounds - the entire game could be made up of deeply detailed 3D environments with gorgeous textures. Progress comes at a cost, though. Crafting an overworld that could match the visual advancements of the main locations would have been a development nightmare; hugely expensive, technically demanding, and incredibly punishing when it came to disc space. And so when Final Fantasy 10 arrived in 2001, it did so without the series’ traditional overworld. The entire game took place within its level environments – a linear chain of towns, beaches, temples, and the back of a giant evil whale.
entries.cn: 当PS2在千禧年之初到来时，它也带来了一整代全新的画面保真度。《最终幻想》不再局限于预渲染背景——整款游戏都可以由拥有精美纹理、细节丰富的3D环境构成。然而，进步是有代价的。要制作一张能在视觉效果上比肩主要区域的大地图，在开发上会是一场噩梦：成本极其高昂、技术难度巨大，而且对光盘空间的要求也极为苛刻。因此，当2001年《最终幻想10》发售时，它没有延续系列传统的大地图。整款游戏都发生在它的关卡环境之内——一条由城镇、海滩、寺院以及一头巨型邪恶鲸鱼的背部连成的线性旅途。

entries.en: Battles look to be divided into two main approaches - a battlefield view to give directions to your forces, and directly controlling your character over their shoulder. Giving orders to your army will look and feel a bit familiar to fans of other medieval strategy games, where you will be aligning your troops into various formations. Battle planning will begin before the first arrow is even shot. During this preparation, Medieval has you organize your forces into “battle lines”, positioning them in your starting lines from a high-in-the-sky vantage point, and giving them their initial actions. Raw Power explains that these act as a sort of underlying “rule” that your AI units will follow during the battle.
entries.cn: 战斗似乎分为两种主要模式：一种是战场视角，用于向部队下达指令；另一种是越肩视角，直接控制你的角色。向军队下达指令的方式，对其他中世纪策略游戏玩家来说会有些熟悉——你需要将部队排列成各种阵型。战斗计划在箭矢射出之前就已开始。在准备阶段，你需要将部队组织成「战线」，从高空俯瞰视角布置初始位置，并下达初始行动指令。Raw Power解释称，这些相当于一种底层「规则」，你的AI单位将在战斗中遵循。

entries.en: Just last week, Microsoft announced significant Xbox price rises of its own , which kick in this August. They come less than a year after the last Xbox price rises in October 2025. “We hoped another price increase would not be necessary, and we have spent the last several months working with suppliers on options,” Microsoft explained. “Unfortunately, console storage and memory prices have increased by more than 2.5x and we expect another doubling by the fall of 2027. The entire consumer electronics industry is struggling with the current components crisis, but the effects are particularly hard on consoles. Unlike phones, computers, speakers, and other consumer devices, consoles are typically not sold at a profit, but instead for less than they cost to make.”
entries.cn: 就在上周，微软也宣布了自家XBOX的重大涨价，将于今年8月生效。这距离上次2025年10月的XBOX涨价还不到一年。微软解释称：「我们曾希望不需再次涨价，过去几个月我们一直在与供应商探讨方案。不幸的是，主机存储和内存价格已上涨超过2.5倍，我们预计到2027年秋季还会再翻一番。整个消费电子行业都在与当前的元器件危机作斗争，但对主机的影响尤为严重。与手机、电脑、音箱等消费设备不同，主机通常不是以盈利为目的销售，而是以低于制造成本的价格出售。」

entries.en: “Initial forecasts predicted sales of around 300,000 copies. 10 years and more than 70 million players later, I’m astounded by how the game continues to reach new heights. 2025 was Dead by Daylight’s most successful year so far.
