entries.en: PlayStation’s decision serves as a harbinger for a potentially dire future for gamers everywhere. It is entirely self-serving, and will have ripple effects throughout the industry that we can only begin to speculate on. The immense backlash on social media to PlayStation’s own social posts has become its own news story, and there’s always potential that such heavy negativity may cause publishing partners to hit pause on their PlayStation social marketing efforts. Gamers have every right to be angry – we’re being challenged on the future of our right to own the things we’ve paid for. Allowing this to pass unscathed would open the door to a myriad of worse decisions: things advertising during pause screens, and intrusive product placement throughout classic franchises. How we respond to this decision over the next year may define how the next decade of the video game industry is shaped. The official slogan of the PlayStation 5 is ‘Play Has No Limits’; if we don’t make a stand now, the PlayStation 6’s slogan might as well be ‘You’ll Play How We Want You to Play.’
entries.cn: PlayStation的决定预示着全球玩家可能面临严峻未来。它完全出于自身利益，并将在行业中产生我们才刚开始揣测的连锁效应。PlayStation官方社交帖子遭遇的巨大反弹本身已成为新闻，强烈负面情绪也可能让发行合作伙伴暂停PlayStation社交营销。玩家完全有权愤怒，因为我们购买物品后拥有它们的未来权利正受到挑战。如果此事毫发无损地通过，就会为无数更糟决定打开大门，例如暂停画面播放广告、在经典系列中植入侵扰性产品。未来一年我们如何回应，或将决定游戏行业下一个十年的形态。PS5官方口号是「玩无极限」；如果现在不站出来，PS6的口号不妨改成「你得按我们想要的方式玩」。

entries.en: So what you can expect out of the game is that we've created a comic book-style pacing, dense story, that's like a rollercoaster and it grips you from beginning to end. And generally speaking, you're driven through all of these missions by important events and plot points that are happening. So in that sense, what you saw in the gameplay trailer was kind of representative. Logan's got a lead, he's got a direction, but he has agency in how he decides to approach it. The areas have different paths you could take. Stealth is optional; you could do it or you could not do it, you could jump straight into combat. And you can poke your nose around the nooks and crannies of the world to find things here and there, and some optional content and collectibles along the way.
entries.cn: 所以你可以期待的是，我们创造了漫画式的节奏、紧凑的故事，就像过山车一样，从头到尾扣人心弦。总的来说，你被重要事件和剧情节点驱动着完成所有任务。从这个意义上说，你在实机预告片中看到的内容具有代表性。罗根有线索、有方向，但他有自主权决定如何行动。区域内有不同的路径可供选择。潜行是可选的；你可以潜行，也可以不潜行，直接跳入战斗。你还可以在世界各处探索，发现各种东西，以及一些可选内容和收集品。

entries.en: So, rather than add combat to Subnautica 2 or give death-dealing weapons to players, Unknown Worlds is changing the way predators work. This hotfix is a part of that. For example, Hammerheads no longer attack unpiloted Tadpoles, although they can still take an interest in Tadpoles generally. And while the overall damage of Marrowbreaches is increased, their attacks are now spaced out to occur less frequently. As for Nibblers, their perception range is reduced so players are less visible to them, and the duration Nibblers circle the player before attacking is increased. Patch notes courtesy of Steam are below.
entries.cn: 因此，Unknown Worlds没有为《深海迷航2》加入战斗系统或致命武器，而是改变掠食者的行为方式。本次热修复就是其中一部分。例如，锤头鲨不再攻击无人驾驶的蝌蚪号（不过它们仍可能对蝌蚪号产生兴趣）。髓裂兽的总体伤害提高了，但攻击间隔拉长，频率降低。至于啃噬者，它们的感知范围缩小了，玩家更难被发现，而且它们在攻击前环绕玩家的时间也变长了。以下是Steam上的更新说明。

entries.en: Sweeney : I guess I've been around the longest. But you can't say that this is the first time the industry has gone through a shakeup because there have been many before. I was a young gamer in the 1980s when the Atari crash happened, and the transition from 2D gaming to 3D when suddenly a lot of the games at the time that were being developed ended up not finding a market. And then BitTorrent hit the industry pretty hard, too. There was a time when the industry rumor was that Crysis had sold 100,000 copies and 10 million people had played it. And the solution to that was multifaceted.
entries.cn: Sweeney：我想我是在这行干得最久的了。但你不能说这是行业头一次经历震荡，因为以前已经发生过很多次。我年轻时在 1980 年代玩着游戏，经历了雅达利大崩溃，还有从 2D 游戏到 3D 游戏的转型，当时一大批正在开发的游戏突然就找不到市场了。后来 BitTorrent 也对行业冲击不小。曾有一段时期，业内传闻《孤岛危机》只卖出了 10 万份，却有 1000 万人玩过它。应对这种局面的办法是多方面的。

entries.en: Sony's controversial decision to stop releasing PlayStation games on physical discs means all new PS5 games launched from January 2028 onwards will be digital only — something that's almost certain to continue on PS6 . entries.en: For Sony, going all-digital for new game releases will earn it more money from every sale at a time when console sales are expected to plummet due to their rising cost. For a first-party PlayStation game such as The Last of Us, Sony will only keep around 65% of the money from a physical copy, with around 30% going to the retailer and roughly another 5% on manufacturing costs. Meanwhile, for a physical copy of a third-party game such as the Activision-published Call of Duty, Sony will get a licensing fee, likely around 15%.
entries.cn: 随着主机成本上涨、销量预计大幅下滑，新游戏全面数字化能让索尼从每笔销售中赚到更多。以《最后生还者》这样的PlayStation第一方游戏为例，实体版收入中索尼只能留下约65%，约30%归零售商，另有约5%用于生产。至于动视发行的《使命召唤》等第三方游戏实体版，索尼获得的授权费可能只有约为15%。

entries.en: “I think a lot of us humans find something very appealing when we see something of grand scale,” explains Ueda. “Whether that's robots, mechs, or creatures. For example, whales are gigantic. Why? There's a sense of awe, right? Just looking at giant fireworks in the sky. I don't know if you feel the same way, but there's kind of a sense of wonder and awe that you get from something that is so big and larger in life, so to speak. And so I think that's a more natural thing for any human to feel.”
entries.cn: 「我认为，大多数人都会对那些规模宏大的事物产生天然的吸引力，」上田文人解释道。「无论是机器人、机甲，还是某种巨大的生物。比如鲸鱼为什么会让人着迷？因为它们实在太庞大了，对吧？又或者是夜空中巨大的烟火。我不知道你是不是也有同样的感受，但面对那些远远超出现实尺度的庞然大物时，人总会产生一种惊奇与敬畏。某种意义上来说，我觉得这是所有人都会拥有的一种非常自然的情绪。」

entries.en: Harding-Rolls also suggests Sony has money on its mind. Selling games digitally makes games companies more money than selling games in boxes, where publishers take about 50% of the sale price. Sony takes a 30% cut of game sales on the PlayStation Store, leaving 70% for publishers. When PlayStation goes 100% digital from 2028 onwards, the game companies including Sony will make more money overall from software sales.
entries.cn: Harding-Rolls还认为，索尼考虑的是钱。相比销售盒装游戏，数字销售能让游戏公司赚到更多。盒装游戏中，发行商大约拿走售价的50%；而PlayStation Store游戏销售中，索尼抽成30%，发行商拿走70%。当PlayStation自2028年起全面数字化后，包括索尼在内的游戏公司整体会从软件销售中赚到更多。

entries.en: Sweeney : I'm really looking forward to the increased simplicity. I wrote the first generation Unreal Engine and with every generation, out of necessity of taking advantage of new features of hardware and expanding the engine capabilities, we've made the engine progressively more and more complicated, to the point where it's somewhat daunting to open up Unreal Engine 5 and look at the five-level MUI nested menus in some cases.
entries.cn: Sweeney：我尤为期待简化的提升。我编写了第一代虚幻引擎，此后每一代，出于利用硬件新功能和扩展引擎能力的必要，我们都让引擎变得越来越复杂，以至于如今打开虚幻引擎5，有时看到五层深的MUI嵌套菜单，会让人有点望而生畏。

entries.en: On the flip side, I have never, ever purchased a movie digitally. My household still subscribes to several streaming services, and I’m content enough with their convenience for the time being, but my movie collection is otherwise strictly physical. Prior to entering the media industry I worked at Blockbuster Video during the transition from VHS to DVD, which is where my collection started. I’m hesitant to put a figure on its current size on the off chance that my wife reads this, but I will admit I’m… deeply nostalgic about video stores. Like, proper deeply. If I can’t visit them anymore, building one around me was the next best thing. Now I can work at IGN while still ensconced in a video store. It’s the best of both worlds.
entries.cn: 反过来说，我从来没有、真的从来没有以数字形式购买过电影。我们家现在仍然订阅几个流媒体服务，我暂时也还算满意它们的便利性，但我的电影收藏除此之外严格坚持实体。在进入媒体行业之前，我曾在Blockbuster Video工作，正赶上VHS转向DVD的时期，我的收藏也是从那时开始的。我不太想给出现在的规模，免得我妻子看到，但我承认自己对录像带租赁店有着非常深的怀旧情结。真的很深。既然现在不能再去这样的店，那在自己身边搭出一家就是次优选择。现在我能一边在IGN工作，一边仍然被自己的「录像店」包围。这就是两全其美。

entries.en: Out of all that Yooka-Laylee Kart is looking to deliver, what has me most excited and that I am more interested in is its custom rulesets that players will be able to tinker around with to create custom race types. These custom rules look to extend into the grand prix mode too, as during my cup race, I encountered races that would not only turn all racers invisible in one map, but then in the next made each racer the same character. entries.en: The name, Dreadnought, is a nod to the early 20th Century British warship, HMS Dreadnought. Aston Martin Chief Creative Officer, Marek Reichman, said: “To me, Dreadnought is unmistakably an Aston Martin — amplified without restraint. The quality of the details we have been able to include, right down to the iconic Chiltern Green paint colour so synonymous with this marque, underscores our dedication to delivering a truly authentic Aston Martin experience. Features as diverse as the carbon fibre chassis right through to exquisite elements such as the door hinges in anodised Satin Gold, reflect our real-world determination to be the most desirable ultra-luxury brand in the automotive sector, and beyond.”

entries.en: Nintendo has dabbled with releasing physical versions with just a code in the box with its controversial Game Key-Card releases for the Switch 2. It’s been as helping improve the performance of games because they are downloaded to the console's internal memory. With GTA 6, which is set for launch on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S only, there are all sorts of theories. Analysts have suggested to IGN that the decision was in part about Rockstar's desire to avoid damaging leaks that might have emerged from releasing a disc into a pre-release supply chain. They've also explained that releasing GTA 6 without a disc will cut manufacturing costs and make Rockstar more money because it can subsequently control the price of the game. Rockstar has yet to explain its decision.
entries.cn: 任天堂在Switch 2上试行了颇具争议的游戏钥匙卡，即实体版盒内只带下载码的销售方式。由于游戏会下载到主机内部存储，这种做法有助于提升游戏性能。至于《GTA6》，这款游戏预计仅登陆PS5和XBOX Series，各界对此众说纷纭。分析师向IGN表示，Rockstar这么做部分原因是为了防止实体光盘进入预发售供应链而导致的破坏性泄露。他们还解释称，发售不带光盘的《GTA6》能削减制造成本，并且由于Rockstar之后可以控制游戏定价，还能赚更多钱。Rockstar尚未对此决定做出解释。

entries.en: Nvidia is hoping that the RTX Spark, along with Windows, will bring about a new type of computing. Microsoft has been hinting at this type of thing in a while, but at Nvidia's press conference in Taipei, CEO Jensen Huang spelled it out himself, saying "For forty years, you launched apps. Click. entries.en: Phantom Blade Zero’s 50-day gamble is nothing compared to some, though. The parting of this Red Sea of releases means there’s a near and far side, and we’ve already seen a couple of games that were originally destined for 2026 make a tactical backslide into next year. Playground Games’ reboot of Fable, which had been promised to release this year after being delayed out of 2025, has now repositioned itself for a February 2027 launch . Xbox’s Matt Booty provided a straightforward reason for this: "so it can have the dedicated moment it deserves". There’s no easy victory within the shadow cast by GTA 6, and so there's no shame in stepping backwards for a second time.
entries.cn: 不过，《影之刃零》的50天赌博与某些游戏相比根本不算什么。这场发行红海的分裂意味着有近岸和远岸，我们已经看到几款原本定于2026年发售的游戏战术性地退到了明年。Playground Games重启的《神鬼寓言》，在从2025年延期后曾承诺今年发售，现在已重新定位到2027年2月。Xbox的Matt Booty给出了直白的理由：「这样它才能获得应有的专属时刻。」在《GTA6》的阴影下没有轻松取胜，因此第二次后退并不丢人。

entries.en: With all of this said, there has been a lot of discussion throughout the current console generation over whether or not the Xbox Series S is worth the hassles. Microsoft mandates that all Xbox Series X titles must also work on Series S with full feature parity, but it has led to some games being released later on the platform. It begs the question whether Project Helix, the next Xbox console , will have a cheaper and weaker variant – or if Microsoft will go all-in on one SKU. Given how aggressive Xbox's new CEO Asha Sharma has been, it's hard to imagine the company doing two consoles again, but we'll just have to wait and see.
entries.cn: 综上所述，在本世代主机周期中，关于XSS是否值得带来这些麻烦的讨论一直不绝于耳。微软要求所有Xbox Series游戏必须同步支持XSS并保持功能完全一致，但这导致部分游戏在该平台上延期发售。这不禁让人思考：下一代Xbox主机Project Helix是否会推出一个更便宜、性能更弱的版本？还是微软会全力押注单一销售单元（SKU）？考虑到Xbox新任CEO Asha Sharma一贯激进的作风，很难想象公司会再次推出两款主机，但我们也只能拭目以待。

entries.en: 2016’s Infinite Warfare – on which Kurosaki and Minkoff worked as narrative director and design director respectively – felt very different indeed. While some COD fans couldn’t countenance the idea of a story set in space, Infinity Ward grounded its campaign in deliberately-paced character drama, just as Naughty Dog had for the preceding decade. The studio learned the right lessons from Wolfenstein: The New Order, too: not only that it should cast B.J. Blazkowicz actor Brian Bloom in the lead role, but that it should situate the heart of its FPS in a conversationally-focused hub world.
entries.cn: 2016年的《无限战争》感觉完全不同。Kurosaki和Minkoff分别担任该作叙事总监和设计总监。虽然一些COD粉丝无法接受故事设定在太空，但Infinity Ward让战役扎根于刻意放慢节奏的角色戏剧，就像顽皮狗此前十年所做的那样。工作室也从《德军总部：新秩序》中学到了正确的经验：不仅应该让B.J. Blazkowicz的演员Brian Bloom担任主角，还应该把这款第一人称射击游戏的核心放在一个以对话为中心的枢纽世界里。

entries.en: Brawley noted that while "the tactical missions themselves are the bread and butter of a lot of the gameplay and where all off the combat happens," he was also excited for players to experience The Den. As he described it, The Den is "a place where you and your operators are operating between missions. You'll have the opportunity to not only talk to the different members of the team and see how they're doing and if they're hoping you'll help them take care of something, but also take care of a lot of the management tasks. You'll be able to buy items from the black market. You can choose to modify your character's load outs - what weapons and utility items they're using and then customize and level up their skills as you choose to."
entries.cn: Brawley指出，虽然「战术任务本身是大部分游戏玩法的核心，也是所有战斗发生的地方」，但他也很期待玩家体验「巢穴（The Den）」。他描述道，「巢穴」是「你和你的特工在任务之间运作的地方。你不仅有机会与团队的不同成员交谈，了解他们的状况，以及他们是否希望你帮忙处理某事，还可以处理许多管理任务。你可以在黑市购买物品。你可以选择修改角色的装备——他们使用的武器和实用物品——然后根据自己的选择自定义和升级他们的技能。」

entries.en: We gave Deltarune a 9/10 , noting that it manages to impress despite the fact it is largely unfinished: "Toby Fox and his team have really accomplished something incredible with Deltarune and its new chapters, even if that accomplishment isn’t quite finished just yet. The fact that what appears to be a halfway point in the story can leave off on such a phenomenal and high-stakes note after roughly 20 hours still has me reeling knowing I’ve yet to see the true depths of where this adventure will lead."
entries.cn: 我们给《三角符文》打出了9分（满分10分），并指出尽管游戏目前远未完成，但它依然令人印象深刻：Toby Fox及其团队凭借《Deltarune》及其新增章节完成了一项非凡的成就，即便这项成就目前仍未最终完成。令人难以置信的是，这部作品在故事仅推进到看似中途的位置、游玩约20小时后，就已经以如此震撼、如此攸关命运的高潮收尾，至今仍让我回味不已。我迫不及待想知道，这场冒险最终究竟会走向何方，又会展现出怎样更深层次的精彩。」

entries.en: Control Resonant is the sequel to 2019's Control , and the latest game from developer Remedy. As for where the story takes us this time, a PlayStation Blog post from Remedy Entertainment's Co-Creative Director Mikael Kasurinen explains, "In Control Resonant, Manhattan has been warped by paranatural forces: its architecture impossible, its realities shifting, its streets stalked by monstrous entities born from a new kind of resonance. entries.en: NordVPN had detected fake GTA 6 beta keys and subscription traps, and to make them feel more legit scammers have even asked their targets to fill out a short form or go through a fake “Are you a bot?” verification step. It’s also worth being mindful of Android adware masquerading as a GTA 6 beta. These fake apps lead to websites that may include infostealers, banking trojans, adware, and ransomware. There are also trojanized GTA 6 repacks, where threat actors build clones of well-known piracy and repack sites to distribute Windows malware disguised as game files.
entries.cn: NordVPN已发现伪造的《GTA6》Beta密钥和订阅陷阱，而且为了让这些骗局看起来更可信，骗子甚至要求目标填写简短表格或通过「你是机器人吗？」这种假验证步骤。还需要警惕伪装成《GTA6》Beta版的Android广告软件。这些虚假应用会导向可能包含信息窃取器、银行木马、广告软件和勒索软件的网站。此外还有被植入木马的《GTA6》整合包，威胁行为者仿冒知名盗版和整合网站，将伪装成游戏文件的Windows恶意软件分发出去。

entries.en: Shawn Kittelsen: From the jump, the idea of PlatinumGames and The Last Ronin seemed like peanut butter and chocolate. They went together very, very well. It was the kind of no-brainer pitch in terms of, could this work? Absolutely. When we started Paramount Games at the end of last year, building out the division and the team and looking at the slate, there wasn't a Last Ronin game in development at the time. There were some previous partnerships that had gone away. So we were very, very excited to say, "Well, let's get going on this. Let's make that the first thing that we focus on." And Platinum had some really awesome creatives who were excited about The Last Ronin and had a pitch. And when we saw their pitch, it was about so much more than what we expected.
entries.cn: Shawn Kittelsen：从一开始，白金工作室和《最后的浪人》这个想法就像花生酱和巧克力一样。它们非常非常搭配。这是一个无需多想的提案：这能行吗？绝对能行。去年年底我们启动派拉蒙游戏时，正在组建部门和团队，审视项目清单，当时并没有《最后的浪人》游戏在开发中。之前的一些合作已经终止了。所以我们非常兴奋地说：「好吧，我们开始吧。让它成为我们关注的第一件事。」白金工作室有一些非常棒的创意人员，他们对《最后的浪人》充满热情，并提出了一个方案。当我们看到他们的方案时，它远远超出了我们的预期。

entries.en: First off, Larian itself moved on from Dungeons & Dragons to make Divinity . In an interview with IGN at GDC 2024, CEO Swen Vincke revealed Larian began work on Baldur’s Gate 3 DLC and even gave some thought to a potential Baldur's Gate 4 before pivoting away to other projects because the team was "going through the motions." "You could see the team was doing it because everyone felt like we had to do it, but it wasn’t really coming from the heart, and we’re very much a studio from the heart," Vincke added. "It’s what gotten us into misery and it’s also been the reasons for our success."
entries.cn: 首先，Larian自己已经放下了《龙与地下城》，转而去开发《神界》系列。在GDC 2024上接受IGN采访时，CEO Swen Vincke透露，Larian曾着手开发《博德之门3》的DLC，甚至对潜在的《博德之门4》也做过一些考虑，但随后转向了其他项目，因为团队是在「走流程」。「你能看出来，大家去做这件事是因为觉得非做不可，但并非发自内心，而我们正是一家凭内心做游戏的工作室。」Vincke补充道，「这很矛盾，凭内心做游戏曾让我们陷入困境，也同样是我们成功的原因。」

entries.en: “Ro Laren’s character, who's played by Michelle Forbes, who we're bringing back from The Next Generation, never got her moment in the spotlight enough for the fans who loved her on The Next Generation. So bringing her back and having an adventure focused on her, and then giving her that deeper inner psychological conflict to work with, and making that the centerpiece for the psychological thriller where she has to survive on a strange planet, is right up Bloober's alley. And I think this is a game that's going to show that Bloober has more range, that they don't need to be pigeonholed in a horror category. They're trying to flex to a different place and show what they can do.
entries.cn: 「由Michelle Forbes饰演的Ro Laren角色，我们将从《下一代》中把她带回来。她在《下一代》中一直没有得到足够让喜欢她的粉丝们满意的聚光灯时刻。所以，让她回归，并将冒险聚焦于她，同时赋予她更深层次的内心冲突，并以此作为心理惊悚的核心，让她在一个陌生星球上求生，这简直是为Bloober量身定做的。我认为这款游戏将展示Bloober拥有更丰富的可能性，他们不需要被局限在恐怖这一类型中。他们正努力向新的领域拓展，展示自己的能力。」

entries.en: The end of disc production doesn’t just threaten borrowing, but potentially the entire second-hand market ecosystem. Many players over the years, once bored of their collection, have found their way down to a local GameStop in the U.S. or CEX in the UK to trade in their games, and in the process, collect a few new ones while they’re in-store. Think of them as recycling plants for video games – as one player closes the book on The Witcher 3, another opens that person’s case for the first time. Second-hand stores have served as gateways for players to experience the extensive back catalog of past and present consoles alike, often at an alluring discount.
entries.cn: 停止生产光盘威胁的不只是游戏借用，还可能波及整个二手市场生态。多年来，许多玩家厌倦收藏后，会去美国当地的GameStop或英国CEX置换游戏，并在店内顺便带走几款新作品。可以把这些商店看作游戏回收站：一名玩家合上《巫师3》这本书时，另一名玩家第一次打开了他的游戏盒。二手商店一直是玩家接触新旧主机庞大游戏库的入口，而且通常提供诱人的折扣。

entries.en: "We already have had a character like Tupac, who had passed away before the game was made [the character Genzo Iwaki with the likeness of actor Bunta Sugawara]. He's a really famous actor in yakuza movies and Japanese film history. But it's kind of the same situation, he's this famous actor who passed away. But we made sure that we talked to his estate and family and got their permission; not just their permission, but we talked to them about what we wanted to do. They not only said okay, but they were really excited about the opportunity. We wanted to give their characters a role that would do other justice to the people themselves as well. If we didn't, we think that would be extremely rude, so we definitely wouldn't have done it otherwise. So we did our best to make sure that any role we create for these characters would honor them and their families."
entries.cn: 「我们之前已经有过类似Tupac的角色，即在游戏制作前就已去世的人物（角色岩木 源造使用了演员菅原文太的肖像）。他是日本黑道电影和电影史上非常著名的演员。情况很相似，他是一位已故的著名演员。但我们确保与他的遗产管理方和家人沟通并获得许可；不仅仅是许可，我们还与他们讨论了我们想做的事情。他们不仅同意了，而且对这次机会非常兴奋。我们希望赋予他们的角色一个能公正对待他们本人的角色。如果我们做不到，我们认为那将极其无礼，所以我们绝对不会那样做。因此我们尽最大努力确保为这些角色创造的角色能够荣耀他们和他们的家人。」

entries.en: The groundwork was laid in the second game, 2024’s Rebirth , which pushed Final Fantasy the furthest it's ever been into the modern day understanding of an open world game. While technically made up of hubs bridged by linear environments, each hub has the classic hallmarks of a post-Assassin’s Creed open world; towers that reveal the many icons dotted across the map, a multitude of different activity types, and a long list of side quests and bounties to complete in the pursuit of 100%-ing each area.
entries.cn: 第二部，即2024年的《重生》，为此打下了基础。它将《最终幻想》推向了现代意义上开放世界游戏的最前沿。虽然从技术上讲，它由线性环境连接的多个枢纽区域组成，但每个枢纽都具备后《刺客信条》时代开放世界的经典特征：可以揭示地图上密密麻麻图标的瞭望塔、多种多样的活动类型，以及一大票支线任务和悬赏目标，驱动着玩家将每个区域达成100%完成度。

entries.en: There’s still so much left to know about Gen Atlas, but one thing we can be sure of is that each aspect of it will be designed with utmost intentionality. Ueda games are never rushed — he’s only given us three in 25 years, after all — but always worth the wait. There’s always that sense of anticipation. What will those initial feelings of wonder evolve into as the story reaches its final moments? Joy? Melancholy? Hope? We’ll likely all feel something different. For now, though, with no release date or window currently given, the wait will have to continue.
entries.cn: 关于《gen Atlas》还有太多未知，但有一点我们可以肯定：它的每一个方面都将被设计得极度用心。上田文人的作品从来不会匆忙问世——毕竟25年来，他只推出了三部原创作品——但最终往往都值得等待。当故事走向结局时，游戏开始时那份惊叹与好奇，最终会演变成什么情绪？喜悦？惆怅？希望？我们大概每个人都会有不同的感受。不过眼下，游戏尚未公布发售日期或窗口，等待还得继续。

entries.en: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma sent shockwaves through the video game industry with her now infamous “reset” memo, in which she revealed that Microsoft's gaming business has a 3% accountability margin (assumed to mean profit margin). "Excluding Activision Blizzard King, over the past five years, we have spent over $20 billion on ongoing investments in our content, platform, and hardware subsidy, but our annual revenue has declined nearly half a billion during that time. Going forward, this cannot continue," Sharma said.
entries.cn: XBOX CEO Asha Sharma此前那封如今已经颇具争议的「重置」备忘录震动了整个游戏行业。她在备忘录中透露，微软游戏业务的问责利润率为3%（外界推测指利润率）。Sharma表示：「不计动视暴雪和King，过去五年里，我们在内容、平台和硬件补贴的持续投资上花费了超过200亿美元(约合人民币1360亿元)，但同期年收入却下降了近5亿美元(约合人民币34亿元)。往后，这种情况不能继续下去。」

entries.en: While Sony struggles to deal with the RAMpocalypse, it has said it has yet to decide when to launch the PS6 . The near six-year-old PS5 is approaching the 100 million sold mark (93.7 million), although it continues to lag behind the PS4. It's worth remembering that PS4 had seen various price cuts at this point in its lifecycle, making it a compelling casual purchase. This generation, however, has swung the other way, limiting the potential install base. There are even concerns that Sony and Microsoft won’t be able to release enough consoles into the retail channel to meet the demand this Christmas fueled by the guaranteed system seller that is GTA 6. During a financial Q&A in May, Sony boss Hiroki Totoki insisted that Sony had enough materials to see it through the rest of 2026.
entries.cn: 索尼在艰难应对内存价格危机时表示尚未决定何时推出PS6。即将年满六周岁的PS5 正接近1亿销量大关（9370万台），但仍落后于PS4。值得注意的是，PS4 在生命周期相同阶段已多次降价，使其成为极具吸引力的冲动型消费选择。然而，本世代却走向了相反方向，限制了潜在装机量。甚至有人担心，索尼和微软可能无法在圣诞季向零售渠道供应足够的主机，以满足由《GTA6》这一铁定能带动主机销售的大作所引爆的需求。在 5 月的一次财务问答中，索尼总裁十时裕树坚称，索尼有足够的物料支撑 2026 年剩余时间的生产。

entries.en: Polydin describes the story setup as follows: "You play as Elena, who returns to the place where she grew up after receiving a message from her missing twin sister, Rita. The orphanage should have been empty. Instead, its halls are still warm, the bells are ringing again, and something has been moving through the walls. As Elena follows Rita’s trail, she uncovers the remains of a forbidden ritual tied to the children who vanished from the orphanage years ago. Some of them may still be here, though not in any form she remembers."
entries.cn: Polydin这样介绍故事背景：「Elena 在收到失踪的双胞胎姐妹Rita发来的消息后，回到了自己长大的地方。孤儿院本应空无一人。然而，这里的走廊依然残留着温度，钟声再次响起，还有某种东西一直在墙体中穿行。循着Rita留下的踪迹，Elena开始揭开一场禁忌仪式留下的残迹，而这场仪式与多年前失踪的孩子们息息相关。他们中的一些人或许仍在孤儿院内，只是早已不再是她记忆中的模样。」

entries.en: So, what has Sony actually released over the last half decade? Well, there have been some high-profile bombs, including the disastrous live-service game Concord. But it’s worth remembering that through it all, Sony has had a number of smash hits despite the overall sales figure falling. Arrowhead’s Helldivers 2, for example, remains the fastest-selling PlayStation Studios game of all time. Astro Bot might not have sold at the same level, but it was critically acclaimed. Insomniac has released Marvel's Spider-Man: Miles Morales and Spider-Man 2, both of which have sold millions, and Sony Santa Monica released God of War Ragnarök, which was a huge hit. Polyphony released Gran Turismo 7. Guerrilla released Horizon Forbidden West. These are all major launches.
entries.cn: 那么，索尼在过去五年里到底发布了哪些游戏？确实有一些高调翻车的作品，比如灾难性的服务型游戏《星鸣特攻》。但值得记住的是，尽管整体销量下滑，索尼仍然推出了不少爆款。例如Arrowhead的《绝地潜兵2》至今仍是PlayStation Studios史上销售最快的游戏。《宇宙机器人》销量可能没那么高，但获得了评论界一致好评。Insomniac推出了《漫威蜘蛛侠：迈尔斯·莫拉莱斯》和《漫威蜘蛛侠2》，两款游戏销量均达数百万份；索尼圣莫尼卡工作室推出了大获成功的《战神：诸神黄昏》。Polyphony Digital推出了《跑车浪漫旅7》。Guerrilla推出了《地平线：西之绝境》。这些都是重磅作品。

entries.en: To catch you up, Chronicles: Medieval is a sandbox RPG that mixes third-person action combat with larger strategic-based battles where you assume the role of an army’s commander. Set during the period of the Hundred Years’ War in Europe, your time will be spent earning renown, recruiting troops, waging battles, and growing your legacy. Serving as one of the core pillars that Medieval has been built around, these battles will range from smaller skirmishes of a mere 20 soldiers all the way up to large-scale battles with 2,000 at your command.

entries.en: Earlier this month, the California State Senate held a hearing regarding Stop Killing Games-backed bill known as the Protect Our Games Act. The bill aims to obligate publishers to find ways to make games playable, even after ending support for them. That would mean that live-service games would need to have some kind of functionality after servers are shut down. The subject of private servers was brought up as a feasible solution and cited Minecraft as a prominent example, to which ESA’s VP of State Government Affairs, Jennifer Gibbons, countered with a head-scratching argument.
entries.cn: 本月早些时候，加利福尼亚州参议院就一项由Stop Killing Games支持、名为《保护我们的游戏法案》的法案举行了听证。该法案旨在要求发行商即使在结束支持游戏后，也要找到让游戏继续可玩的方式。这意味着服务型游戏在服务器关闭后仍需要保留某种功能。私人服务器被提出为一种可行解决方案，并以《我的世界》作为典型例子；对此，ESA州政府事务副总裁Jennifer Gibbons提出了令人费解的反驳。

entries.en: Arkane Lyon, meanwhile, is widely acknowledged as one of the medium’s leaders in dense, engrossing world design. That’s evident to anyone who’s played Dishonored, Deathloop, or Dark Messiah of Might and Magic. Arkane’s worldbuilding has combined industrial Victoriana and bohemian witch covens; subarctic fishing villages and immortal party people. These unlikely mashups haven’t felt jarring in their juxtaposition, but instead grounded and believable. Much the way Fallout was, when Cain’s team married Atomic Age kitsch to wasteland horror.

entries.en: This has become something of a signature for Minkoff-Kurosaki design ever since. Not cruise ships, precisely, but a reconfiguration of the way the player interacts with a level – turning what is usually static into something fluid. In Crossfire, that means navigating a craggy mountainside in a different way than you’re used to, thanks to the game’s adaptive cover system. “Our player character Layla dynamically adjusts her stance to react to the complex terrain and the enemy’s line of sight,” Minkoff said at SGF. “It fundamentally changes your relationship with the environment and becomes an active skill to master.”
entries.cn: 此后，这几乎成了Minkoff-Kurosaki式设计的标志。不一定是邮轮本身，而是重新配置玩家与关卡互动的方式，把通常静止的东西变成流动的东西。在《穿越火线：潜伏》中，这意味着借助游戏的自适应掩体系统，以不同于以往的方式穿越崎岖山坡。Minkoff在夏日游戏节上说：「我们的玩家角色Layla会动态调整姿态，以应对复杂地形和敌人的视线。它从根本上改变了你和环境之间的关系，并成为一种需要掌握的主动技能。」

entries.en: Earlier this month, new Xbox boss Asha Sharma said the spiralling cost of new and existing consoles would require "radically different business models" over the coming generation. Speaking to Fortune, Sharma acknowledged the increasing price of existing hardware and components — fuelled by global crises and the rise of AI — and said the industry had "reached a point where it will be hard to imagine" mass audiences still being able to afford "thousands of dollars" for a new console generation.
entries.cn: 本月早些时候，XBOX新任负责人Asha Sharma表示，新老主机成本不断攀升，未来一代主机需要「截然不同的商业模式」。她在接受《财富》采访时承认，受全球危机和AI崛起推动，现有硬件和组件的价格持续上涨，并称业界已「到了一个难以想象的地步」，广大消费者可能无力承受新一代主机「数千美元」的价格。

entries.en: GOG’s approach could be evolved to give players even more autonomy. An online hub filled with individual user storefronts operated by players themselves – like a digital yard sale, players could browse one another’s wares, combing through for a good deal or a brand-new gem they’ve never heard of. Much like GOG’s extensive partnership program, or World of Books’s AuthorSHARE initiative, which donates a portion of all used book sales to the authors who originally penned them, publishers and developers could take a percentage of each sale in exchange for ensuring that ownership exchange of each digital title begins with the player handing it over and ends with the player purchasing it. No DRM middle-man in sight. This could also provide a second-life for pre-owned retailers like GameStop and CEX, thereby ensuring a key sub-section of the video game market continues to be served whilst, for the first time ever, actively incorporating the publishers and developers as financial participants. Idealistically, this could see a greater cash injection flowing into the industry, an alternative that would be much welcomed by many a developer over publishers’ hyper-focus on making their own live-service cash cow.
entries.cn: GOG的做法还可进一步发展，给予玩家更多自主权。可以建立一个由玩家经营个人商店的在线中心，像数字庭院旧货销售一样，玩家浏览彼此商品，寻找好价或从未听说的新宝藏。类似GOG广泛的合作计划，或World of Books把部分二手书收入捐给原作者的AuthorSHARE项目，发行商与开发者可以从每笔交易中抽成，作为交换，确保每款数字作品的所有权转移始于玩家交出、终于另一名玩家购入，完全没有DRM中间人。这也能让GameStop和CEX等二手零售商获得第二次生命，确保游戏市场的关键细分领域继续得到服务，并首次让发行商和开发者主动成为经济参与者。理想情况下，这能为行业注入更多资金；相比发行商过度专注打造自家服务型游戏摇钱树，许多开发者会更欢迎这种选择。

entries.en: The data reinforces the idea that Sony has struggled to release new PlayStation 5 games this generation. Big new games have come out, as we've outlined, but some developers haven’t released brand new games in years. Chief among them is Naughty Dog, which is working on Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet but hasn’t released a brand new game since the aforementioned The Last of Us Part II six years ago. Gran Turismo 7 came out as a cross-gen game four years ago, and continues to receive updates, but Polyphony is due another entry in the racing game franchise. Bend Studio’s last game was 2019’s Days Gone. Media Molecule’s last game was 2020’s Dreams.
entries.cn: 这些数据强化了一个观点：索尼在本世代推出新PS5游戏方面举步维艰。正如我们所述，确实有大作问世，但一些开发商已经多年未推出全新游戏。最典型的是顽皮狗，他们正在开发《星际：异端先知》，但自六年前的《最后生还者 第二部》之后就没有再推出过全新游戏。《跑车浪漫旅7》作为跨世代游戏推出已有四年，仍在持续更新，但Polyphony Digital应该推出该赛车系列的新作了。Bend Studio的上一款游戏是2019年的《往日不再》。Media Molecule的上一款游戏是2020年的《梦想大创造》。

entries.en: Wassmer : I think its role is as a helper where it's useful, right? You go look back at Codegen tools back in last November, they kind of weren't that great. Now they're pretty good, so you can pretty easily put them into engineering pipelines. I think the main thing is you want to make sure of is to use AI to reduce all of the tedium. All the tedious tasks, like, you don't need an engineer to go and spend half a day doing root cause analysis on a crash if you can have a thing do that for you in 20 minutes and then tell them what's going on so they can spend that time optimizing the engine instead, helping a content creator, or whatever. I think it's horses for courses and there will be places where it's not useful, there'll be places where it will.
entries.cn: Wassmer：「我认为它的角色是在有用的地方做个帮手，对吧？你回想一下去年11月的代码生成工具，当时还不怎么样。现在已经相当不错了，可以很轻松地把它们整合到工程流水线里。我觉得关键是要确保用AI来减少所有枯燥的工作。所有繁琐的任务，比如不需要工程师花半天时间做崩溃的根因分析，如果有东西能在20分钟内帮你搞定，然后告诉你发生了什么，他们就可以用那段时间去优化引擎，或者帮助内容创作者等等。我觉得这要因地制宜，有些地方它没用，有些地方则有用。」

entries.en: Why did Zelnick get added into WWE 2K26? It's anyone's guess. He himself has admitted he isn't even a gamer, so it feels unlikely to be because he wants to play as himself. He seems like a decent sport, though, as he previously promoted the franchise's custom character creator with a silly video . However, this is the first time he's been added as an official character. He even sports his own exclusive entrance music in WWE 2K26, which is My Way by Frank Sinatra. The song was licensed seemingly just for Zelnick, as it can't be used for any other character in the game.
entries.cn: 为什么Zelnick会被加入《WWE 2K26》？谁也说不准。他本人承认自己甚至不是游戏玩家，所以不太可能是他想扮演自己。不过，他似乎是个有风度的家伙，此前曾用一个搞笑的视频宣传该系列的自定义角色创建器。但这是他首次作为官方角色加入。他甚至在《WWE 2K26》中拥有专属入场曲——Frank Sinatra的《My Way》。这首歌似乎只为Zelnick授权，游戏中其他角色无法使用。

entries.en: Josh Walter, a senior QA tester at Rockstar Lincoln, said: “Rockstar leads the industry in the games we create. We believe it can also lead the industry in how it treats the people who make them. There is so much that is special about the studio and the work we put out. We want to protect that. When people are confronted with pay disparities, excessive overtime or a lack of flexibility in arrangements, they are not in the best position to do their best work. We want to sit down with management and build a future where both the games and the conditions of the people who make them are as strong as possible.”
entries.cn: Josh Walter，Rockstar林肯办公室高级QA测试员，说道：「Rockstar在游戏创作上引领行业。我们相信，它也能在如何对待游戏制作者方面引领行业。这个工作室和我们产出作品中有太多特别之处，我们想要保护这一点。当员工面对薪资差异、过度加班或安排缺乏灵活性的情况时，他们就很难发挥最佳状态。我们希望与管理层坐下来，共同构建一个未来，让游戏作品和我们自己的工作条件都能尽可能强大。」

entries.en: Mike Daly: It was really important to us that you saw the damage, that you felt the damage, that you could tell Wolverine was in pain and he was hurting for all these things that were happening to him. The damage on his body reflects what his health is currently at. So you can sort of see it heal in real-time as he does his Healing Surges or his Last Stand, or he’ll heal rapidly once you complete a combat and he can focus all his energy on regeneration. And I can say a lot of work was put into building Logan's body in a way that can take lots of different types of damage all over and at a level of fidelity that holds up to our close, visceral camera.
entries.cn: Mike Daly：对我们来说，让玩家看到伤害、感受到伤害、能看出金刚狼正在承受痛苦，这非常重要。他身上的伤害反映了他当前的生命值。所以你可以看到他使用「治疗爆发」或「背水一战」时实时愈合，或者一旦你完成战斗，他就能集中所有能量进行再生，快速愈合。可以说，我们在构建罗根的身体上投入了大量工作，使其能够承受全身多种不同类型的伤害，并且细节精度足以匹配我们近距离、有冲击力的镜头。

entries.en: Now rage is also tied to another essential sort of Logan element of combat, which is his healing factor. When all of Logan's body energy is dedicated to fighting in combat, his healing factor is relatively slow, passively. And our Logan, if he takes enough damage, his healing factor is overloaded, his heart can stop, and that ends his healing. He will die. But if you have enough rage, the adrenaline surge can jumpstart your healing factor and let you do a Healing Surge to get back into battle.
entries.cn: 愤怒值还与罗根战斗的另一个核心要素——治疗因子——相关联。当罗根的全部体能都投入战斗时，他的治疗因子会相对缓慢地被动运作。在我们的游戏中，如果罗根受到足够多的伤害，治疗因子会过载，他的心脏可能停跳，从而终止治疗，他就会死亡。但如果你有足够的愤怒值，肾上腺素激增可以重新激活治疗因子，让你使用「治疗爆发」重返战斗。

entries.en: Bloomberg reporter Jason Schreier has said that while Microsoft-owned ZeniMax will suffer from today's cuts, it won't be left to work on Fallout and The Elder Scrolls only. Yes, Bethesda has The Elder Scrolls6 in the works, and the expectation is that there will be a focus on getting new Fallout games out the door. But ZeniMax studios will also work on Doom and Quake (id Software) and Wolfenstein (MachineGames). There's no mention of Indiana Jones, however, which suggests MachineGames will not get the chance to work on a sequel to the well-received Indiana Jones and the Great Circle.
entries.cn: 彭博社记者Jason Schreier表示，尽管Microsoft旗下ZeniMax会受到今天裁员的影响，但它不会只剩下开发《辐射》和《上古卷轴》。没错，Bethesda正在开发《上古卷轴6》，外界也预计其重点会放在推出新的《辐射》游戏上。但ZeniMax旗下工作室也会继续开发《毁灭战士》和《雷神之锤》（id Software），以及《德军总部》（MachineGames）。不过报道中没有提到《夺宝奇兵》，这意味着MachineGames可能不会有机会开发口碑不错的《夺宝奇兵：古老之圈》续作。

entries.en: I, for one, rarely spend any money at all in newer games, but I don't really think twice before buying a new mount or something in World of Warcraft. And that's where Unreal Engine 6 comes in. By creating this interconnected web of games through a common engine, you can buy skins and such in a new, smaller game, and know that those items will go with you when you inevitably move on to a different game. That means the devs of the smaller game get some extra cash, and it probably also means that Epic gets to enjoy a bunch of cosmetic skins they didn't have to actually make come to Fortnite, and still get a cut from their revenue.
entries.cn: 就我个人而言，很少在新游戏里花什么钱，但在《魔兽世界》里买新坐骑之类的东西时，我几乎毫不犹豫。而这正是虚幻引擎6发挥作用的地方。通过通用引擎打造出互联的游戏网络，你可以在某款较小的新游戏里购买皮肤等物品，并且知道当你不可避免地转向另一款游戏时，这些东西会跟着你一起走。这意味着小体量游戏的开发者能获得一些额外收入，也意味着Epic可以坐享一大堆无需自己动手制作就流入《堡垒之夜》的外观皮肤，同时从收入中抽成。

entries.en: "The pricing lands cheaper than many of the rumors," said Piers Harding-Rolls, games industry analyst at Ampere Analysis, referencing previous speculation that GTA 6 could sell for $90 or even $100. "I expected there to be some premium for GTA 6 because of its stature and if any game can charge $79.99 without a major backlash, it’s GTA. Many players that pre-order will opt for the Ultimate Edition at $99.99 meaning that the ‘$100 GTA 6’ is a reality. What is perhaps more of a surprise is the lack of early access for the Ultimate Edition – a common strategy to drive buyers to higher priced editions of the game. Also, there is no news on a Collector's Edition, but that might come later."
entries.cn: Ampere Analysis游戏行业分析师Piers Harding-Rolls提到之前的传言——有猜测称GTA6可能卖90甚至100美元，并表示：「这次定价其实比很多传闻要低。我原先就预计GTA6会有溢价，毕竟它的分量摆在那里。如果说哪款游戏敢卖79.99美元还不会引发大规模反弹，那只能是GTA。很多预购玩家会选择99.99美元的终极版，所以‘100美元的GTA6’已经成为现实。但比较让人意外的是，终极版居然没有抢先体验权——这本来是把玩家推向更高价位版本的常见手段。另外，目前也没有典藏版的消息，不过可能后续会有。」

entries.en: So where the hell was it last week ? entries.en: We should set aside flukes where a game didn't meet expectations of gamers and just look at more of the structural changes. And those are really appreciable, the fact that games are becoming increasingly multiplayer. And not just multiplayer but social, where you're getting together with your friends and then you're deciding what to do, what to play, and how to play it. This trend of the gaming economy shifting – some people like it and some don't – is going more and more towards buying things in games rather than buying games. In-game economy is driving gaming, especially at scale and especially over long durations as you see with these long-lasting multiplayer games.
entries.cn: 我们应该把那些未能满足玩家期待的游戏案例当成偶发事件放在一边，更多地去审视结构性变化。这些变化确实相当显著，比如游戏正变得越来越强调多人模式。而且不仅是多人模式，更是社交化——你和朋友们聚在一起，一同决定要做什么、玩什么、怎么玩。游戏经济转型的趋势——有些人喜欢，有些人不喜欢——正越来越转向在游戏内购买内容，而非直接购买游戏。游戏内经济正在驱动整个行业，特别是在大规模运营和长线运营中，就像那些长期运营的多人游戏所展现的那样。

entries.en: "The PC thing, in my mind at the time, was not to make money, frankly," said Layden. "It was, 'How do I get my intellectual property in front of people who wouldn't normally see it? How do I get the world of Horizon to be seen by people who aren't in the PlayStation world?' Not necessarily because they're going to buy a PlayStation, I wasn't that crazy. But as we take our [IP] across other media, whether it's into film, television, comic books, or whatever... you need to have as many eyeballs that are aware of this character [and] this story.
entries.cn: Layden说：「说实话，我当时觉得PC这件事不是为了赚钱。」「而是想，'我怎么才能让我的知识产权呈现在那些平时不会接触到的人面前？怎么让《地平线》的世界被PlayStation圈外的人看到？'不一定是因为他们会买一台PlayStation，我还没那么天真。但随着我们把IP推向其他媒体，无论是电影、电视、漫画还是别的什么……你需要尽可能多的眼睛来认识这个角色和这个故事。」

entries.en: Ascension takes place months after Kratos was manipulated into killing his wife and daughter by the Greek God of War Ares (more on this under the original God of War section below). Kratos, traumatized by the killings, refuses to honor the oath he swore to Ares, setting into motion the story of Ascension. Ares seeks revenge through the game’s antagonistic Furies, three beings tasked with punishing betrayal, whom Kratos must kill in order to free himself from his oath. The story ends with Kratos leaving his Spartan home behind, still tormented by his grief.
entries.cn: 《升天》的故事发生在奎托斯被希腊战神阿瑞斯操纵杀害妻女数月之后（更多细节见下文初代《战神》部分）。奎托斯因杀戮而深受创伤，拒绝履行他向阿瑞斯立下的誓言，从而引发了《升天》的故事。阿瑞斯通过游戏中的反派「复仇女神」来寻求报复，这三位女神负责惩罚背叛者，奎托斯必须杀死她们才能摆脱誓言。故事以奎托斯离开斯巴达家园告终，他仍被悲痛所折磨。

entries.en: Or maybe there's a third option — and the more I think about this problem, the more I come around to this as a solution — we just give up on Baldur’s Gate 4 entirely. Does Baldur’s Gate 3 even need a sequel? I’m not sure it does. I’m not sure it needs a TV adaptation that continues the story , either. Perhaps Hasbro would be better off doing to Baldur’s Gate what Larian is doing to Divinity and make a soft reboot. Baldur’s Gate 4 will face extremely tough comparisons with Baldur’s Gate 3. I’m not saying a Baldur’s Gate reboot wouldn’t, but it would perhaps take the pressure off, ever so slightly.

entries.en: "The $80 price for the Standard Edition is in line with our expectations and comes after multiple publishers have experimented with this price point with varying degrees of success," noted Daniel Ahmad, Director of Research & Insights at Niko Partners. "Given current macroeconomic conditions, only certain games and publishers can confidently price a title at $80, and Rockstar Games is one of them as players understand the value they'll receive from the title. We expect strong preorders, with day one sell-through exceeding $1.2 billion globally."
entries.cn: Niko Partners研究总监Daniel Ahmad指出：「标准版80美元的定价符合我们的预期，此前已有多家发行商尝试过这一价位，成败不一。以目前的宏观经济环境，只有特定游戏和发行商能把标准版定在80美元，而Rockstar Games正是其中之一，因为玩家知道自己能从这款游戏中获得怎样的价值。我们预计预购会非常强劲，发售当日全球实际销售收入将突破12亿美元（约合人民币82亿元）。」

entries.en: Everything from the MacBook Neo to the Apple Vision Pro has gone up in price on Apple's website , by as much as $200 for the latter. The MacBook Neo , which came out earlier this year for $599 as a way for Apple to take over some of the budget market from low-end Windows laptops and Chromebooks, went up by $100. The biggest price increase though, is the top-end Mac Studio with the M3 Ultra, which went up from $3,999 to $5,299 – a $1,300 jump.
entries.cn: 从MacBook Neo到Apple Vision Pro，苹果官网上的产品价格全面上涨，后者的涨幅高达200美元（约合人民币1362元）。今年早些时候以599美元（约合人民币4079元）发售的MacBook Neo，旨在帮助苹果从低端Windows笔记本和Chromebook手中抢占部分预算市场，如今涨价100美元（约合人民币681元）。不过，涨幅最大的还是搭载M3 Ultra的顶级Mac Studio，从3,999美元（约合人民币3万元）涨到了5,299美元（约合人民币4万元），整整涨了1,300美元（约合人民币8853元）。

entries.en: But in the years since, Rockstar’s games have gotten so much better on PC. entries.en: “For nearly 40 years, VGP has been committed to supporting physical media and preserving the value of physical game ownership,” reads a statement from VGP. “As part of that commitment, our company policy is that we do not carry physical products for video game consoles that contain only a digital download code. As a result, VGP will not be offering it for sale under our current company policy.”

entries.en: There are a few things worth unpacking here. Nishino’s mention of the PlayStation Portal and providing "experiences tailored to users’ play styles beyond the living room," could be taken as yet another hint at the long-rumored PS6 handheld or hybrid console . There’s also an acknowledgement that Sony will pass on some component cost increases to the consumer, and has done so already with those PS5 price rises. In short, gamers are going to have to take the hit here.

entries.en: "The handful of publishers who can charge $80 base share one trait: a captive, price-inelastic audience that won't shop around or wait for a discount. That's why Nintendo gets away with it, its players are locked in, first-party, and famously discount-averse. PlayStation could probably manage it on a marquee first-party title. FromSoftware has the brand strength to do it, even if they've historically priced more modestly than they could (Elden Ring is $80 on Switch, though). Maybe the big yearly sports games as well.
entries.cn: 「少数能把基础版卖到80美元的发行商都有一个共同点：他们拥有忠实且价格不敏感的用户群体，这些人不会货比三家或等着打折。正因如此，任天堂能做到这一点，它的玩家被牢牢锁定在第一方生态里，而且出了名的不爱等折扣。PlayStation或许也能在重磅第一方作品上做到这点。From Software有足够的品牌号召力去定这个价，尽管他们历来定价比应有的要克制（不过Switch版《艾尔登法环》倒确实是80美元）。也许那些大型年货体育游戏也能办到。」

entries.en: "We see much more variability in launch pricing now than we have seen historically in the video game industry," Circana senior director and analyst Mat Piscatella told IGN. "But I'm sure more games will start pushing towards the higher end of the price spectrum, especially given everything happening in the macro-economic environment. When Call of Duty 2 released at $59.99 on the Xbox 360 in 2005, other games quickly followed. Would these other games have gotten there at some point, anyways, even without Call of Duty 2? Sure. But having a big game prove the viability of the price point can help make pricing decisions a bit easier."
entries.cn: Circana高级总监兼分析师Mat Piscatella告诉IGN：「现在游戏首发定价的波动比我们以往在游戏行业所见的要大得多。但我相信，会有更多游戏开始向价格区间的高端靠拢，尤其是考虑到宏观经济环境中发生的一切。2005年《使命召唤2》以59.99美元（约合人民币409元）在XBOX 360上发售，其他游戏很快就跟进了。即使没有《使命召唤2》，这些游戏总有一天也会涨到这个价吗？当然。但有一款大作证明了这个价格点的可行性，无疑会让定价决策变得更容易一些。」

entries.en: Since you’re reading IGN, you already know and love video games, so I’ll save you the lengthy recap of why Ocarina of Time is so incredible. But let’s do the basics: It’s regularly near the top of every “Greatest Zelda Game of All Time” and “Greatest Video Game of All Time” lists. It revolutionized what a third person action-adventure game could look like, adding a whole new dimension to the rock-solid groundwork laid down by its 2D predecessor, A Link to the Past. Ocarina’s time jumping story is full of heart and humor, regularly engaging in epic conflicts, and between its meticulously crafted puzzle box dungeons and grand, sweeping vistas brimming with secrets and mysteries, it forever raised the bar for not only the Zelda series, but the medium of video games as a whole.

To think we might never get to see what that studio running on all cylinders could accomplish with a project built for the PS5 and PS5 Pro is yet another unforgivable sin of this industry’s obsession with squandering its most talented teams on things they are not best positioned to make. From Naughty Dog to BioWare, from Bethesda to Bluepoint, it’s seemingly never enough to be great, brilliant, or even completely unassailable at just one kind of thing.
entries.cn: 多种因素共同导致顽皮狗在理应蓬勃发展、占据主导地位的时候被迫「坐冷板凳」，这实在令人遗憾。想到我们可能永远看不到这家工作室全力运转、为PS5和PS5 Pro打造一款作品时能取得怎样的成就，这又是这个行业痴迷于将最有才华的团队浪费在他们并不擅长的事情上的又一不可饶恕之罪。从顽皮狗到BioWare，从贝塞斯达到Bluepoint，仅仅在某一种类型上做到出色、卓越甚至无可匹敌，似乎永远不够。

entries.en: Mike Daly: Yeah, for sure. We knew we needed to represent Logan's rage in combat as a major element of the character. entries.en: In answer to the question, “Where the hell is Naughty Dog?”: that’s easy. Santa Monica, California. And what it's doing there, undoubtedly, is cooking. Getting ready to make a huge comeback potentially on the next PlayStation. Building its expertise, its talent, and those crucial technical pipelines back up again ready to re-assert itself as king of the blockbusters for the next phase of triple-A. Games that actually shift consoles (what a concept!). Whether this hit-making institution can get back onto its perch, or surpass it, remains to be seen. With the best will in the world, it's not the same studio that it was during its golden era. I just hope it emerges strong from its current abyss.
entries.cn: 回答「顽皮狗到底去哪了？」这个问题：很简单。加州圣莫尼卡。而它在那里做什么？毫无疑问，在憋大招。准备在下一代PlayStation上强势回归。重新积累专业能力、人才和那些关键的技术管线，准备在下一阶段的3A游戏中重新确立自己作为爆款之王的地位。那些真正能带动主机销量的游戏（多么新奇的概念！）。这个爆款制造机能否重回巅峰，甚至超越过去，还有待观察。说句好听的，它已经不是黄金时代那个工作室了。我只希望它能从当前的深渊中强势崛起。

entries.en: Mike Daly: But yeah, the serious answer to your question is like, yeah, we think about that! Everybody knows this character to some degree, so early on in development, these questions came up all the time. How can we accurately represent this character when some people see him as truly, literally immortal? And everybody has kind of a different take. I think we have the benefit that his healing factor has taken many different forms over the many different media that he's encountered. And so we had a little bit of leeway to find the best fit for this video game that still was true to the character. And this is the one that we ended up on because basically it makes the game fun, while still giving you a chance to witness this insane regeneration factor up close.
entries.cn: Mike Daly：但说正经的，答案是：是的，我们考虑过！每个人对这个角色都有一定了解，所以在开发早期，这些问题经常出现。当有些人认为他真正意义上永生不死时，我们如何准确呈现这个角色？而且每个人的看法都不同。我认为我们的优势在于，他的治疗因子在不同媒体中有过多种不同表现形式。所以我们有一定的自由度，来找到最适合这款游戏、同时又忠于角色的方案。我们最终选择了这个方案，因为它基本上让游戏变得有趣，同时还能让你近距离目睹这种疯狂的再生能力。

entries.en: But because we're also publishing and making our own games, we can be a bit more selective about where we license to make sure that we're curating the maximum quality for each IP. We don't want to just shotgun things out there and flood the market. We really want to make sure that when people see a Turtles game or a SpongeBob game or whatever, that they see that and they associate quality with it. And that means that over time we will want to grow our first-party development. But I think if there's anything that the 2020s has taught us, it's don't get over your skis by being too acquisitive in this industry and just building up a giant war chest of studios without being prepared to manage them effectively, to guide them towards the right projects and make sure that you can bring those projects to market. So we're taking the mixed approach and then building very, very conscientiously.
entries.cn: 但因为我们也在发行和制作自己的游戏，我们可以更谨慎地选择授权对象，以确保为每个IP策划最高质量。我们不想像散弹枪一样到处乱发，充斥市场。我们真正想要的是，当人们看到一款忍者神龟游戏或海绵宝宝游戏时，他们能将其与品质联系起来。这意味着随着时间的推移，我们希望扩大第一方开发能力。但我认为，如果说2020年代教会了我们什么，那就是不要在这个行业过于贪婪，不要在没有准备好有效管理、引导正确项目并确保项目上市的情况下，就盲目收购一大堆工作室。所以我们采取混合方式，并且非常、非常审慎地建设。

entries.en: Current generation consoles have gone up in price, with Sony, Microsoft, and Nintendo struggling to cope with the component shortage fueled by the AI boom. Sony raised the price of PS5 consoles in April , bringing the cost of a standard PS5 to $649.99, the PS5 Digital Edition to $599.99, and the PS5 Pro to $899.99. entries.en: The Blood of Dawnwalker faces its own hurdles, too. This deeply ambitious RPG is helmed by the director of The Witcher 3, whose new studio Rebel Wolves includes multiple veterans of CD Projekt Red among its staff. The game looks great, but the busy period poses many threats. Will PlayStation owners want to embark on a 50-70 hour RPG when Wolverine is just around the corner? And will Geralt fans, now safe in the knowledge that there’s a brand new expansion for The Witcher 3 arriving next year , be willing to give this one a miss in exchange for some of September’s shorter offerings that can be completed before GTA arrives on the scene? Debut projects are often a make or break situation, and I really hope that being the first of the September games – arriving after what appears to be the classic long summer drought – plays in Dawnwalker’s favour.
entries.cn: 《黎明行者之血》也面临着自己的障碍。这款野心勃勃的RPG由《巫师3》总监领衔，他的新工作室Rebel Wolves拥有多位CDPR老将。游戏看起来很棒，但繁忙的档期带来了诸多威胁。PlayStation玩家会在《漫威金刚狼》即将到来之际，愿意投入一款50-70小时的RPG吗？而杰洛特粉丝们，在得知《巫师3》明年将迎来全新扩展包后，会愿意放弃这款游戏，转而选择9月那些能在《GTA6》到来前通关的较短作品吗？首秀项目往往是成败攸关的局面，真的希望作为9月第一款游戏——在经典的漫长夏季游戏荒之后到来——能对《黎明行者之血》有利。

entries.en: Sweeney : Yeah, exactly that. You know, gaming has always been driven by great games built by great development teams and that will continue to be the case. Every generation has had its stereotypical low quality games, from just plain old bad games to asset flips and now we’ll have AI slop. But in the hands of awesome professional creators and serious indies building a game, these tools are just an accelerant. And just as the industry moved from pixel art to Photoshop and then from 2D to 3D, these are just going to be ways to make content more efficiently and avoiding the drudgery of handwiring a giant blueprint and debugging really complicated problems in a program.
entries.cn: Sweeney：是的，正是如此。你知道，游戏行业一直由出色的开发团队打造的优秀作品推动，未来也依然如此。每一代都有其典型的低质量游戏，从纯粹的老式烂游戏到素材翻新，现在又会有AI烂作。但在优秀的专业创作者和认真的独立开发者手中，这些工具只是加速器。正如行业从像素画过渡到Photoshop，又从2D过渡到3D，这些工具只会使内容制作更高效，避免手工编写庞大蓝图的繁琐，以及调试程序中极其复杂的问题。

entries.en: GTA Online, which is certainly not going anywhere once GTA 6 launches, uses BattlEye Anti-Cheat, and that doesn’t play well with SteamOS because it needs kernel access. Now, Rockstar could, with its vast resources, probably get a workaround that runs on Linux. But, remember, this is the same company that says its core audience is console gamers. Even when the PC version inevitably comes out, I just don’t see Rockstar paying much mind to SteamOS compatibility issues.
entries.cn: GTA Online在《GTA6》推出后当然不会消失，而它使用的是BattlEye反作弊。这东西和SteamOS相处得并不好，因为它需要内核访问权限。Rockstar资源雄厚，理论上也许能弄出一个在Linux上运行的变通方案。但别忘了，这家公司说自己的核心受众是主机玩家。即便PC版最终不可避免地推出，我也不觉得Rockstar会太在意SteamOS兼容性问题。

entries.en: Everyone has a foundational memory of borrowing a video game and discovering a whole new world. For me, it was Fallout. My friend Joe lent me an Xbox 360 copy of New Vegas: Ultimate Edition – the base game plus all the DLC on one handy disc – and over a weekend I became absorbed in Obsidian’s post-apocalyptic mojave. Since then, Fallout has become one of my favourite franchises. That memory serves as a good reminder that video gaming is an inherently shared experience, and borrowing games from one another is the purest form of that. It’s saying “I loved this experience, and I think you will too.”
entries.cn: 每个人都有一段借来游戏、由此发现全新世界的记忆。对我而言，那款游戏是《辐射》。朋友Joe借给我一张XBOX 360版《辐射：新维加斯 终极版》光盘，里面包含本体和全部DLC；一个周末下来，我便沉浸在黑曜石打造的末日后莫哈韦荒原中。此后，《辐射》成为我最喜爱的系列之一。这段记忆提醒我们，电子游戏天生是一种共享体验，而互相借游戏是最纯粹的形式：它是在说「我喜欢这段体验，我觉得你也会喜欢」。

entries.en: Gavin Price: One immediate favourite was to turn characters off (Invisible Racers), shrink them (‘Mini Racers’ so the camera is low to the ground) and increase kart speeds. It immediately becomes very fast and unforgiving, feeling like playing F-Zero in first-person. I like bouncy collision too; it really makes choosing a character more strategic as the weight difference can have a real impact, and it’s fun to brute-force knock people out of the way, preferably into a nicely rendered nearby pool of water they sink in.
entries.cn: Gavin Price：一个立刻成为心头好的组合是关掉角色（隐形车手）、缩小角色（「迷你车手」，镜头贴近地面）并提高卡丁车速度。比赛瞬间变得极快且残酷，感觉就像第一人称的《F-Zero》。我也喜欢弹性碰撞，它让选角更具策略性，因为重量差异会有实质影响，把人粗鲁地撞开也很有趣，最好直接撞入旁边渲染精美的水池，让他们沉下去。

entries.en: For the corporate bootlickers in the back, we’ve read the legalese. You don’t need to parrot it back. We’re all aware of the insidious terms and conditions that companies apply to transactions for digital media in order to be able to snatch it away without consequence. We’re aware of the fact that, despite companies being clearly permitted to use words like “buy” and “purchase”, we’re only ever really leasing a license to access content – a license companies can revoke at their discretion.
entries.cn: 给那些替公司说话的人听清楚：法律条款我们读过了，不用你们复读。我们都知道，公司会把阴险的条款和条件加在数字媒体交易上，好让它们可以在不承担后果的情况下把内容夺走。我们也知道，尽管公司显然被允许使用「购买」这样的字眼，但我们实际得到的永远只是访问内容的一份许可，而这份许可可以由公司自行撤销。

entries.en: My take is that Sony is working on a number of PS6 options, each of varying price. I’m sure there will be a traditional home console version of the PS6, one that provides the most horsepower but also commands a premium price. But then I wouldn’t be surprised to see Sony offer a cheaper, less powerful PS6, as Microsoft has done with the Xbox Series S. On top of this, I suspect Sony is indeed working on a PS6 handheld that may work like the Switch. And then there’s a potential cloud gaming-powered next-gen PlayStation Portal, which is potentially the cheapest option of the lot.
entries.cn: IGN的看法是，索尼正在开发多种PS6方案，每种方案价格不同。我相信会有传统家用主机版本的PS6，它能提供最强性能，但价格也会更高。不过，如果索尼推出一款更便宜、性能较弱的PS6，我也不会感到意外，就像微软推出XBOX Series S那样。除此之外，我怀疑索尼确实正在开发一款可能像Switch一样运作的PS6掌机。然后还有一款可能由云游戏驱动的下一代PlayStation Portal，它或许是其中最便宜的选择。

entries.en: The influential strategy game about building and creating automated factories launched on Steam in early access form in February 2016, before launching proper in August 2020. It is a huge hit for Wube, one of those eternal Steam games with addictive gameplay mechanics, complex systems, and near infinite replayability. Factorio, which has seen superb support over the years, is credited with popularising the factory-building and automation genre on PC, and retains an ‘Overwhelmingly Positive’ user review rating on Valve’s platform.

entries.en: The Nintendo Switch 2 just ended its first 12 months on sale as the second fastest-selling hardware in U.S. history, behind only Nintendo's own Game Boy Advance. entries.en: The C++ programming model really requires expert level programming, and the great cleanup in Unreal Engine 6 is to adopt the Verse scripting language that we've been pioneering in Fortnite with the Fortnite creator community and bring that into UE6 as the primary way to develop gameplay code. So, it brings the ease of development and programming that you have in an engine like Unity or Godot together with the full power of UE6 on the high-end AAA feature-sets. And to tame complexity of the engine, the ability to prompt a lot of different systems, and have it help you create a particle system and tweak it; it’ll enable you to focus on the details that really matter rather than the boilerplate of creating and repeating the same rote actions over and over. It's going to be really freeing.
entries.cn: C++编程模型确实需要专家级编程水平，而虚幻引擎6的重大精简就是采用我们在《堡垒之夜》中与创作者社区一起开创的Verse脚本语言，并将其引入UE6，作为开发游戏逻辑代码的主要方式。这样一来，它既带来了类似Unity或Godot等引擎的开发与编程便捷性，又结合了UE6在高端3A功能集上的全部威力。为了驯服引擎的复杂性，能够向各种系统发出提示，并让它帮你创建粒子系统并进行微调，这将让你能够专注于真正重要的细节，而不是重复那些创建和循环的样板化操作。这将是非常解放的事情。

entries.en: Mike Daly: There are a lot of scenarios in the game where it is not possible to stealth your way all the way through. But generally speaking, when the enemies are unaware of you, there are ways you can get through the whole thing with stealth. Now that being said, being a super stealthy character through and through isn't necessarily our priority for Wolverine. He uses stealth when it's the most efficient way to get the job done rather than it being important that he doesn't get caught, because he doesn't really fear combat. So the choice of stealth or combat is always in the hands of the player. In all those scenarios, he can always jump into combat whenever he wants. Not just that, but in a way there's kind of a natural encouragement towards it, because when you get stealth kills, it is a great way to pre-build your rage meter in a way that doesn't decay. And so there's a growing incentive to go ahead and make a big splash into combat because you have so much of that momentum behind you already. So we leave the choice to the player to how they want to get through the combat setup. And usually the ideal route is striking some balance of a little bit of stealth and then finding the right moment to go all out and take out the rest.
entries.cn: Mike Daly：游戏中有很多场景无法全程潜行。但一般来说，当敌人没有察觉你时，你可以通过潜行完成整个部分。话虽如此，把金刚狼塑造成一个彻头彻尾的超级潜行角色并非我们的首要目标。他在潜行是最有效的方式时才会使用，而不是因为害怕被发现，因为他并不畏惧战斗。所以潜行还是战斗的选择始终掌握在玩家手中。在所有场景中，他随时都可以跳入战斗。不仅如此，某种程度上游戏还会自然鼓励你这么做，因为潜行击杀是预先积攒愤怒值的好方法，而且不会衰减。所以你会越来越有动力大张旗鼓地投入战斗，因为你已经积累了足够的势头。我们把选择权留给玩家，让他们决定如何应对战斗场景。通常理想的路线是平衡一下：先潜行，然后找到合适的时机全力出击，消灭剩下的敌人。

entries.en: Wassmer : Sure, we're building all the pipelines in Unreal to maximally preserve artistic intent. We gave the demos and you can see every step of the way. Our intention is, whatever gets built is a real Unreal scene that people can tweak and make exactly the way they wanted it to be rather than just typing into the prompt and trying a million times to get whatever pops out right. It's really meant to help people explore creatively more quickly, then settle in on the details of what they actually want, and then do the tweaks they need by hand right in the engine. So for us, it's human control all the way through the pipeline.
entries.cn: Wassmer：当然，我们在虚幻引擎中构建所有流程，以最大限度地保留艺术意图。我们做了演示，你可以看到过程中的每一步。我们的目的是，构建出来的任何内容都是一个真实的虚幻引擎场景，人们可以对其进行调整，完全按照自己的意愿来实现，而不是仅仅在提示框里输入文字，然后尝试无数次以求得到正确的结果。这旨在帮助人们更快地进行创意探索，然后确定他们真正想要的细节，最后直接在引擎中手动进行所需的调整。所以对我们来说，从始至终都由人掌控整个流程。

entries.en: The mainline series has never revisited the idea of the overworld, and thus the airship dream faded. While locations became more expansive, such as Final Fantasy 12 ’s sprawling deserts and 13’s late-game Gran Pulse region, these games followed FF10’s lead. Level environments fed directly into each other, forgoing the need for a world map. The games became more linear, much to Final Fantasy 13 ’s detriment in particular.

entries.en: For instance, a 9to5Google report this week covered "three [Amazon] listings that appear to be placeholders" published early, "with official images in tow." The listings, the outlet wrote, revealed the Pixel 11 in many colors with descriptions labeling them "Midnight," "Fuchsia," and "Moss." entries.en: “We expanded our studio system when we needed a pipeline of content to meet multiple strategies across subscription, streaming and devices,” she wrote. “In the process, we have found ourselves over extended as we executed on changing strategies in a landscape of more readily available content. entries.en: The decision to feature a dead music star so prominently in the game has raised a lot of eyebrows, especially after it came to light that Tupac's estate is managed by music executive Tom Whalley — a situation that has been the subject of legal disputes between Whalley and Tupac's family. However, IGN spoke with executive director and RGG studio head Masayoshi Yokoyama who addressed these concerns, and claimed that both Tupac's estate and family approved of his role in the game. Yokoyama also noted that Tupac isn't the first instance of the team using the likeness of a deceased actor.
entries.cn: 在游戏中如此突出地使用一位已故音乐巨星的决定已经引起了很多人的关注，尤其是在得知Tupac的遗产由音乐高管Tom Whalley管理之后——Whalley与Tupac家人之间一直存在法律纠纷。不过，IGN与执行董事兼RGG工作室负责人横山昌义进行了交谈，他回应了这些担忧，并声称Tupac的遗产管理方和家族都批准了他在游戏中的角色。横山还指出，Tupac并非团队首次使用已故演员的肖像。

entries.en: This mobile 2D sidescroller is officially part of the God of War canon, according to Sony Santa Monica animation director Bruno Velazquez . The gods, displeased with Kratos’s bloodlust, attempt to stop his latest conquest with Argos, a many-eyed giant that serves Hera, Queen of the Gods. Kratos is framed for the killing of Argos by an unidentified assassin in an attempt to further fracture his relationship with Olympus. Later, Zeus sends a messenger to put an end to Kratos’s continued destruction. Kratos responds with violence, once again defying the other gods. Betrayal leaves players with this message, setting up the events to come in God of War 2: “Soon, the fury of Zeus would rain down upon [Kratos].”
entries.cn: 据索尼圣莫尼卡动画总监Bruno Velazquez称，这款手机2D横版卷轴游戏正式属于《战神》正史。众神对奎托斯的嗜血不满，试图用百眼巨人阿耳戈斯阻止他最新的征服——阿耳戈斯是为众神之母赫拉服务的。奎托斯被一名身份不明的刺客陷害，被指控杀害了阿耳戈斯，旨在进一步破坏他与奥林匹斯的关系。随后，宙斯派出一名使者，要求结束奎托斯的持续破坏。奎托斯以暴力回应，再次违抗众神。《背叛》给玩家留下了这样的信息，为《战神2》中的事件埋下伏笔：「很快，宙斯的怒火将降临到[奎托斯]头上。」

entries.en: Revelation looks set to take the next step: turning that structure of hubs into a true open world. Quite how it will do this remains to be seen, as presumably it needs to unify the existing regions we explored through Rebirth – the likes of Junon, Corel, and Cosmo Canyon – with the many new areas its story will take us to, such as Wutai and the Mideel Archipelago. Any gaps between the existing hubs will need patching up, and then there’s the question of Midgar itself. Square needs to find a place for the Mako-powered city in all of this. But there’s no question that, when all brought together, it will create Final Fantasy's “most expansive open world yet,” as the trailer proclaims.
entries.cn: 《Revelation》看起来要迈出下一步：把这种枢纽式结构变成真正的开放世界。具体要怎么做还有待观察，因为据推测，它需要将玩家在重制版系列中探索过的现有区域——比如朱农、科雷尔和宇宙峡谷——与剧情将带我们前往的众多新地区（如五台和米迪尔群岛）统一起来。现有枢纽之间的任何空隙都需要填补，此外还有米德加本身的问题。史克威尔艾尼克斯必须为这座魔晄动力城市在这一切中找到一席之地。但毫无疑问，正如预告片所宣称的那样，当所有这一切汇聚在一起时，将打造出《最终幻想》「迄今为止最广阔的开放世界」。

entries.en: The Verge added onto the news cycle by reporting that Microsoft is exploring a new disc-to-digital feature. This would allow users to put a disc into their console and gain a digital license for the game, giving them the ability to play it without a disc. If the owner gives the disc to someone else, that entitlement then transfers to the new player. This essentially means you can't resell or loan your physical copy to a friend if you want to keep the digital version. The discs will still work as normal if you choose not to digitize it.
entries.cn: The Verge随后补充报道称，微软正在探索一种新的光盘转数字功能。该功能允许用户把光盘放入主机，并获得该游戏的数字许可，从而无需光盘即可游玩。如果拥有者把光盘交给其他人，这份权益就会转移给新玩家。这本质上意味着，如果你想保留数字版，就不能把实体版转卖或借给朋友。如果你选择不把光盘数字化，光盘仍会照常工作。

entries.en: It’s been a rollercoaster Early Access ride for Palworld since it arrived on Steam priced $30 and launched straight into Game Pass on Xbox and PC in early 2024, breaking sales and concurrent player number records in the process. Pocketpair boss Takuro Mizobe has said Palworld's launch was so big that the developer couldn’t handle the massive profits the game generated . Still, Pocketpair acted swiftly to capitalize on Palworld’s breakout success, signing a deal with Sony to form a new business called Palworld Entertainment that’s tasked with expanding the IP. It later launched the game on PS5.

entries.en: PlayStation isn’t alone in this – Nintendo’s game-key cards for the Switch 2 and Xbox’s over-reliance on Game Pass reflect an industry-wide shift toward a digital-only future. And it’s not just the publishers either – developers must bear some responsibility for injuring physical’s future, too. Over 22% of IO Interactive’s 007 First Light European sales were physical , which is a significant statistic in and of itself and a clear sign of a viable physical market. Except IO Interactive shipped a physical disc containing only the first mission , requiring players to download a hefty day one patch to actually make the game they purchased playable. What value does a physical disc have if it becomes just a download key? At least it can be borrowed by a friend, but its use for any owner disintegrates the moment something happens to the servers that First Light is stored on.
entries.cn: PlayStation并非唯一如此：任天堂为Switch 2推出的游戏钥匙卡，以及XBOX对Game Pass的过度依赖，都反映了整个行业向纯数字未来转变。责任也不只在发行商，开发者同样要为实体游戏的未来受损承担一部分责任。IO Interactive的《007 初露锋芒》欧洲销量中超过22%来自实体版，这个数字本身意义重大，也清楚证明实体市场仍然可行。然而IO Interactive发行的实体光盘只包含第一项任务，玩家必须下载体积庞大的首日补丁，才能真正游玩所购买的游戏。如果实体光盘只是下载密钥，它还有什么价值？至少可以借给朋友，但一旦存储《007 初露锋芒》的服务器出问题，光盘对任何持有者的用途都会随之消失。

entries.en: Kurosaki and Minkoff left Naughty Dog not long after Amy Hennig’s departure, during a creative shakeup that left the directors of The Last of Us as the studio’s new figureheads. And the pair joined Infinity Ward – a 25 minute drive down the road – at a time when the Call of Duty developer had been in the wilderness. entries.en: “I’ll talk through what we were going with there,” Brown tells IGN. “I’m not going to ding any other games in particular, because this actually applies to quite a few games, but I guess traditionally the presentation has a bit museum-like. Where the car, no matter its age, will be presented in a way that is completely pristine. Which then creates a problem that it’s so perfect that it doesn’t alway sit in the scene in a way that makes sense. Like, you’d be driving it around a place that looks like a real city or real countryside, with this museum-quality 60-year-old car driving around.
entries.cn: 「我来谈谈我们的设计思路，」Brown告诉IGN，「我不打算特别批评任何其他游戏，因为这个问题其实适用于不少作品。但我觉得传统上，车辆的呈现方式有点博物馆化——无论车龄多大，都以完全崭新的状态展示。这就产生了一个问题：它太完美了，以至于无法合理地融入场景。比如，你开着一辆博物馆级别的60年老车，行驶在看起来像真实城市或乡村的地方。」

entries.en: Fallout was never properly pitched to Interplay’s superiors. The publisher was distracted by shinier prospects: sports games, an online division, and a newly won Dungeons & Dragons license. While nobody was watching, the Fallout team instilled its game with a pervading moral greyness, and a commitment to mapping the consequences of player actions. It simulated drug addiction, and blowing up NPCs with dynamite. It introduced a faction of militant hoarders called the Brotherhood of Steel. The resulting RPG was decidedly odd - and only once it became an unexpected hit did Interplay start to consider Fallout a hot property.
entries.cn: 《辐射》从未正式向Interplay高层提案。发行商正忙于更光鲜的项目：体育游戏、在线部门和刚取得的《龙与地下城》授权。无人关注时，团队为游戏注入贯穿始终的道德灰度，并坚持呈现玩家行为的后果。游戏模拟毒瘾，允许用炸药炸死NPC，还引入了名为钢铁兄弟会的武装囤积者阵营。成品RPG显得格外古怪；直到意外走红后，Interplay才把《辐射》视为热门资产。

entries.en: “Just to give a sense of the ambition of where we’re going with this – I’m obviously very well-invested in car culture and automotive entertainment, and really aware that historically there’s always been these huge tentpole franchises that have propped up and pushed car culture forward,” says Brown. “There was that spell where Need for Speed – from Need for Speed Underground, Underground 2, and Most Wanted – was the number one best-selling game in the world, like, three years running. There was that period where Top Gear was the most-watched TV show and, in film, even though it’s not the biggest film franchise in the world, the Fast & Furious series is one of them. It’s made more money than Harry Potter; it’s made more money than Batman. And that is the level of ambition for Clutch, to set the tone for car culture across the next decade, and be that tentpole IP that drives culture forward.”
entries.cn: 《Clutch》志在竞速品类中掀起巨浪。「为了让大家了解我们的雄心——我显然对汽车文化和汽车娱乐投入颇深，并且深知历史上总有那些巨大的支柱系列支撑并推动着汽车文化向前发展，」Brown说。「曾经有一段时间，《极品飞车》——从《极品飞车：地下狂飙》、《地下狂飙2》到《最高通缉》——连续三年成为全球最畅销游戏。还有一段时期，《Top Gear》是收视率最高的电视节目。在电影领域，尽管《速度与激情》系列不是全球最大的电影系列，但它也是其中之一。它赚的钱比《哈利·波特》还多，比《蝙蝠侠》还多。这就是《Clutch》的野心：为未来十年的汽车文化定下基调，成为推动文化前进的支柱IP。」

entries.en: “There’s always potential, especially once our meta starts to get more established,” he told us. “Who knows where we're going to push the game? There's all sorts of crazy opportunities. But one of the things we ran into is, once we shipped, our focus has been all about solidifying the foundation of the game. And so now that we're in a pretty solid state, now is the time for us to push things. We're like, ‘Hey, guess what? We've got a pretty solid roster of characters. We can push some new mechanics and ideas.’ And Universa and Immortal are the perfect opportunity for that.”
entries.cn: 他告诉我们：「游戏总有潜力可挖，尤其是在我们的对战环境趋于稳定之后。谁知道我们会把游戏推向何方？各种疯狂的机会都有可能。但我们也遇到过一个情况，就是游戏发售后，我们的重点一直都在于巩固游戏的基础。所以现在基础已经相当稳固了，正是我们推进新内容的时候。我们就像是说，‘嘿，猜猜怎么着？我们已经有了一套很扎实的角色阵容，可以推出一些新机制和新点子了。’而Universa和Immortal就是实现这一点的绝佳机会。」

entries.en: Destiny fans have shown up in droves to send off the beloved sci-fi shooter. Although Destiny 2's servers will remain active for the foreseeable future, the game won't be getting any new content going forward. The game's final update was released today and at the time of writing, the game's 24-hour concurrent player count on Steam has peaked at 167,000. This is the highest Destiny 2 player count since the release of 2024's The Final Shape, the last paid expansion for the game, which peaked at 314,000 players.

entries.en: There's also this lingering feeling that turn-based RPGs have had a resurgance in recent years. By no means did they ever go away – look at the continued success of Atlus RPGs (Persona, Metaphor, Shin Megami Tensei) and Square Enix's own (Octopath Traveler and Dragon Quest remakes). And let's not forget Baldur's Gate 3 is part of this wave. Plenty of independent games kept the spirit alive as well with the likes of Sea of Stars, Chained Echoes, Dosa Divas, and the ongoing saga of Deltarune, just to name a few. However, there's no denying that the mainstream spotlight is brighter than it has been with last year's critically acclaimed, award-sweeping Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. So, with that momentum in the genre and bringing it back to Final Fantasy, I also asked Nakashima and Furuya about their perspective on the sort of renaissance we're seeing with turn-based RPGs.
entries.cn: 有一种挥之不去的感觉是，回合制RPG在近年来迎来了复苏。它们当然从未真正消失——看看Atlus RPG（《女神异闻录》《暗喻幻想：ReFantazio》《真·女神转生》）以及史克威尔艾尼克斯自家作品（《歧路旅人》和《勇者斗恶龙》重制版）的持续成功就知道了。也别忘了《博德之门3》也是这股浪潮的一部分。众多独立游戏同样让这种精神得以延续，例如《星之海》《宿命残响》《Dosa Divas》以及仍在更新的《三角符文》，凡此种种，不胜枚举。然而，不可否认的是，随着去年备受好评、横扫各大奖项的《光与影：33号远征队》的出现，回合制RPG的主流聚光灯比以往更加耀眼。于是，趁着这股类型大势，我将话题拉回《最终幻想》，询问中岛启辅和古屋海斗如何看待我们正在经历的这场回合制RPG复兴。

entries.en: To potentially answer that question, look no further than the soon-to-be-released Switch 2 remake of Star Fox 64 . Not only is Star Fox also a beloved N64 game that has been ported to various Nintendo consoles, it also got a Nintendo 3DS remake in 2011. Like the Ocarina 3DS remake, it largely stuck to the original game’s blueprint while adding brand new graphics and dual screen features. And while the Star Fox franchise has never come close to Zelda’s popularity, the parallels across Ocarina of Time and Star Fox 64’s journey from the N64 to the 3DS to the Nintendo Switch 2 are fascinating to see.
entries.cn: 要回答这个问题，只需看看即将推出的《星际火狐64》Switch 2重制版。不仅《星际火狐》也是一款备受喜爱的N64游戏，并移植到了多款任天堂主机上，它同样在2011年获得了Nintendo 3DS重制版。与《时之笛》3DS重制版类似，它基本沿用了原版游戏的框架，同时加入了全新画面和双屏功能。尽管《星际火狐》系列的人气从未接近《塞尔达》，但思考《时之笛》和《星际火狐64》从N64到3DS再到Nintendo Switch 2的历程，其相似之处令人着迷。

entries.en: In Red Dead Redemption 2, you can only have two large weapons (rifles, shotguns, etc.) and two handguns. If there isn't a physical way for your character to hold the weapon, it stays on your horse. It's more realistic and forces the player to be more conscious of their loadout, something that has been divisive with players over the years. This is also radically different from the way GTA handles it, as GTA 5 allows you to carry dozens of weapons in your pocket. However, fans have been wondering which inventory system GTA 6 will utilize, and it seems like it may be Red Dead Redemption 2's, based on the inclusion of a weapons locker.
entries.cn: 在《荒野大镖客：救赎2》中，你只能携带两把大型武器（步枪、霰弹枪等）和两把手枪。如果你的角色没有物理方式携带某把武器，它就会留在你的马上。这种设计更真实，也迫使玩家更留意自己的装备配置，多年来玩家对此褒贬不一。这与《GTA》的处理方式截然不同，因为《GTA5》允许你在口袋里携带几十种武器。然而，粉丝们一直想知道《GTA6》会采用哪种物品系统，而根据武器柜的加入来看，很可能就是《荒野大镖客：救赎2》的那种。

entries.en: Schofield didn't give an explicit reason for his retirement, but he has had a successful 35-year run in the industry. After beginning as an artist, Schofield climbed the ranks before becoming a producer at EA, where he contributed to James Bond and Lord of the Rings games. After his work on Bond, EA gave him the freedom to create a brand-new IP: Dead Space. With the team at Visceral Games, Schofield built one of the scariest video games ever created, and its impact has had a lasting ripple effect. Although it took inspiration from titles like Resident Evil, it was fresh, unique, and most importantly, utterly terrifying.
entries.cn: Schofield没有明确说明退休原因，但他已在行业中成功奋斗35年。他从美术师起步，一路晋升为EA制作人，参与过詹姆斯·邦德和《指环王》游戏。在完成邦德项目后，EA给予他创作全新IP的自由，这便是《死亡空间》。Schofield与Visceral Games团队打造了史上最恐怖的游戏之一，其影响延续至今。虽然作品从《生化危机》等游戏汲取灵感，但它新鲜、独特，最重要的是极其恐怖。

entries.en: “Thematically, I don't think you're going to see anything that different,” reveals Ueda. “Having said that, the way I've approached building my previous games is that every single time I start creating a world and what lives in it, the goal is that it doesn't exist in reality, but it's as if it does, and the layers that come on top of it make that work, right? It's really grounded in the reality that is in that world, and so I would want for players to, at the end of the experience, remember it 10 years later, and ask themselves, ‘Does that world still exist? What is going on in that world? What if it did exist?’”
entries.cn: 「不过，我过去制作游戏时一直遵循一个原则：每当我创造一个世界，以及生活在其中的事物时，我的目标都是让它看起来并不存在于现实之中，但又仿佛真实存在。所有后续叠加上去的细节，都是为了支撑这种真实感。这个世界必须遵循属于它自己的现实逻辑。因此我希望玩家在通关十年后，仍会回想起它，并问自己：‘那个世界现在还存在吗？那里究竟发生了什么？如果它真的存在会怎样？’」

entries.en: But on top of that, the developers at Larian are just amazing at what they do, their writers the best in the business, their quest designers the envy of the video game industry. Baldur’s Gate 3 is a masterpiece but it is also truly unique, with more content than any single player could ever hope to see. Most developers are not in the position to make a game like Baldur’s Gate 3. None, other than perhaps Rockstar, has the time, resources, or the freedom to make the sort of creative decisions that went into Baldur's Gate 3. Baldur’s Gate 3 is a single-player role-playing game that could last you forever, and truly, there are none in the modern era quite like it.
entries.cn: 除此之外，Larian的开发者们在自己擅长的领域里就是出类拔萃：编剧是业界顶尖，任务设计师让整个游戏行业艳羡。《博德之门3》是一部杰作，同时也真正独一无二，其内容之多，任何单个玩家穷极一生都难以尽览。大多数开发商并不具备制作《博德之门3》这样一款游戏的条件。除了Rockstar，恐怕没有别的公司拥有制作《博德之门3》所需的时间、资源或创作自由度。《博德之门3》是一款能让你一直玩下去的单人角色扮演游戏，而在现代游戏里，真正与之相仿的作品可以说绝无仅有。

entries.en: Now, amid new Xbox CEO Asha Sharma’s “reset” of Microsoft’s gaming business, the future of Game Pass is unclear. Microsoft cut 1,600 staff from Xbox earlier this month, with another 1,600 to go this financial year. Sharma has pulled Call of Duty out of Game Pass as a day-one launch title, and is doubling down on Xbox’s biggest franchises, such as Fallout. Four studios are confirmed to be leaving Microsoft ownership, with another on its way. Sharma has called it the most “significant” restructure in Xbox history, insisting Microsoft’s gaming business “is not healthy.”

entries.en: Ultimately, the reason the Ryse series ended up in limbo is because Crytek refused to sell the IP to Microsoft. As a result of this impasse, the two parted ways, and Crytek switched focus to other projects.

entries.en: Baldur’s Gate was BioWare’s second game, releasing on PC in 1998 and published by Interplay. It did well enough to spawn a sequel, 2000’s Baldur's Gate II: Shadows of Amn, which like its predecessor took place in the Forgotten Realms. Both original games use an isometric perspective and pausable real-time gameplay, with the player controlling up to six characters. Could the remakes follow Baldur’s Gate 3’s lead and go for fully turn-based combat? Or maybe a hybrid system is in order.
entries.cn: 《博德之门》是BioWare的第二款游戏，于1998年在PC上发行，由Interplay发行。游戏表现足够出色，催生了续作——2000年的《博德之门2：安姆的阴影》，与前作一样，故事发生在被遗忘的国度。两款原作都采用等距视角和可暂停的实时制玩法，玩家最多可控制六名角色。重制版会效仿《博德之门3》，采用完全回合制战斗吗？或者也许应该采用一种混合系统。
