entries.en: Another Xbox Games Showcase, another no-show from The Elder Scrolls VI . Yes, we know it’s in development — Bethesda chief Todd Howard pops up to reassure fans every now and then. But the unescapable fact is this is a game that was announced eight years ago, on June 10, 2018, with a teaser trailer and we’ve not seen anything of it since. It also means that the wait between the announcement of The Elder Scrolls VI and now is longer than the wait between the release of The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim and the announcement of The Elder Scrolls VI itself. We don’t even know the name of the game, or where in the fantasy world it’s set. Information-starved GTA 6 fans don’t know how good they’ve got it!
entries.cn: 又一场Xbox游戏展示会，又一次《上古卷轴6》缺席。是的，我们知道它正在开发中——贝塞斯达老大陶德·霍华德时不时会冒出来安抚粉丝。但无法回避的事实是，这款游戏早在八年前（2018年6月10日）就通过一段预告片公布了，此后我们再也没有看到任何实质内容。这也意味着，从《上古卷轴6》公布至今的等待时间，已经超过了从《上古卷轴5：天际》发售到《上古卷轴6》公布之间的间隔。我们甚至连游戏的名字都不知道，也不知道它设定在奇幻世界的哪个角落——《GTA6》粉丝根本不知道自己有多幸福！

entries.en: “I was super stoked to do a Viking game,” recalls Peter Gornstein, Ryse’s art director and director of cinematics. For one, the opportunities were endless: a game about Vikings could have taken players on raids along the English and French coasts, the shores of Newfoundland, and even the city of Constantinople, where they served as bodyguards to Byzantine emperors. It was also uncharted territory – at least back then. The History Channel’s Vikings TV show was still on its first season, and Assassin’s Creed Valhalla nearly a decade away.
entries.cn: 《崛起》的艺术总监兼过场动画导演Peter Gornstein回忆：「我当时特别想做一款维京游戏。」这种题材的可能性无穷无尽：玩家可以沿英格兰和法国海岸、纽芬兰海岸展开劫掠，甚至前往君士坦丁堡；维京人曾在那里担任拜占庭皇帝的护卫。至少在当时，这还是一片未开拓的领域：历史频道剧集《维京传奇》仍在播第一季，《刺客信条：英灵殿》则要近十年后才会问世。

entries.en: So that's the first big AAA project that we greenlit and that we've been working on. entries.en: This generation, console manufacturers gave players the choice on how they buy their games. If you are uninterested in discs, you can buy digital-only variants of both Xbox Series X and PS5. entries.en: Final Fantasy returning to turn-based combat through the upcoming Final Fantasy Resonance is a pretty big deal, even if you were just going off the reception to its initial reveal. Many folks, including myself, are thrilled to see the series' name attached to a game with an HD-2D art style and have the story of Brave Exvius get adapted in the form of Resonance. In my exclusive hands-on preview of Final Fantasy Resonance , I experienced first-hand just how its rethinking turn-based combat with a stagger system, the Job-like Visions, and intricate party customization. And I got to dig deeper into its inspirations, namely Final Fantasy V, in a conversation with producer Keisuke Nakashima and director Hiroto Furuya .
entries.cn: 《最终幻想》系列通过即将推出的《最终幻想 RESONANCE》回归回合制战斗，本身就是一件相当轰动的大事，光从初次亮相的反响就能看出端倪。许多玩家（包括我在内）都兴奋地看到，这款采用HD-2D美术风格的游戏冠以《最终幻想》之名，并将《勇气启示录》的故事改编成了《RESONANCE》。我与制作人中岛启辅和总监古屋海斗进行了交谈，更深入地了解到本作的灵感来源。

entries.en: But there’s no denying the fact that this is an era of many blunders, whichever platform or publisher you look at, and one of the most significant of these is the industry’s pervasive obsession with Games as a Service. A mad, decade-long scramble where everyone and their dog wanted to make the next Destiny, or seemed obligated to even if they didn’t. Even Naughty Dog, a studio so keenly devoted to its signature craft of cinematic action adventures, got caught up in this folly.
entries.cn: 但不可否认，无论你看哪个平台或发行商，这都是一个充满失误的时代，其中最大的失误之一就是整个行业对服务型游戏的普遍痴迷。一场疯狂的、长达十年的争夺战，每个人都想做出下一个《命运》，或者即使不想也似乎有义务去做。就连顽皮狗——这家如此专注于其标志性电影化动作冒险工艺的工作室——也陷入了这场愚蠢的浪潮。

entries.en: It's a tradition as old as video games themselves. Selling games or trading them in to either make some money back on your purchase or make buying new games cheaper has been a valuable option for gamers for decades. entries.en: "This organisation was introduced in the original Code: Veronica and was active behind the scenes in several other games including RE4 before mysteriously vanishing," TheBatman begins. "Since then we’ve had one surprising reference in RE7 and a few teases in Requiem, but Capcom have always refrained from going into any major detail about them. Concept art refers to H.C.F. as Hive/Host Capture Force in reference to Wesker’s mission to capture Alexia Ashford and the t-veronica virus, so there is some suggestion they are a special forces team belonging to a larger organisation. RE: Veronica is the ideal opportunity to really clarify who they are and solidify any links to The Connections from the more recent games as we know they worked together on the Mutamycete project."
entries.cn: TheBatman首先解释道：「这个组织最初在《代号维罗妮卡》原版中登场，并在包括《生化危机4》在内的多部作品中暗中活动，随后神秘消失。后来在《生化危机7》里有一个出人意料的提及，在《生化危机 安魂曲》中也有数次暗示，但卡普空始终避免详细展开。概念图显示H.C.F. 指的是Hive/Host Capture Force，即蜂巢/宿主捕获部队，暗示他们是一支隶属于某个更大组织的特种部队。考虑到威斯克的任务就是捕获亚历克西娅·阿什福德和T-维罗妮卡病毒，所以有推测认为H.C.F. 是一支特别行动队。《生化危机 维罗妮卡 重制版》正是澄清这个组织真面目以及确定它和新作中The Connections之间联系的理想机会，毕竟我们已经知道他们合作进行过Mutamycete项目。」

entries.en: WWDC, or the Worldwide Developer's Conference is typically where we see all the updates that'll be coming to iOS, macOS, tvOS and all the other disparate Apple operating systems for the next year or so. Just like any other year, the bulk of the show was focused on iOS 27, but after the divisive changes, like Liquid Glass, that came to iOS 26 last year , the company focused on refining its operating systems. There weren't many hot new features announced, but there just didn't need to be.

entries.en: The 1666: Amsterdam Prologue is available now for free via Epic Games Store and Steam, where it sits with a 'Mixed' user review rating. "They use gen AI in many places," reads one user review. "Pictures inside the game, assets and even the promo key art is generated. I'm de-wishlisting it and ignoring the company." entries.en: “It always pops out of the scene in a way that doesn’t feel real. You could never actually see that car, on a road, looking like that; it would never exist that way. The way it’d actually exist would be there’d be dust, there’d be little bits of build-up, there’d be carbon around the exhaust. There’d be little bits of wear here and there. If you looked inside it there’d be wear on the steering wheel where someone’s driven this and gripped it, and the leather would be sagging on the seats. Maybe there’d be sun damage on the leather if it’s a soft top. Once you start to layer in all those bits of detail, a thing just looks that much more real and loved.”
entries.cn: 「它总是以不真实的方式跳出场景。你在路上永远看不到那样一辆车；它根本不可能以那种状态存在。真实的样子应该是：有灰尘、有污渍堆积、排气管周围有积碳、到处都有磨损痕迹。往车里看，方向盘上会有驾驶者抓握的磨损，座椅皮革会松弛下垂。如果是敞篷车，皮革可能还有日晒损伤。一旦你开始叠加所有这些细节，东西就会看起来更真实、更有人情味。」

entries.en: But what happens after the Year 4 DLC characters are all released? With Street Fighter 6 now in its fourth year, some are wondering how much life it has left. entries.en: Yooka-Laylee Kart pits eight racers against each other in a heated race around courses themed after locales from the main games. In an attempt to adopt a look that is a bit of a blend of Nintendo’s 16- and 64-bit eras, Yooka-Laylee’s maps are colorful, flat tracks decorated with 3D assets outside of the tracks. The racers themselves, like my GOAT, Trowzer the Snake, appear as 3D models rendered with a filter to give the sense of pixel art. entries.en: Sharma sent shockwaves through the video game industry with her now infamous “reset” memo, in which she revealed that Microsoft's gaming business has a 3% accountability margin (assumed to mean profit margin). "Excluding Activision Blizzard King, over the past five years, we have spent over $20 billion on ongoing investments in our content, platform, and hardware subsidy, but our annual revenue has declined nearly half a billion during that time. Going forward, this cannot continue," Sharma said.
entries.cn: Sharma那封如今臭名昭著的「重置」备忘录震动了整个电子游戏行业。她在备忘录中透露，微软游戏业务的问责利润率为3%（外界认为这指的是利润率）。Sharma说：「不包括动视暴雪和King，过去五年里，我们在内容、平台和硬件补贴的持续投资上花费超过200亿美元，按当前汇率约合人民币1360亿元，但同期我们的年收入却下降了近5亿美元，约合人民币34亿元。往后，这种情况不能继续。」

entries.en: Sweeney : It's the cumulative set of optimizations that have been done. We have Fortnite back on mobile, we're putting a lot of effort into optimizing the engine so that a developer can ship a game and run on everything from the highest end hardware all the way down to low-end Android and several-year-old iPhones. Over time, we've also come to an increasing appreciation of the need to make the engine automatically scale much more of the content in the game. It's always been the case that with enough effort and trickery, a developer could make their game run on low-end devices. But the more our systems like Nanite can automatically scale, the better. That's going to be a source of ongoing attention.
entries.cn: Sweeney：「这是累积优化后的结果。我们把《堡垒之夜》带回了移动平台，我们正在投入大量精力优化引擎，让开发者能做出从最高端硬件一路跑到低端安卓和好几年前的iPhone上的游戏。随着时间的推移，我们也越来越认识到，需要让引擎能自动缩放游戏中更多的内容。以前，只要有足够的努力和巧思，开发者总能设法让游戏在低端设备上运行。但像Nanite这样的系统能自动缩放的内容越多，效果就越好。这将是我们会持续关注的方向。」

entries.en: Zelnick went on to discuss the long wait for GTA 6 — and painted the gap between releases in the series as something of a strength. Unlike other video game publishers, Zelnick said, he had ensured that Take-Two had never tried to annualize its franchises (outside of its sports games). In other words, he wasn't trying to replicate Activision's demands for an annual Call of Duty blockbuster, or Ubisoft's past push for annual Assassin's Creed adventures.
entries.cn: Zelnick随后谈到《GTA6》漫长的等待——并把系列发售之间的间隔描述为一种优势。他表示，与其他游戏发行商不同，他始终确保Take-Two除体育游戏外从不让旗下系列年货化。换言之，他不会效仿动视每年都要推出一部《使命召唤》大作，也不会像育碧过去那样把《刺客信条》变成年货。

entries.en: Marcus Smith: I would just add one more thing that was a deciding factor in this, which is the relentlessness of the character himself. It's such a true, core element of Logan that what makes him so heroic is that he feels everything along the way and he keeps going. And so we couldn't show that without showing damage, without showing that violence and everything on him as well. So it wasn't just he’s going to inflict a lot of damage because he's got these razor sharp, unbreakable claws. Obviously that's true, but it's also part of the core essence of the character we're trying to show.
entries.cn: Marcus Smith：我想补充一个决定性因素，那就是角色本身的坚韧不拔。这是罗根真实的核心特质——他之所以如此英勇，是因为他一路感受一切，却依然继续前行。如果不展现伤害、暴力和他身上的伤痕，我们就无法表现这一点。所以这不仅仅是因为他有锋利的、坚不可摧的爪子而能造成大量伤害。显然那是对的，但这也是我们试图展现的角色核心本质的一部分。

entries.en: It feels redundant to say at this point that the games industry is in unprecedented times, but it really is – at the convergence of unaffordable consumer hardware, development studios getting shuttered, and AI getting pushed onto everything in between; this is where we are. With Unreal Engine being so ubiquitous as the framework for which some of the biggest games are made, Epic and its tech has a major role in stewarding the games industry, as fallible as they may be. We talked about all that in the following interview, which you can read or watch below.
entries.cn: 如今再说游戏行业身处前所未有的时代可能有些老套，但事实确实如此——买不起的消费者硬件、不断关停的开发工作室，以及被强加到一切事物中的AI，这几股力量汇聚在一起，这便是我们当下的处境。鉴于虚幻引擎作为许多最大规模游戏的开发框架无处不在，Epic及其技术在管理游戏行业方面扮演着重要角色，尽管他们也难免有失误。我们在以下采访中聊到了所有这些话题，你可以阅读或观看下文。

entries.en: Different people will interpret Ueda's games in different ways, such is the intention of his art. But one universal feeling amongst those who play his games is that sense of awe — whether it be the first time you rode up to a colossus in 2005 or came face-to-face with a giant bird-dog called Trico in 2016. That certainly looks set to continue if Gen Atlas’s reveal trailer is anything to go by. Spectacle is littered across each and every frame. A sense of scale has always been something Ueda has attempted to convey, as part of his greater quest to establish human connection through even the most rudimentary of sensations: that “wow” feeling.
entries.cn: 不同的人会以上田的方式解读他的游戏，这正是他艺术创作的意图。但所有玩过他游戏的人都有一个共通的感受，那就是敬畏感——无论是2005年你第一次策马靠近巨像，还是2016年与你面对面那只名叫特里克的巨大鸟犬，这种感觉始终贯穿于他的作品之中。如果《gen Atlas》的公布预告片能说明什么，那这种感觉肯定会延续下去。每一帧画面都洒满了奇观。尺度感一直是上田试图传达的东西，作为他更宏大追求的一部分：通过最朴素的感觉来建立人与人的联结，而这一切的起点，其实只是最原始、最简单的一种情绪——那种「哇」的感觉。

entries.en: "My coworkers just want to focus on making amazing games for players," said Veneto. "They do not want to spend every day worrying about whether another round of layoffs is coming. It drains away the energy we should be using to be creative. We want layoffs to be treated not as a quick fix to a quarterly balance sheet, but only as an absolute last resort. But if they're truly unavoidable, we are asking Microsoft for common sense protections around layoffs and a real effort to lessen the burden on affected employees, not only for the workers at the bargaining table, but for everyone who will be affected by Xbox layoffs. Our game developers deserve that."
entries.cn: 「我的同事只想专注于为玩家制作精彩的游戏，」Veneto说，「他们不想每天担心下一轮裁员是否会来。这消耗了我们本应用于创作的精力。我们希望裁员不被视为季度资产负债表的快速修正，而只是绝对的最后手段。但如果真的无法避免，我们请求微软提供关于裁员的常识性保障，并真正努力减轻受影响员工的负担，不仅是为了谈判桌上的员工，也是为了所有将受到XBOX裁员影响的人。我们的游戏开发者值得这样的待遇。」

entries.en: 2025’s bayou-set adventure game, South of Midnight, had stunning art direction and received solid enough reviews, but it seemed to fly under the radar. That’s not an unusual situation for Canadian studio Compulsion Games – its previous title, BioShock-ish survival game We Happy Few, never quite set the world alight in the way its initial trailer suggested it had the potential to. And its debut game, Contrast, is perhaps better remembered for being the very first PS4 game included in PlayStation Plus than for its own achievements. Unfortunately, such a history seems to have put the studio in danger: it is one of the three developers reportedly planned for closure . While we didn’t expect a sequel to South of Midnight, since all of Compulsion's games have been original creations, this does mean there’s little chance of the studio creating something new.
entries.cn: 2025年的冒险游戏《午夜之南》拥有惊艳的美术风格，也获得了相当不错的评价，但它似乎并未引起太多关注。这对加拿大工作室Compulsion Games来说并不异常——它的上一部作品、类似《生化奇兵》的生存游戏《少数幸运儿》，也从未像最初的预告片所展现的那样引起轰动。而它的处女作《Contrast》，或许更多地是因为它是首款加入PlayStation Plus的PS4游戏而为人所知，而非其自身的成就。不幸的是，这样的历史似乎让工作室陷入了危险：它是三家据报道计划关闭的开发商之一。虽然我们并未指望《午夜之南》推出续作，因为Compulsion的所有游戏均为原创IP，但这确实意味着该工作室几乎不可能再创造全新的作品了。

entries.en: It's also important to keep in mind that while the GPU in the DGX Spark looks impressive on paper, it will be stapled to an ARM processor. While it's likely that Nvidia will be able to work out the compatibility quirks with its nearly unlimited resources, ARM processors haven't traditionally been great for PC gaming. Even with the launch of Copilot+ laptops back in 2024 , there were a ton of games that I couldn't even get to run on Qualcomm's chips, because they were built for an x86 platform. Only time will tell if Nvidia is able to work around that problem, but even if it does, I wouldn't exactly go out and get a RTX Spark-powered system as a gaming laptop .
entries.cn: 同样需要注意的是，尽管DGX Spark中的GPU从纸面规格来看相当亮眼，但它将与一颗ARM处理器绑定在一起。凭借近乎无限的资源，英伟达很可能有能力解决兼容性方面的小问题，但ARM处理器传统上并不擅长PC游戏。即便Copilot+笔记本早在2024年就已经推出，当时仍有大量游戏甚至无法在高通芯片上运行，因为这些游戏是为x86平台打造的。英伟达能否绕过这个问题，还需要时间来证明；但即使它真的做到了，我也不会真的把一台搭载RTX Spark的设备当作游戏笔记本来购买。

entries.en: "I think a lot of publishers are about to learn that the hard way," Rhys Elliot, head of market analysis at Alinea Analytics, said. "GTA 6 has more pricing power than any game on earth, and it still didn't go above $80. If the biggest release in the industry's history looked at the ceiling and chose not to break it, that should tell everyone else the ceiling is real, and they’ll smack their head on it. The danger is that publishers read 'GTA is $80' as a green light and push their own run-of-the-mill or new-IP games to $80, when the lesson is the opposite: even GTA didn't think it could go higher.
entries.cn: Alinea Analytics市场分析主管Rhys Elliot表示：「我觉得很多发行商很快就会吃这个亏。《GTA6》拥有地球上最强的定价权，但它的售价都没超过80美元。如果业界史上最大的发售作品看看天花板后选择不捅破，那其他人就该明白，天花板真的存在，而且撞上去会很疼。危险在于，发行商会把‘GTA卖80美元’解读成放行信号，然后也把自己那些平庸之作或新IP提到80美元，但事实恰恰相反：连GTA都不觉得自己能定更高的价。」

entries.en: God of War’s Norse-set masterpieces has cemented it as one of PlayStation’s most iconic franchises . Born during the PS2 era, the God of War franchise made a name for itself with excellent action gameplay, an intriguing tale of divine revenge, and a memorable lead in the Spartan demigod Kratos. 20 years later, God of War has grown into gaming’s seminal action-adventure series, blending that increasingly fine-tuned action with deeper lore and a stronger narrative hook, anchored by an older, more empathic Kratos.

entries.en: For decades, Sony first party studio Naughty Dog absolutely dominated the conversation when it came to triple-A console gaming. The studio’s talent for creating expressive, endearing, beloved characters and putting them in deadly jungles (there's almost always a deadly jungle), gorgeously rendered at the absolute technical limits of whatever the hardware of the day could manage, has long been the envy of game developers everywhere. It's fair to say that the studio's output has been instrumental in the establishment and ongoing success of Playstation as a platform synonymous with the big budget single-player action-adventure.
entries.cn: 几十年来，索尼第一方工作室顽皮狗在主机3A游戏领域始终是话题中心。这家工作室擅长塑造生动可爱、深受喜爱的角色，将他们置于致命的丛林（几乎总有一片致命丛林）中，并以当时硬件极限的华丽画面呈现，长久以来令全球游戏开发者艳羡。可以说，顽皮狗的作品对PlayStation作为高预算单人动作冒险代名词的平台建立与持续成功，起到了关键作用。

entries.en: First-person horror games are some of our favorite kind, as they bring the scary stuff right in front of your character's eyes. In Black Lake, developer Polydin Studio ups that ante by setting this spooky psychological/survival horror game not just in an abandoned orphanage in search of your missing twin sister, but one that's abandoned and floating at sea. It's in development for PC and consoles, with the PC version due out in Winter 2027 and the console versions expected to follow in mid-2027. Check out the first trailer above and the first screenshots in the gallery below.
entries.cn: 第一人称恐怖游戏是我们最喜欢的类型之一，因为那些恐怖的事物会直接呈现在角色眼前。在《黑湖》中，开发商Polydin Studio进一步加码：这款心理与生存恐怖游戏不仅让玩家在废弃孤儿院寻找失踪的双胞胎妹妹，孤儿院本身还漂浮在海上。游戏正面向PC和主机开发，PC版预计2027年冬季推出，主机版预计于2027年年中发售。

entries.en: Since the Steam Machine came out, its performance has been, well, heavily discussed online, to say the least. It’s not hard to see why some folks are skeptical of Valve's little PC – it does cost $1049 to start and is slightly slower than the PS5 most of the time. In spite of that, though, Rockstar’s last couple of PC launches, namely and the Enhanced Edition of Grand Theft Auto V, have been monuments to the scalability of PC games. So the Steam Machine might be more capable of handling everyone’s favorite crime simulator better than you might think.
entries.cn: 自Steam Machine推出以来，它的性能在网上被热烈讨论，这么说已经算含蓄。有人怀疑Valve这台小PC并不难理解：它起售价1049美元（约合人民币7133元），而且多数时候性能弱于PS5。尽管如此，Rockstar最近几次PC发行，尤其是《GTA5 增强版》，都证明了Rockstar在中低配设备上的优化能力。所以，Steam Machine处理这款大家最爱的犯罪模拟器的能力，可能比你想象中更强。

entries.en: This idea is brought violently home by two notable enemies, Sekhmet and Begtse. The latter, a colossal red dude, is the Mongolian god of war. He’s so metal that his name comes from a Mongolian word for armor, and his role seems to be as a sort of afterlife bouncer for Sekhmet. As for her, she’s a big deal in Egyptian mythology rather than just another god of war, associated with plagues, vengeance, medicine and the sun. She was created by Ra, Egypt’s ruler of the Earth, sky, and underworld, to punish humanity, but got way too into it and nearly wiped them all out. God of War Laufey seems to be really leaning into the whole psycho mean girl element, and I'm here for it.
entries.cn: 这一理念通过两个著名的敌人——塞赫美特（Sekhmet)与贝格策(Begtse)——得到了暴力体现。后者是一个巨大的红色家伙，是蒙古战神。他如此金属，名字来自蒙古语中「盔甲」一词，他的角色似乎是塞赫美特在来世的保镖。至于塞赫美特，她在埃及神话中举足轻重，不仅仅是另一个战神，还与瘟疫、复仇、医学和太阳有关。她是由埃及的天地冥界统治者拉（Ra）创造出来惩罚人类的，但她过于投入，差点把人类全部消灭。《战神：劳菲》似乎非常强调这种疯狂刻薄女孩的元素，我很喜欢。

entries.en: GTA 6's lack of a disc appears to be a security measure from Rockstar Games in order to prevent leaks and control access to the game ahead of launch. entries.en: It’s also worth noting recent reports that Sony may have to delay the release of the PS6 to 2028 or even 2029 as a result of the AI-fueled chip crisis. In January, an analyst report suggested that Sony may push the launch of the PS6 beyond 2028 and lengthen the PS5 lifecycle . David Gibson, senior analyst at MST international who focuses on game and tech companies, predicted that “rising memory prices will not impact short-term performance thanks to Sony’s existing inventory.” However, he noted that increased memory costs could become an issue for Sony in the next fiscal year (ending in March 2027), saying “Sony might pass future cost increases onto consumers.”

entries.en: With that said, Housemarque is aware that it operates in its own niche, but has seen how that has worked for a studio like FromSoftware. Founded in 1986 and initially focussed business software, FromSoftware released its first action RPG, King's Field, back in 1994 on the original PlayStation. After two more King's Field games, the studio established the long-running mecha series Armored Core and developed a variety of other action RPGs throughout the late '90s and 2000s. However, it was 2009's Demon's Souls and the subsequent Dark Souls trilogy that would prove to be the studio's true breakout hits, setting the stage for the even more successful Bloodborne and Elden Ring. It was a slow rise to prominence, and one that meant FromSoftware didn't become a household name among gamers until decades after the studio was established.
entries.cn: 话虽如此，Housemarque明白自己是在一个细分领域里运作，但也看到了这对From Software这样的工作室是如何起作用的。From Software成立于1986年，最初专注于商业软件，1994年在初代PlayStation上推出了首款动作角色扮演游戏《国王密令》。在又推出两款《国王密令》游戏后，该工作室开创了长盛不衰的机甲系列《装甲核心》，并在整个90年代末和2000年代开发了多种其他动作角色扮演游戏。然而，真正让工作室实现突破的是2009年的《恶魔之魂》以及随后的《黑暗之魂》三部曲，这为之后更成功的《血源诅咒》和《艾尔登法环》铺平了道路。这是一条缓慢崛起之路，意味着From Software在成立数十年后才成为玩家们家喻户晓的名字。

entries.en: It’s far from the only solution, though. One alternative direction would be for players to seek out third-party alternatives to get their discs, like boutique publishing houses. Limited Run Games , Fangamer and Super Rare Games are just some of the companies whose mission statement is clear: to take digital games out of your console, and put something real back into your hands. Limited Run Games initially began with humble indie game origins and have since expanded to work with the likes of Capcom and SEGA, proving the feasibility of these companies to scale their operations to meet traditional brick-and-mortar publishers’ expectations. If PlayStation’s lack of disclosure over cutting disc production to its triple-A publishing partners is true, it could well be those same partners have just as strong a desire to continue physical publishing as their fanbases - making for a potentially very bright future for these boutique publishing houses (provided a disc drive add-on is made available for the PS6 – something you’d hope would happen, considering Sony’s extensive disc-based back catalog and the continued production of physical media movies).
entries.cn: 这远非唯一解决方案。另一个方向是玩家通过精品发行商等第三方渠道获得光盘。Limited Run Games、Fangamer和Super Rare Games等公司使命明确：把数字游戏从主机中带出来，把真实物品重新放进玩家手中。Limited Run Games最初从规模不大的独立游戏起步，后来已扩展至与卡普空和世嘉等公司合作，证明这类公司能够扩大业务，满足传统实体发行商的期望。如果PlayStation确实没有向3A级发行合作伙伴披露削减光盘产量，那么这些伙伴继续实体发行的愿望可能和粉丝一样强烈，精品发行商的未来或许十分光明——前提是PS6提供外接光驱；考虑到索尼庞大的光盘游戏旧目录及实体电影媒体仍在生产，人们当然希望如此。

entries.en: “For this reason, we designed PS Portal as a dedicated device to reliably deliver the PlayStation gaming experience, which is predicated on controller-based gameplay and a large screen. Because it is difficult to provide a sufficiently high-quality experience through smartphone touch controls or a PC’s keyboard and mouse, our cloud strategy is not to rapidly expand to smartphones and PCs, but rather to focus on environments where quality can be assured.
entries.cn: 「因此，我们将PS Portal设计为一款专用设备，用于稳定提供PlayStation游戏体验，而这种体验以手柄操作和大屏幕为前提。由于通过智能手机触控操作或PC的键盘鼠标很难提供足够高质量的体验，我们的云战略并不是快速扩展到智能手机和PC，而是专注于能够确保质量的环境。」

entries.en: It comes into play in a few major ways where, as you get towards the middle of the meter, your combos become more powerful. And so, you have an incentive to play more aggressively, because in addition to doing damage faster, the rage starts to decay a little bit. If you work through that and build it up towards the top of the meter, then... you saw him go into this aggressive, really feral tier of rage where he can get kills really quick. He's able to do moves called Critical Strikes, where he just impales enemies with real brute force to take them out quickly. But at that level, his rage also drains very quickly. So there's a strategic aspect of choosing your targets, not worrying about defense, and being as aggressive as possible in order to sustain it and get as many enemies as you can before it runs out.
entries.cn: 愤怒值在几个主要方面发挥作用：当它达到计量条中间时，你的连招会变得更强大。因此，你有动力打得更激进，因为除了更快造成伤害外，愤怒值还会开始缓慢衰减。如果你继续积攒，把它推到计量条顶端，那么……你看到他会进入一个极具攻击性的狂野愤怒层级，能非常快速地击杀敌人。他可以使用名为「暴击」的招式，用蛮力直接刺穿敌人，迅速解决战斗。但在这个层级，愤怒值也会快速消耗。所以这涉及策略性：选择目标，不必担心防御，尽可能激进地维持愤怒值，在它耗尽前尽可能多地消灭敌人。

entries.en: "I think when you're creating any product in the entertainment industry, there's going to be criticism," he said. "You can't really say, 'don't criticize us' that just doesn't make sense. Criticism is a freedom that people are free to have. But, this is something that we thought was a good idea. That this would be something that would add value to our game, which is why we chose to do this. I mean, we had a similar issue with this when we announced the casting of Sugawara as well. He's obviously a very famous actor in Japan, and there were a lot of people who responded saying like, 'maybe you should have left him alone.' For Tupac, he's a person who's well known outside of Japan, and we expected those voices. But in the end, we are creating something we think people will enjoy and like. We think it's something that will add value to the game we're making. So, we have no real regrets or worries about what we're doing.
entries.cn: 「我认为，当你在娱乐行业创作任何产品时，都会有批评，」他说，「你不能真的说‘不要批评我们’，这根本说不通。批评是人们拥有的自由。但，这是我们认为是好主意的事情。这会给我们的游戏增加价值，这就是我们选择这样做的原因。我的意思是，当初我们宣布使用菅原文太的肖像时，也遇到过类似的问题。他显然是日本非常著名的演员，有很多人回应说‘或许你们不该打扰他’。对于Tupac，他是个在日本以外广为人知的人，我们预料到了这些声音。但最终，我们在创造我们认为人们会喜欢和享受的东西。我们认为这会为我们制作的游戏增加价值。所以，我们对正在做的事情没有真正的遗憾或担忧。

entries.en: Will Oblivion Remastered eventually get some love? Oblivion Remastered, overall, seems like a big success for Bethesda, which contracted Virtuos to help remake its much-loved role-playing game using Unreal Engine 5. It’s seen over 9 million players , and Howard himself told IGN in December that the studio was “really, really pleased with how well it did.” So it seems somewhat odd that the game hasn’t seen an update in so long. Oblivion Remastered launches for the Nintendo Switch 2 on August 11, 2026, so perhaps we'll see a big update for all versions then.

entries.en: "We know Claire ultimately joins TerraSave so can her role be adjusted slightly to accommodate this? Perhaps the organisation was established, and she joined prior to the events of RE: Veronica? These kinds of changes can easily be implanted without breaking canon.I also suspect Capcom will find a way to get The Connections into this story. As I mentioned above it could be a case of retconning them to be the rival company, in which case that would by default put them in Resident Evil 4 and strengthen ties to the later games. Unlike Raccoon City, the events of Code: Veronica are quite standalone so there is a lot of flexibility to restructure and remix the storyline whilst still preserving the core events that ensures continuity with the later sequels."
entries.cn: 「我们知道克莱尔最终加入了TerraSave，那么能否稍微调整她的角色来配合这一点？也许这个组织在此期间成立，而她在《生化危机 代号维罗妮卡》事件之前就加入了？这类改动很容易植入，而且不会违背正史。我还觉得卡普空会想办法把The Connections也牵扯进这个故事。正如我前面提到的，可以吃书将他们设定为那家敌对的公司，这样他们自然也会出现在《生化危机4》中，并加强后续作品的关联。与拉昆市的剧情不同，《代号维罗妮卡》的事件相对独立，因此在重组和混合故事线时有很大灵活性，同时仍能保留保证后续续作连续性的核心事件。」

entries.en: "There are certain games that can get away with charging more than the standard $69.99 and GTA 6 is one of them," Harding-Rolls continued. "Mario Kart World also pulled it off. Publishers will be aware that some games get a pass at this level while others are likely to face a consumer backlash. As such, I don’t think this means that all AAA games will be priced at $79.99 for the standard edition moving forward. Many players spend more than that on Deluxe and Ultimate editions anyway to get early access to games or unique in-game items, so for enthusiasts the standard edition pricing is not a factor."
entries.cn: Harding-Rolls继续说：「确实有些游戏敢定得比69.99美元的标准更高，GTA6就是其中之一，而《马力欧卡丁车世界》也成功做到了。发行商都明白，有的游戏定这个价能过关，有的则很可能引发玩家反弹。因此，我不认为这意味着今后所有3A大作的标准版都会标价79.99美元。反正许多玩家在豪华版或终极版上花的钱早就超过这个数了，为的是抢先体验或独占道具，对核心粉丝来说，标准版定价其实并不是关键因素。」

entries.en: Fast-forward to last week's Summer Game Fest Showcase and The Wolf Among Us 2's THIRD reveal. The difference this time: they actually showed the game behind closed doors as proof of life. Yes, I've seen it. It's real, and it's now running on Unreal Engine 5. It still retains the same comic book-style look the original did, but it's running on modern tech that should result in clean performance on most platforms. Oh, and while The Wolf Among Us 2 will still be structured episodically, it will be released all at once as one single 8-12 hour game.

entries.en: Really, you just have to look at how many smaller multiplayer games have gone live within the last year or two, only to fizzle out and die with little to no fanfare. Just look at something like Exoprimal or Concord for an example. Sweeney's explanation of this does make some sense. After all, it's hard to get motivated to buy a bunch of cosmetic junk in a game that you don't know if it will live for more than a few months, but the math looks a lot different for a game that you've played for years and you know isn't going anywhere.

entries.en: This is hardly the first time something like this has happened. The Xbox version of Black Myth: Wukong was delayed by a year and it was heavily rumored that it may be due to difficulties developing for the consoles. Microsoft responded to these rumors noting that it had not been informed of such troubles, but developer Game Science later suggested those rumors may have had some truth to them. Game Science CEO Yongar Feng-Ji noted in January 2025 that the Xbox Series S' 10 GBs of shared memory was creating issues with optimization . When the game was eventually released on Xbox , the studio confirmed that the delay was a result of spending extra time trying to optimize the game specificially for Xbox.
entries.cn: 这已经不是第一次出现类似情况了。《黑神话：悟空》的Xbox版本延期了一年，当时有大量传闻称原因在于主机开发困难。微软回应称并未收到此类问题的报告，但开发商游戏科学后来暗示这些传闻可能并非空穴来风。游戏科学CEO冯骥在2025年1月指出，XSS的10GB共享内存给优化带来了问题。当游戏最终登陆Xbox时，工作室确认延期是因为花费了额外时间专门针对Xbox进行优化。

entries.en: With Destiny in its own hands, Bungie self-published the game, but it couldn't escape financial troubles and layoffs as Destiny 2 expansions failed to hit the mark and the player base dwindled. entries.en: Then there’s the suggestion that sales are proceeding as planned despite these price rises. Data from the U.S. perhaps suggests otherwise. As IGN reported last week, May was a catastrophic month for PlayStation and Xbox sales in the U.S. , driven by price rises that have clearly had a significant impact on consumer interest in buying a new console. According to new Circana data, PS5 spending fell 43% year-on-year, and unit sales plummeted 58%. In fact, PlayStation hardware unit sales fell to their lowest May total since May 2000, and Xbox hardware unit sales were the lowest ever recorded for a May month in the U.S.
entries.cn: 而且，尽管有这些涨价，销售仍按计划推进的说法也存在。但美国的数据或许显示出相反情况。正如 IGN 上周报道的那样，5月对美国PlayStation和XBOX的销售而言是灾难性的一个月，涨价显然已经对消费者购买新主机的兴趣产生了重大影响。据 Circana最新数据，PS5消费支出同比下降43%，销量暴跌58%。事实上，PlayStation 硬件销量跌至自2000年5月以来的同期最低水平，而XBOX硬件销量则创下美国有史以来5月单月的最低纪录。

entries.en: The idea, on the surface, is to get rid of the barriers between different games, letting you use skins and other cosmetics that you buy in other Unreal Engine 6 games in Fortnite, and vice-versa. entries.en: Shawn Kittelsen: That's the trick. I started my career working on the Arkham games at DC Comics. That's how I got connected to NetherRealm and WB Games in the first place. I think we don't want to treat any of these as just opportunities to bring something that people know to games. It's cultural stewardship for us. It's, what's the best way to bring this to an audience? I think The Last Ronin comics are some of the best books of the last five, 10 years, but even so there's only an audience that's so big for comics. And when we bring the story to games, I hope that it drives a lot more people back to the comics and go back and rediscover that story in the comics, because we're going to be pushing towards such a big global audience. So we're very excited about what we can do with this one.
entries.cn: Shawn Kittelsen：这就是诀窍。我的职业生涯始于DC漫画公司，参与过《阿卡姆》系列游戏。这也是我最初与NetherRealm和华纳游戏建立联系的原因。我认为我们不想把这些仅仅视为将人们熟悉的东西带到游戏中的机会。对我们来说，这是文化管理。问题是：将这个故事带给观众的最佳方式是什么？我认为《最后的浪人》漫画是过去五到十年里最好的作品之一，但即便如此，漫画的受众规模也是有限的。当我们把这个故事带到游戏中时，我希望它能驱使更多人回到漫画中，重新发现漫画里的故事，因为我们将面向一个巨大的全球受众。所以我们对此非常兴奋。

entries.en: While I maintain a library of physical games I love – and I regularly browse charity stores and my local CeX for hard copies of things I know I’ll enjoy having stashed on a shelf – allow me to qualify that I have indeed purchased and downloaded many digital games over the decades, via console and PC storefronts. Provided they always remain available to redownload – even if delisted from sale – it’s a compromise I’ve been willing to concede, for now. Credit where credit’s due, it’s been a pretty workable arrangement to date. For instance, when the disc tray on my Xbox 360 turned to dust during the production of a recent racing game retrospective I put together to celebrate IGN’s 30th anniversary, I found myself pulling down 20-year-old, long-delisted DLC on a replacement console without much fuss.
entries.cn: 我自己保有一批喜爱的实体游戏，也经常去慈善商店和本地CeX淘那些我知道会乐意摆上架子的实体盘。不过也要说明，过去几十年里，我确实通过主机和PC商店购买并下载过很多数字游戏。只要它们始终可以重新下载，哪怕已经从商店下架，这暂时还是我愿意接受的一种妥协。该给的肯定还是要给。到目前为止，这套安排还算能运转。比如，我最近为了庆祝IGN三十周年做一篇赛车游戏回顾时，我的XBOX 360的光驱托盘彻底报废了，但我还是能在替换主机上相当顺利地那些下载20年前、早已下架的DLC。

entries.en: Whoever plays it next – whenever it’s played next – the beloved experience remains the same. A physical copy of a game is frozen in amber: they can never change. It’s the only way games like Grand Theft Auto 4, Alan Wake, and Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 1 & 2 can maintain their original and often iconic music licenses – publishers can’t hijack them and remove the classic tracks because their deals expired.
entries.cn: 无论下一个游玩者是谁、何时游玩，那份被喜爱的体验都保持不变。实体游戏就像凝固在琥珀中，永远不会改变。只有这种方式，才能让《GTA4》《心灵杀手》和《托尼·霍克职业滑板1+2》等游戏保留原汁原味且往往已成经典的授权音乐；发行商无法因为协议到期而夺走它们并删除经典曲目。

entries.en: The next barrier we faced when we were bringing them back for these characters for these roles was their voice, right? We probably couldn't replicate their voices with AI if we went for it, but we're a studio that has really valued acting, not just movie acting but also drama acting. And we're really careful about the voice actors we chose in the past as well. So, we wanted to focus on getting a real person to put their own spin on that character. We didn't want to have them just do an imitation of that character, we wanted them to try to bring out that character's personality, but with a different voice. So, we did our best to pick an actor that would fit the role and fit that character, and some of these people might be related to them or have some sort of relationship to them.
entries.cn: 我们在让这些角色回归时面临的下一个障碍就是他们的声音，对吧？我们或许可以用AI复制他们的声音，但我们是一家非常重视表演的工作室，不仅是电影表演，还有戏剧表演。过去我们在选择声优方面也非常谨慎。因此，我们专注于找一位真人演员来对这个角色进行自己的演绎。我们不希望他们只是模仿那个角色，我们希望他们尝试带出角色的个性，但使用不同的声音。所以，我们尽力挑选适合这个角色和人物的演员，有些人可能与角色有关联或某种关系。

entries.en: They do not want to spend every day worrying about whether another round of layoffs is coming. It drains away the energy we should be using to be creative. We want layoffs to be treated not as a quick fix to a quarterly balance sheet, but only as an absolute last resort. But if they're truly unavoidable, we are asking Microsoft for common sense protections around layoffs and a real effort to lessen the burden on affected employees, not only for the workers at the bargaining table, but for everyone who will be affected by Xbox layoffs. Our game developers deserve that.
entries.cn: 他们不想每天担心下一轮裁员是否会来。这消耗了我们本应用于创作的精力。我们希望裁员不被视为季度资产负债表的快速修正，而只是绝对的最后手段。但如果真的无法避免，我们请求微软提供关于裁员的常识性保障，并真正努力减轻受影响员工的负担，不仅是为了谈判桌上的员工，也是为了所有将受到XBOX裁员影响的人。我们的游戏开发者值得这样的待遇。

entries.en: Rockstar leads the industry in the games we create. We believe it can also lead the industry in how it treats the people who make them. There is so much that is special about the studio and the work we put out. We want to protect that. When people are confronted with pay disparities, excessive overtime or a lack of flexibility in arrangements, they are not in the best position to do their best work. We want to sit down with management and build a future where both the games and the conditions of the people who make them are as strong as possible.
entries.cn: Rockstar在游戏创作上引领行业。我们相信，它也能在如何对待游戏制作者方面引领行业。这个工作室和我们产出作品中有太多特别之处，我们想要保护这一点。当员工面对薪资差异、过度加班或安排缺乏灵活性的情况时，他们就很难发挥最佳状态。我们希望与管理层坐下来，共同构建一个未来，让游戏作品和我们自己的工作条件都能尽可能强大。

entries.en: There's that moment in the reveal where she gets the sword and then she pops the soul out of that character, and you get that great slow-mo to see that there is a power even beyond what was shown before that she has. And it is only going to grow and evolve inside of this world. It's that idea that in the realms that we've explored, in Greece and in the Norse realms, magic is part of the air. It exists all around us. Its density is a certain amount in these realms. And when we get to the Everywhen, the density of magic is amplified by like a thousand.
entries.cn: 在演示中，有一个时刻她拿到剑，然后她把那个角色的灵魂抽出来，你看到那个精彩的慢动作，发现她拥有甚至超越之前展示的力量。而且这种力量只会在这个世界中成长和进化。这就是我们在希腊和北欧领域探索过的理念：魔法是空气的一部分，存在于我们周围。在这些领域中，魔法密度是固定的。而当我们到达万古时，魔法密度被放大了大约一千倍。

entries.en: We already have had a character like Tupac, who had passed away before the game was made [the character Genzo Iwaki with the likeness of actor Bunta Sugawara]. He's a really famous actor in yakuza movies and Japanese film history. But it's kind of the same situation, he's this famous actor who passed away. But we made sure that we talked to his estate and family and got their permission; not just their permission, but we talked to them about what we wanted to do. They not only said okay, but they were really excited about the opportunity. We wanted to give their characters a role that would do other justice to the people themselves as well. If we didn't, we think that would be extremely rude, so we definitely wouldn't have done it otherwise. So we did our best to make sure that any role we create for these characters would honor them and their families.
entries.cn: 我们之前已经有过类似Tupac的角色，即在游戏制作前就已去世的人物（角色岩木 源造使用了演员菅原文太的肖像）。他是日本黑道电影和电影史上非常著名的演员。情况很相似，他是一位已故的著名演员。但我们确保与他的遗产管理方和家人沟通并获得许可；不仅仅是许可，我们还与他们讨论了我们想做的事情。他们不仅同意了，而且对这次机会非常兴奋。我们希望赋予他们的角色一个能公正对待他们本人的角色。如果我们做不到，我们认为那将极其无礼，所以我们绝对不会那样做。因此我们尽最大努力确保为这些角色创造的角色能够荣耀他们和他们的家人。

entries.en: We know Claire ultimately joins TerraSave so can her role be adjusted slightly to accommodate this? Perhaps the organisation was established, and she joined prior to the events of RE: Veronica? These kinds of changes can easily be implanted without breaking canon.I also suspect Capcom will find a way to get The Connections into this story. As I mentioned above it could be a case of retconning them to be the rival company, in which case that would by default put them in Resident Evil 4 and strengthen ties to the later games. Unlike Raccoon City, the events of Code: Veronica are quite standalone so there is a lot of flexibility to restructure and remix the storyline whilst still preserving the core events that ensures continuity with the later sequels.
entries.cn: 我们知道克莱尔最终加入了TerraSave，那么能否稍微调整她的角色来配合这一点？也许这个组织在此期间成立，而她在《生化危机 代号维罗妮卡》事件之前就加入了？这类改动很容易植入，而且不会违背正史。我还觉得卡普空会想办法把The Connections也牵扯进这个故事。正如我前面提到的，可以吃书将他们设定为那家敌对的公司，这样他们自然也会出现在《生化危机4》中，并加强后续作品的关联。与拉昆市的剧情不同，《代号维罗妮卡》的事件相对独立，因此在重组和混合故事线时有很大灵活性，同时仍能保留保证后续续作连续性的核心事件。
